### E: INSPECTION

1. CHECK MOTOR

1) Connect the battery positive terminal to terminal No. 5 and the battery ground terminal to terminal No. 4, and check that the valve is fully opened on LH side and the valve is fully closed on RH side.

CAUTION: Do not power the motor for more than 10 seconds.

![](images/30717d0dbf9251dbddb3bb99a1b149e77f7d233e58cd3082e0dbbfe2fda5884a.jpg)

(A) Full open (B) Full closed

2) Connect the battery positive terminal to terminal No. 4 and the battery ground terminal to terminal No. 5, and check that the valve is fully closed on LH side and the valve is fully opened on RH side.

CAUTION: Do not power the motor for more than 10 seconds.

![](images/eb6040e975690ad8766c118b5db4bddf9cb91aba1e4ef7ad6610a31f46f31474.jpg)

(A) Full open (B) Full closed

### 2. CHECK SENSORS

1) Connect dry-cell battery positive terminal to terminal No. 3 and dry-cell battery ground terminal to terminal No. 2, and connect the resistance (0.5 — 2 kΩ) between dry-cell battery positive terminal and terminal No. 1.

NOTE:

Use new dry-cell batteries. • Using circuit tester, check the voltage of a single dry-cell battery is 1.6 V or more. And also check the voltage of three batteries in series is between 4.8 V and 5.2 V 2) Connect the circuit tester positive terminal to terminal No. 1, and the circuit tester negative terminal to terminal No. 2.

3) Connect the battery positive terminal to terminal No. 5 and the battery ground terminal to terminal No. 4, and measure the voltages with the valve fully opened on LH side and with the valve fully closed on RH side.

CAUTION: Do not power the motor for more than 10 seconds.

![](images/ce5250d0b637f2eb82e3c71deb02302cf1c8a7eb0c12267ff0194c0d3fa9546d.jpg)

(A) Full open (B) Full closed

![](images/e7135952ecd4e927bdb4e2586b2dd7e08bff8c330919392560012e3e7987e42c.jpg)

4) Connect dry-cell battery positive terminal to terminal No. 3 and dry-cell battery ground terminal to terminal No. 2, and connect the resistance (0.5 — 2 kΩ) between dry-cell battery positive terminal and terminal No. 1.

NOTE:

• Use new dry-cell batteries.
• Using circuit tester, check the voltage of a single dry-cell battery is 1.6 V or more. And also check the voltage of three batteries in series is between 4.8 V and 5.2 V.
5) Connect the circuit tester positive terminal to terminal No. 1, and the circuit tester negative terminal to terminal No. 2.

6) Connect the battery positive terminal to terminal No. 4 and the battery ground terminal to terminal No. 5, and measure the voltages with the valve fully closed on LH side and with the valve fully opened on RH side.

CAUTION: Do not power the motor for more than 10 seconds.

![](images/13a9232dd66a5756c69eb445d5d4b6ee372c1d237a321083d411f20a8c4f358e.jpg)

(A) Full open (B) Full closed

![](images/5c073a0e85fb967ac98917653e48a636171c8684df9ed062d63ef6e15e399451.jpg)

### 3. OTHER INSPECTIONS

1) Check that the tumble generator valve assembly has no deformation, cracks or other damages.
2) Check tumble generator valve assembly for contamination or clogging.

### A: REMOVAL

1) Disconnect the ground cable from battery.
2) Remove the radiator sub fan and fan motor assembly. <Ref. to CO(H4DO)-67, REMOVAL, Radiator Sub Fan and Fan Motor.>
3) Lift up the vehicle.
4) Remove the under cover. <Ref. to EI-22, REMOVAL, Front Under Cover.>
5) Disconnect the front oxygen (A/F) sensor connector, and remove the clip holding the front oxygen (A/F) sensor harness.

![](images/ccccd8efe17610f2f801a058d4858ad3ec3afbe65d8490386b1e90ae244e2eca.jpg)

(A) Front oxygen (A/F) sensor con- (B) Rear oxygen sensor connector (C) Clip nector

6) Lower the vehicle.
7) Apply spray-type lubricant to the threaded portion of front oxygen (A/F) sensor, and leave it for one minute or more.

8) Remove the front oxygen (A/F) sensor.

CAUTION:
When removing the front oxygen (A/F) sensor, wait until exhaust pipe cools, otherwise it will damage the exhaust pipe.

![](images/399fa2135ee48c04b5d80476282b1c587b1b469fdb8481739d1e9be9f4eaf92c.jpg)

### B: INSTALLATION

CAUTION:

If lubricant is spilt over the exhaust pipe, wipe it off with cloth to avoid emission of smoke or causing a fire.

1) Before installing front oxygen (A/F) sensor, apply anti-seize compound only to the threaded portion of fron oxygen (A/F) sensor to make the next removal easier.

CAUTION: Never apply anti-seize compound to the protector of front oxygen (A/F) sensor.

Anti-seize compound: NEVER-SEEZ NSN, JET LUBE SS-30 or equivalent

2) Install the front oxygen (A/F) sensor.

Tightening torque: 21 N·m (2.1 kgf-m, 15.5 ft-lb)

![](images/bb51d61b75f4e449c0cb27df1b1cc2c869e0d5712f0b1e93edb4025792d949a1.jpg)

3) Lift up the vehicle.
4) Connect the front oxygen (A/F) sensor connector, and secure the front oxygen (A/F) sensor harness by using the clip.

![](images/f1172e60fed89ffddd7f3a43b006e153d03cfcab9565d38070fbba17ce422636.jpg)

(A) Front oxygen (A/F) sensor con- (B) Rear oxygen sensor connector (C) Clip nector

5) Install the under cover. <Ref. to EI-22, INSTALLATION, Front Under Cover.>
6) Lower the vehicle.
7) Install the radiator sub fan and fan motor assembly. <Ref. to CO(H4DO)-67, INSTALLATION, Radiator
Sub Fan and Fan Motor.>
8) Connect the battery ground terminal.

### C: INSPECTION

1) Check that the front oxygen (A/F) sensor has no deformation, cracks or other damages.
2) Measure the resistance between front oxygen (A/F) sensor terminals.

![](images/15cef81b524c54fa38700eaad87795ba9c3904427c94f91df5c9e79fad3f01d5.jpg)

![](images/96f68077a607caf6b9eef51454277827ed4f794986d181ae6e39292b03e353ac.jpg)

### A: REMOVAL

1) Disconnect the ground cable from battery.
2) Lift up the vehicle.
3) Remove the under cover. <Ref. to EI-22, REMOVAL, Front Under Cover.>
4) Disconnect the rear oxygen sensor connector.

![](images/ca266cd76668cfbaf477ca3d37017c46422dc6e15384cb9111a98a61c161e552.jpg)

(A) Front oxygen (A/F) sensor con- (B) Rear oxygen sensor connector (C) Clip nector

5) Apply spray-type lubricant to the threaded portion of rear oxygen sensor, and leave it for one minute or more.
6) Remove the rear oxygen sensor.

> ⚠️ **Внимание:** 
> When removing the rear oxygen sensor, wait until exhaust pipe cools, otherwise it will damage th exhaust pipe.
>
> ![](images/1a8ba99672332b020110afd040e1cb5e0e4332aecbd5476fc5fe4fd607164481.jpg)

### B: INSTALLATION

CAUTION:

If lubricant is spilt over the exhaust pipe, wipe it off with cloth to avoid emission of smoke or causing a fire.

1) Before installing rear oxygen sensor, apply the anti-seize compound only to the threaded portion of rea oxygen sensor to make the next removal easier.

> ⚠️ **Внимание:** 
> Never apply anti-seize compound to the protector of rear oxygen sensor.
>
> Anti-seize compound: NEVER-SEEZ NSN, JET LUBE SS-30 or equivalent
> 2) Install the rear oxygen sensor.
>
> Tightening torque: 21 N·m (2.1 kgf-m, 15.5 ft-lb)
>
> ![](images/b2c01ce8d61287fc6efd1867d1fdbead3a78b51551e0b11545cad9bf739f2e9c.jpg)
>
> 3) Connect the rear oxygen sensor connector.
>
> NOTE:
>
> Be careful not to allow the rear oxygen sensor harness to interfere with the sensor unit and the front oxygen (A/F) sensor harness.
>
> ![](images/40dc37acf994bb3863c4cbd2a366b196882f37f541bda5974f9d8800f75a4919.jpg)
>
> (A) Front oxygen (A/F) sensor con- (B) Rear oxygen sensor connector (C) Clip nector
>
> 4) Install the under cover. <Ref. to EI-22, INSTALLATION, Front Under Cover.>
> 5) Lower the vehicle.
> 6) Connect the battery ground terminal.

### C: INSPECTION

1) Check that the rear oxygen sensor has no deformation, cracks or other damages.
2) Measure the resistance between rear oxygen sensor terminals.

![](images/6bea397f25e4870f62e8b088d409b41322b8c7f7ca268350baebfe09506485f1.jpg)

FU-05962

![](images/dc8aa82bfd8acac47efc79f2a862ffc99dda009c4ddd27908d4411a669a0feba.jpg)

### A: REMOVAL

1) Disconnect the ground cable from battery.
2) Remove the glove box. <Ref. to EI-61, REMOVAL, Glove Box.>
3) Disconnect the connector from ECM.

![](images/2caa2d50dd04cbffdb5ec786a37ae34c3484d4a411db38c19e8560cf2b7f57c2.jpg)

![](images/fd2338ace624e11be18fd97c20f627950af5fe89d6bec926d47bf755b53daf34.jpg)

### B: INSTALLATION

Install in the reverse order of removal.

CAUTION:

When the ECM of model with immobilizer has been replaced, be sure to perform the registration of immobilizer system. (Refer to the “REGISTRATION MANUAL FOR IMMOBILIZER”.) If replacing ECM or the bracket, replace both parts with new parts at a time. After installing the bracket to ECM, do not separate the bracket. If the bracket has been installed to ECM in the wrong direction, replace both parts to new parts.

NOTE:

When replacing the ECM, be careful not to use the wrong spec. ECM to avoid any damage on the fuel injection system.

Tightening torque: 7.5 N·m (0.8 kgf-m, 5.5 ft-lb)

### A: REMOVAL

1) Disconnect the ground cable from battery.

26.Fuel

### A: PROCEDURE

WARNING: Place “NO OPEN FLAMES” signs near the working area.

CAUTION:
Be careful not to spill fuel.
1) Remove the fuse of fuel pump from main fuse box.

![](images/b9c06e3b8887b5f4919ec66426fc37904478ed74a83321f6e8bfa24f56e286da.jpg)

2) Start the engine and run it until it stalls.
3) After the engine stalls, crank it for five more seconds.
4) Turn the ignition switch to OFF.
5) Install the fuse of fuel pump to the main fuse box.

2. DRAINING FUEL (WITH SUBARU SELECT MONITOR)

### 3. DRAINING FUEL (THROUGH THE FUEL FILLER HOSE)

WARNING:

Place “NO OPEN FLAMES” signs near the working area.

CAUTION:

• Be careful not to spill fuel.
• Fuel may remain in the fuel filler pipe. Drain the fuel from the fuel filler pipe through the fill opening using the gasoline proof pump and the gasoline proof hose (ø10 or less) before the operation. 1) Lift up the vehicle.
2) Remove the rear exhaust pipe and muffler. <Ref. to EX(H4DO)-18, REMOVAL, Rear Exhaust Pipe.> <Ref. to EX(H4DO)-21, REMOVAL, Muffler.>
3) Open the fuel filler lid and remove the fuel filler cap.
4) Drain the fuel from the fuel filler pipe through the filler opening using the gasoline proof pump and the gasoline proof hose (ø10 or less).

> ⚠️ **Внимание:** 
> Be careful not to spill fuel.
> Catch the fuel from hoses using a container or cloth.
>
> ![](images/c107b89f6df5bdbd6c09d0e8a9d5d861d444732d919185a23eab9cdd2a2bd175.jpg)
>
> 6) Set the container under the vehicle and insert the gasoline proof hose (ø10 or less) into the fuel filler hose to drain the fuel.

> ⚠️ **Внимание:** 
> Be careful not to spill fuel.
>
> 7) Install the related parts in the reverse order after draining the fuel.
>
> NOTE: Correctly insert the fuel filler hose to the spool, and then install the clamp as shown.
>
> Tightening torque: 2.5 N·m (0.3 kgf-m, 1.8 ft-lb)
>
> ![](images/378f6215cceb4423e52dafcae3563b4f1e7c9a167b0097fa4107ff44abc10c26.jpg)
>
> (1) Fuel filler hose (3) Spool (4) Fuel filler pipe (2) Clamp

### A: REMOVAL

### B: INSTALLATION

Install in the reverse order of removal. NOTE: Use a new self-locking nut.

### 30.Fuel Pump

A: REMOVAL

WARNING: Place “NO OPEN FLAMES” signs near the working area.

CAUTION:

• Be careful not to spill fuel. Catch the fuel from the tubes using a container or cloth.
• If the fuel gauge indicates that two thirds or more of the fuel is remaining, be sure to drain fuel be
fore starting work to avoid the fuel to spill.

NOTE:

Fuel pump assembly consists of fuel pump, fuel filter and fuel level sensor.
1) Release the fuel pressure. <Ref. to FU(H4DO)-106, RELEASING OF FUEL PRESSURE, PROCEDURE, Fuel.>
2) Drain fuel. <Ref. to FU(H4DO)-106, DRAINING FUEL (WITH SUBARU SELECT MONITOR), PROCEDURE, Fuel.>
3) Disconnect the ground cable from battery.
4) Remove the rear seat cushion. <Ref. to SE-32, REMOVAL, Rear Seat.>
5) Remove the service hole cover of fuel pump.

![](images/d3d790d2b22a63c34307afe2ea4a3b19c90bcaaa43f962c86abbcdfd370ff11a.jpg)

### Fuel Pump

6) Disconnect connectors from the fuel pump, and move aside the service hole cover.

![](images/4193de438f9b397599935424394321ea5d358342805112fd7f44c231976ed55e.jpg)

7) Disconnect the quick connector of fuel delivery tube and jet pump tube. NOTE: Disconnect the quick connector as shown in the figure.

![](images/648e6866671ba868f45686cdd022c6e85d70ef81257dd7ecaa4f89bd701d551a.jpg)

(a) Slider

![](images/bf43fae21075e06083e297cdcc529e4f802bb1f8deae17276facffcf2e5d3601.jpg)

### Fuel Pump

8) Remove the nuts which hold the fuel pump upper plate to the fuel tank.

![](images/9baeac4515f0a636417be6291bfd6c0efd4a8a8f38c622fd7371fef743cf132f.jpg)

9) Remove the fuel pump assembly from the fuel tank.

### B: INSTALLATION

Install in the reverse order of removal while being careful of the following.

Make sure the sealing portion is free from fuel or foreign matter before installation.
Align protrusion (A) of the gasket to the position shown in the figure.
Insert the protrusion (B) of gasket to the fuel pump upper plate. (3 places) Align the protrusion (C) of fuel pump assembly with the cutout on the fuel pump upper plate.
Tighten the nuts to the specified torque in the order as shown in the figure.

NOTE: Use a new gasket.

Tightening torque: 4.4 N·m (0.4 kgf-m, 3.2 ft-lb)

![](images/bea16b5c67252801ba67454a40ed28f0da77bc9d05ffebc5c8f18292b8f38e16.jpg)

FU-06047

(a) Front side of vehicle

### Fuel Pump

Connect the quick connector as shown in the figure.

CAUTION:

• Check that there is no damage or dust on the quick connector. If necessary, clean the seal surface
of the pipe.
• When connecting the quick connector, make sure to insert the pipe all the way in before locking the
slider. When it is difficult to lock the slider, check that the pipe is fully inserted. Make sure that the quick connector is securely connected.

![](images/e9002a565b8f886d323a5334e04241b8ea88feb1ff75918a347d062d311bb729.jpg)

(a) Slider

### C: INSPECTION

1) Check that the fuel pump has no deformation, cracks or other damages.
2) Connect the battery positive terminal to terminal No. 3 and the battery ground terminal to terminal No. 4, and inspect the fuel pump operation.

> ⚠️ **Внимание:** 
> Wipe off fuel completely.
> Keep the battery as far apart from fuel pump as possible.
> Do not run the fuel pump for a long time under non-load condition.
>
> ![](images/851f395fcaa96792296732549df124530e0077d2f43398bc8f59a3c2dd4f85b3.jpg)

### 31.Fuel Level Sensor

A: REMOVAL

WARNING: Place “NO OPEN FLAMES” signs near the working area.

CAUTION:

Be careful not to spill fuel. • If the fuel gauge indicates that two thirds or more of the fuel is remaining, be sure to drain fuel before starting work to avoid the fuel to spill.

NOTE:

The fuel level sensor is built in fuel pump assembly.
1) Remove the fuel pump assembly. <Ref. to FU(H4DO)-134, REMOVAL, Fuel Pump.>
2) Disconnect the fuel level sensor connector (A), and pull out the connector cable and fuel level sensor harness from the clip.

![](images/324855e00fef6e136f6c8ee3adb68445121022b39b59207cc063fff98be88312.jpg)

### B: INSTALLATION

Install in the reverse order of removal.

![](images/57794e5cd77fc1eea8a71ef566dc7efc956eee7b59488d75d9330b29c575f2a2.jpg)

(A) Fuel level sensor harness (B) Connector cable

### C: INSPECTION

1) Check that the fuel level sensor has no damage.
2) Measure the fuel level sensor float position.

NOTE: When inspecting the fuel level sensor, perform the work with the sensor installed to the fuel pump.

FU-07740

### 33.Fuel Filter

A: REMOVAL

WARNING: Place “NO OPEN FLAMES” signs near the working area.

CAUTION:

• Be careful not to spill fuel.
• If the fuel gauge indicates that two thirds or more of the fuel is remaining, be sure to drain fuel before starting work to avoid the fuel to spill.
• Be careful not to drop or apply any impact to the fuel pump during work. This may deteriorate its performance.

NOTE:

The fuel filter is built in fuel pump assembly.

1) Remove the fuel pump assembly. <Ref. to FU(H4DO)-134, REMOVAL, Fuel Pump.>
2) Remove the fuel level sensor. <Ref. to FU(H4DO)-141, REMOVAL, Fuel Level Sensor.>
3) Remove the connector cable from the clip, and disconnect the connector (A) of the connector cable.

![](images/21c8a153ed5058fc515d1035980411b22e996e6e584b16a24fec5f22cf32bd0b.jpg)

FU-07677

4) Push the fuel filter assembly in the direction of the arrow to compress, and detach the connecting clip.

![](images/4ad57df5ad51b11962531a82a866b8e08cc04c5dab4f4978bf85ab7dec692c2f.jpg)

### Fuel Filter

5) Release the claw using a flat tip screwdriver or similar tool wrapped with a protection tape, and remove the tube assembly from the fuel chamber assembly.

![](images/0408ebdcce04d99408931a751d3e42ed36e60da859577b89331d776c3dc843a6.jpg)

6) Release three claws on the fuel pump holder from the fuel chamber assembly, and raise the fuel filter assembly.

![](images/c01f4a59865f98a3f379778a861257725e01914ed886c5f5975f539a3814df80.jpg)

7) Using a flat tip screwdriver or similar tool wrapped with a protection tape, remove the tube assembly from the fuel chamber assembly, and separate the fuel filter assembly and fuel chamber assembly.

![](images/2e97816537ba519ba8ac8b6c0a09630f1788f1b851eb2eb613276732c9e31884.jpg)

8) Using a precision driver or similar tool wrapped with a protection tape, expand the claws on the fuel pump.

![](images/b0d5d4d115174bef2255f2e38cef5943f20827ae54350052e795575dd6c75b11.jpg)

9) Release the claws on the fuel pump.

![](images/4a4d19df8e14ebadc1222b9a557e71e1064ef05c0a3c9edf1887bea4acd2f1fa.jpg)

10) Using a flat tip screwdriver or similar tool wrapped with a protection tape, press on the fuel pump and remove the fuel pump together with the fuel pump holder from the fuel filter assembly.

> ⚠️ **Внимание:** 
> If O-rings remain on the fuel filter assembly side, carefully remove them with a precision screwdriver or similar tool wrapped with a protection tape.
>
> ![](images/bcad0104b3aed03dde74ebaa02c9a8018ae0a395b1a08e5262b7b7f09d097e9f.jpg)

### Fuel Filter

11) Remove the spacer (A) and connector cable (B) from the fuel pump.

![](images/f3faaf86d977aac7396e369cfc46f2dacb3fdd8773d072dc418ffdf50e3c4a83.jpg)

12) Remove the pressure regulator from the fuel filter assembly.

![](images/28bbfa9d53d8b1db8ad46dcced69239957a1cd70ffa1f7cc8105a75a88667152.jpg)

13) Remove O-ring (A), O-ring (B), and backup ring (C) from the pressure regulator.

![](images/f2fbcf4e9873b6ad70d0c9d426e3efc20df9f7c611e0303a290022dadbd6167c.jpg)

### B: INSTALLATION

1) Install O-ring (A), O-ring (B), and backup ring (C) to the pressure regulator. NOTE:

Use new O-rings.
Apply gasoline to the O-ring and backup ring.

![](images/e68b1ab468e379d8a64c2f02fc39f4665d753fdb21a9c89b9e02a609ba7b1da4.jpg)

FU-07274

### Fuel Filter

2) Install the pressure regulator to the fuel filter assembly.

![](images/39cc595d11d6517fdc6c569ca015c4657ff26fa5503638d6ecad21e7812c16ee.jpg)

3) Install O-ring (A), spacer (B), and connector cable (C) to the fuel pump.

NOTE:

Use new O-rings and the connector cable.
Apply gasoline to the O-rings and the spacer.

![](images/c07e4627afe213bcef1386ea73f82ad707d88738b2d668d9f46a124cfbf3257d.jpg)

4) Install the fuel pump to the fuel filter assembly.

NOTE: After installation, make sure five claws are correctly engaged in each position.

![](images/a7fbb0c19900ce04608c87312aee2df803fe38a07c209fba8098419276aa166c.jpg)

5) Check that the cushions of the fuel chamber assembly for dislocation. If any of them is dislocated, install a new cushion.

![](images/1c5fb44c8c7625a8446a7d9d210d8831261a5662ec52472468a49645cae0d458.jpg)

### Fuel Filter

6) Slowly press in and install the tube assembly to the fuel chamber assembly until a clicking sound is heard.

![](images/91aaf3beff4ac20993be378fdb9a0fc65e0b810612e6ae77d0779433a1830f76.jpg)

7) Connect the tube assembly to the fuel chamber assembly.

![](images/d2914402f328007dcab91ec11d2d6c9d1a67841455111f1dd5a809bb5afd4277.jpg)

8) Install the fuel filter assembly to the fuel chamber assembly.

> ℹ️ **Примечание:** 
> Set the tube (A) and spring (B) for the fuel filter assembly as shown in the figure.
>
> ![](images/fa05aa4cb92825e15fe5fd9c06120053c05b4e2a0680a69b78ae910172712d38.jpg)
>
> Check that the claw connecting the fuel camber assembly and the fuel filter assembly is securely fastened.
>
> ![](images/3a29c14a78e794f0aecb0193e620f26b15152a6f1e461703f5ac2fce40983084.jpg)

### Fuel Filter

9) Push the fuel filter assembly in the direction of the arrow to compress, and attach the clip. NOTE:
Use a new clip.

![](images/b6b37850e99752aaa25039849a16c156fb98535fedd193bc4fc963137daf1379.jpg)

10) Secure the connector cable with the clip, and connect the connector (A) of the connector cable.

![](images/8d1fb87147fdf542a5b95b896c09e65bc4cd615fa1ea2e836302237ee8aa9e9c.jpg)

FU-07677

11) Install the fuel level sensor. <Ref. to FU(H4DO)-142, INSTALLATION, Fuel Level Sensor.>
12) Inspect the fuel level sensor. <Ref. to FU(H4DO)-143, INSPECTION, Fuel Level Sensor.>
13) Install the fuel pump assembly. <Ref. to FU(H4DO)-138, INSTALLATION, Fuel Pump.>

### 34.Fuel Delivery and Evaporation Lines

A: REMOVAL

Be careful not to spill fuel.

Catch the fuel from the tubes using a container or cloth.

NOTE: Disconnect the quick connector as shown in the figure.

9) Remove the fuel pipe assembly from vehicle.

Before using water removing agent, follow the cautions noted on the bottle.

### B: CAUTION

Prior to starting work, pay special attention to the following:

1. Always wear work clothes, a safety cap, protective shoes. Additionally, wear a helmet, protective goggles, etc. if necessary. 2. Protect the vehicle using a seat cover, fender cover, etc. 3. Prepare the service tools, clean cloth, containers to catch grease and oil, etc. • Vehicle components are extremely hot immediately after driving. Be wary of receiving burns from heated parts. • When performing a repair, identify the cause of trouble and avoid unnecessary removal, disassembly and replacement. • Before disconnecting connectors of sensors or units, be sure to disconnect the ground cable from battery. • Always use the jack-up point when the shop jacks or rigid racks are used to support the vehicle. • Remove contamination including dirt and corrosion before removal, installation, disassembly or assembly. • Keep the removed parts in order and protect them from dust and dirt. • All removed parts, if to be reused, should be reinstalled in the original positions with attention to the correct directions, etc. • Bolts, nuts and washers should be replaced with new parts as required. • Be sure to tighten the fasteners including bolts and nuts to the specified torque.

### C: PREPARATION TOOL

1. GENERAL TOOL

![](images/a6c08cb97111ca51377b1e18fa15b83ca728e237e84d84cfd21d265231bf3ce1.jpg)

EC(H4DO)-6

### A: REMOVAL

The front catalytic converter is integrated into the front exhaust pipe; therefore, refer to “Front Exhaust Pipe” for the removal procedure. <Ref. to EX(H4DO)-6, REMOVAL, Front Exhaust Pipe.>

### B: INSTALLATION

The front catalytic converter is integrated into the front exhaust pipe; therefore, refer to “Front Exhaust Pipe” for the installation procedure. <Ref. to EX(H4DO)-8, INSTALLATION, Front Exhaust Pipe.>

### C: INSPECTION

1) Check the connections and welded parts for exhaust leaks.
2) Make sure there are no holes or rusting.

### 3. Rear Catalytic Converter

A: REMOVAL

The rear catalytic converter is integrated into the center exhaust pipe; therefore, refer to “Center Exhaust Pipe” for the removal procedure. <Ref. to EX(H4DO)-14, REMOVAL, Center Exhaust Pipe.>

### B: INSTALLATION

The rear catalytic converter is integrated into the center exhaust pipe; therefore, refer to “Center Exhaust Pipe” for the installation procedure. <Ref. to EX(H4DO)-15, INSTALLATION, Center Exhaust Pipe.>

### C: INSPECTION

1) Check the connections and welded parts for exhaust leaks.
2) Make sure there are no holes or rusting.

### A: REMOVAL

1) Lift up the vehicle.

2) Remove the rear exhaust pipe. <Ref. to EX(H4DO)-18, REMOVAL, Rear Exhaust Pipe.>
3) Remove the propeller shaft. <Ref. to DS-11, REMOVAL, Propeller Shaft.>
4) Support the rear differential with the transmission jack.
5) Remove the self-locking nuts which hold the rear differential to the rear sub frame assembly.

![](images/c0c01ad3be686f668bff8e41aa1bab5cb3b3c61bf39958adbd8c324ceecaba6c.jpg)

6) Remove the rear differential member from the rear sub frame assembly and the rear differential.

![](images/f6d0206954b179abbf29646817f20653302d9f3d9ac39de3a54dbd18c3c9d60e.jpg)

7) Lower the transmission jack gradually until the rear differential is at the position shown in the figure. NOTE:

• When pulling out the stud bolt from the bushing portion of the rear sub frame assembly, adjust the angle and location of transmission jack and jack stand.

![](images/281530ac8ab8c9d34ac48dbef3aad015b45e7ca5702e83ed05c61cc4f455f9a6.jpg)

Do not lower the rear differential excessively. Doing so may add extra load to the drive shaft or cause the falling-off of the drive shaft.

![](images/5abf6299beaec3d6eadcb8a6fb907029c6a511e9c0ef776cb4b94e1abeeef1af.jpg)

8) Disconnect the drain tube (A), vent tube (B) and purge tube (C) from the canister. NOTE:
Disconnect the quick connector as shown in the figure.

![](images/befbcdecb23f13cf266469f704fd4d9a66e1e2abe9fb8c85e1237fa367a713ee.jpg)

EC-02971

(a) Drain tube and vent tube (b) Purge tube

![](images/b9ec9a42fdd3f29968bd99988c6aae013ebfc81618f800dd7ab53c71d675b92e.jpg)

9) Remove the canister from vehicle.

![](images/62ad556d8f0f874f0fe93fe94c647a699c1f71886f3ece912464ec06a7f9bf33.jpg)

### B: INSTALLATION

1) Install the canister to the vehicle.

Tightening torque: 7.5 N·m (0.8 kgf-m, 5.5 ft-lb)

![](images/d481026bc5d514415463b7326482a543173b5e1f1f1dc31f3719f45d84fec8bf.jpg)

2) Install the drain tube (A), vent tube (B) and purge tube (C) to the canister.

> ⚠️ **Внимание:** 
> • Check that there is no damage or dust on the quick connector. If necessary, clean the seal surface of the pipe.
> • Make sure that the quick connector is securely connected.
>
> NOTE: Install the quick connector as shown in the figure.
>
> ![](images/283cc7b2ae7b0d9aa57ce1a94512cc94aa5391eb8ecef48c51a4f2b7407a8735.jpg)
>
> (a) Drain tube and vent tube (b) Purge tube
>
> ![](images/dec3f2bfd51eb0b92e02e3b9dac9c2eb51b4225ea189453cc0e98d626fa1421b.jpg)
>
> 3) Lift up the transmission jack gradually, and set the rear differential to the rear sub frame assembly.
>
> NOTE:
>
> When inserting the stud bolt into the bushing portion of the rear sub frame assembly, adjust the angle and location of transmission jack and jack stand.
>
> ![](images/ab4d4c95d6e1b60b6ca4727da2b0be448d60df98a107caed09dff71902395ac9.jpg)
>
> 4) Temporarily tighten the self- locking nuts which hold the rear differential to the rear sub frame assembly. NOTE:
> Use a new self-locking nut.
>
> ![](images/e7f650c91b66ac4087ab41698431ba44da62af3a314c229ac45240082fbd77c8.jpg)
>
> 5) Set the rear differential member to the rear sub frame assembly and rear differential, and temporarily tighten the self-lock nuts which secure the rear differential member to the rear sub frame assembly and rear differential.
>
> NOTE: Use a new self-locking nut.
>
> ![](images/14415269cc9b1afcfe3b1beec5e8d35a93d8445fd1bd1918bef39eab59886c72.jpg)
>
> 6) Remove the transmission jack from the rear differential.
> 7) Tighten the self-locking nuts which secure the rear differential member to the rear sub frame assembly and rear differential.
>
> Tightening torque: T1: 50 N·m (5.1 kgf-m, 36.9 ft-lb) T2: 110 N·m (11.2 kgf-m, 81.1 ft-lb)
>
> ![](images/b6bdc34f457e932d93e8f6ea42552b6cd42c778a3e36d6fe837f73b001908657.jpg)
>
> 8) Tighten the self-locking nuts which secure the rear differential to the rear sub frame assembly.
>
> Tightening torque: 70 N·m (7.1 kgf-m, 51.6 ft-lb)
>
> ![](images/6bed9099d44a5eb2ee66a597480bd4fce2b4930cc5b512981c62d365273157ec.jpg)
>
> 9) Install the propeller shaft. <Ref. to DS-13, INSTALLATION, Propeller Shaft.>
> 10) Install the rear exhaust pipe. <Ref. to EX(H4DO)-19, INSTALLATION, Rear Exhaust Pipe.>
> 11) Lower the vehicle.

### C: INSPECTION

1) Check that the canister has no deformation, cracks or other damages.
2) Check that the tube has no cracks, damage or loose part.

### 5. Purge Control Solenoid Valve

A: REMOVAL

1) Disconnect the ground cable from battery.
2) Remove the bolt which holds the purge control solenoid valve onto intake manifold.

NOTE: Hold the purge control solenoid valve unit by hand to prevent it from rotating together.

![](images/eb17f5ba1c042abb110d1fbf163ddedc9a826bcbcafe552486572d97e2873f24.jpg)

3) Disconnect the vacuum hose from the intake manifold and intake manifold clip (A).

![](images/478f38e00c460dd4017ce2ce7a962b85021669674ea3dedcab9c74392da6d0c2.jpg)

4) Disconnect the vacuum hose (A) and connector (B) from the purge control solenoid valve, and remove the purge control solenoid valve.

![](images/f980a5bd4f2961dbd289fc52b761b244a39ef3cf8603680a42f428364e8d6786.jpg)

5) Remove the vacuum hose from the purge control solenoid valve.

![](images/60b2a660d64135a83753f80ca34d60f157e10562211045c9d44e88f642fae624.jpg)

### B: INSTALLATION

Install in the reverse order of removal.

NOTE:

Hold the purge control solenoid valve unit by hand to prevent it from rotating together.
Connect the vacuum hose as shown in the figure.

![](images/d011decbf46c440c37cc5a344f47ee83050e9bfa75ab2fefdeb5bb859bf471ef.jpg)

EC-02942

(a) To intake manifold (b) To fuel pipe

Check that the vacuum hose is securely held to the intake manifold and intake manifold clip (A).

![](images/caecf0752121f0de4c5d1432d946b3d384122aeb81a8034080c747ab4194ae2b.jpg)

Tightening torque: 3.4 N·m (0.3 kgf-m, 2.5 ft-lb)

### 1. PURGE CONTROL SOLENOID VALVE

1) Check that the purge control solenoid valve has no deformation, cracks or other damages.
2) Measure the resistance between the purge control solenoid valve terminals.

![](images/59e99dfcf307a578ce82f74575d7ed09fb9be3cd06cbf6d054756201f26c82bd.jpg)

![](images/4de18cc56e7c0ada102864319e24c5fdac8746a76155a9e210a9c1deec523d74.jpg)

3) Check that air does not come out from (B) when air is blown into (A).

![](images/1fab6cd5eeff5d35ff9c0a7296d26431e72c23ac3dae70eceb475f416bf66c30.jpg)

EC-02963

4) Connect the battery positive terminal to the terminal No. 1 and the battery negative terminal to the terminal No. 2. Check that air is discharged from (B), when supplying air to (A).

![](images/f51391601c671269658ae784c6b50bdfbaaf0015b4855cea1a77ab68b0557e7d.jpg)

### A: REMOVAL

1) Disconnect the ground cable from battery.
2) Remove the clip (A) from the air intake boot.
3) Loosen the clamp (B) securing the air cleaner case (rear) to the air intake boot.
4) Loosen the clamp (C) which secures the throttle body to the air intake boot.

![](images/3f802bfb74e847caf11a23f40c4516a4bc882185bfc2a57f67a977b113837d01.jpg)

5) Remove the air intake boot from the throttle body, and move it to the left side wheel apron.

![](images/17b0988162c2b10b612386c8a4d6d169ebf875cc2eebdd3ca0c88ccea8d7a082.jpg)

6) Disconnect the connector from the EGR control valve.

![](images/6b2e92009c8e4151b6d71236b3d6a1bc1f9dc26f37b88d9f70b311b70c0611b9.jpg)

7) Remove the EGR control valve from the water pipe assembly.

![](images/4338b4fb99344cb96ca5340e84d825b1d94ab8fed0cffec693a05dd4d986ac99.jpg)

### B: INSTALLATION

Install in the reverse order of removal.

NOTE: Use new O-rings and gaskets.

Tightening torque: 22 N·m (2.2 kgf-m, 16.2 ft-lb)

![](images/0f981f71d00d2083964dd83173cb1cebec05f7ee2742386793c0b7a6f1352934.jpg)

Tightening torque: 3 N·m (0.3 kgf-m, 2.2 ft-lb)

![](images/f60e569f5191e9e42ebc08c20e66095e5a3c516be8830c1385cfd55342e428db.jpg)

### C: INSPECTION

1) Check that the EGR control valve has no deformation, cracks or other damages.
2) Measure the resistance between EGR control valve terminals.

![](images/0b6197bc0c2946a90d96c65de10576f850006978066d8bc42fad4b3a99f85765.jpg)

![](images/2007c91d9e6b3f2947cfd6d85753b5acfedf03f632ca21a82c662250cf0c0683.jpg)

### A: REMOVAL

1) Disconnect the ground cable from battery.
2) Remove the clip (A) from the air intake boot.
3) Loosen the clamp (B) securing the air cleaner case (rear) to the air intake boot.
4) Loosen the clamp (C) which secures the throttle body to the air intake boot.

![](images/6bbc8815c9e694e892eda127a2bb6091c16e5450ebbdd189194d47d2d3dce0b1.jpg)

5) Remove the air intake boot from the throttle body, and move it to the left side wheel apron.

![](images/610d794b8c3afa3c4865dd1615101611431c934bdd41de2066b8bb485fadf59e.jpg)

6) Remove the EGR pipe assembly from the water pipe assembly and the cylinder head RH.

![](images/3c48d7afb58df0739a61eb0de4d8532066fdf6e74a757d25830557d95391b229.jpg)

7) Remove the EGR pipe from EGR pipe adapter.

![](images/392f01970e79b09db5df44b075d516999fec2c826663b0c3c37a4ee9e39b4bf4.jpg)

EC(H4DO)-27

8) Disconnect the connector from the throttle body.

![](images/ef6ae9c5a4d95a6d056efa60b372e31412491fab29d0b0784c575d20737b0260.jpg)

9) Remove the bolts which secure the throttle body to the intake manifold, and tilt the throttle body to the rear side of vehicle.

![](images/47cbfaf771077e4594228fd0df6787fd9c17b310b841612dba9921d1a374e368.jpg)

10) Remove the bolts and nuts that hold the EGR pipe to the intake manifold and the water pipe assembly, and remove the EGR pipe.

![](images/f0b8c0fb48cc3404c32ce89abe63fde4717992740ac94c89b94e1594526c8414.jpg)

### B: INSTALLATION

1) Temporarily install the EGR pipe to the intake manifold and water pipe assembly, and tighten the EGR pipe in numerical order as shown in the figure.

NOTE: Use a new gasket.

Tightening torque: 6.4 N·m (0.7 kgf-m, 4.7 ft-lb)

![](images/06eb9299d3dde2892290fd0003ea6f325babb697ca8b57839ff6c98c6889b95f.jpg)

2) Install the throttle body to the intake manifold.

Tightening torque: 8 N·m (0.8 kgf-m, 5.9 ft-lb)

![](images/c45d5e1aef98c1dc45bccc6e2430282f2e2284c19052124a94cdfaa7c7256a72.jpg)

3) Connect the connector to the throttle body.

![](images/2ea93b063db285c456369c7923ff02cf7628269262887693b75da5762dbfecdf.jpg)

4) Temporarily install the EGR pipe to EGR pipe adapter.

![](images/44ef216da4fb46ca7ad471ebcd4c0ee6b960f6c23824e2b555cec12234d25f4e.jpg)

5) Temporarily install the EGR pipe assembly to the water pipe assembly and cylinder head assembly, and tighten the EGR pipe assembly in numerical order as shown in the figure.

Tightening torque: T1: 6.4 N·m (0.7 kgf-m, 4.7 ft-lb) T2: 51 N·m (5.2 kgf-m, 37.6 ft-lb)

![](images/69b71f8a7fc23d64ba0a010c38d0f99a4c68a0b362f40b29c3b6acafc990ec67.jpg)

6) Install the air intake boot. <Ref. to IN(H4DO)-11, INSTALLATION, Air Intake Boot.>
7) Connect the battery ground terminal.

### A: SPECIFICATION

The leak check valve assembly is a non-disassembled part. Do not remove the drain filter from the leak check valve assembly. Refer to “Leak Check Valve Assembly” for removal and installation procedures. <Ref. to EC(H4DO)-35, REMOVAL, Leak Check Valve Assembly.> <Ref. to EC(H4DO)-41, INSTALLATION, Leak Check Valve Assembly.>

### A: REMOVAL

1) Disconnect the ground cable from battery.
2) Lift up the vehicle.
3) Remove the rear exhaust pipe. <Ref. to EX(H4DO)-18, REMOVAL, Rear Exhaust Pipe.>
4) Remove the propeller shaft. <Ref. to DS-11, REMOVAL, Propeller Shaft.>
5) Support the rear differential with the transmission jack.
6) Remove the self-locking nuts which hold the rear differential to the rear sub frame assembly.

![](images/8ef14e204378229a376c653cc560817caef1e7f70c2da4ae20183e147eb9738e.jpg)

7) Remove the rear differential member from the rear sub frame assembly and the rear differential.

![](images/7038bef85d83843aaf79173ad24b31ed2d84e4fbb98d6dab12b5aa4b5469bcae.jpg)

8) Lower the transmission jack gradually until the rear differential is at the position shown in the figure. NOTE:

• When pulling out the stud bolt from the bushing portion of the rear sub frame assembly, adjust the angle and location of transmission jack and jack stand.

![](images/3fb303acbfb372ae230b9ee9fe2bea691538430246c52ea7325b07e9fce4a319.jpg)

Do not lower the rear differential excessively. Doing so may add extra load to the drive shaft or cause the falling-off of the drive shaft.

![](images/0d41f8a22b2d894c5ca4701b27caf1ad0b45ed63098d198f485db302341aef76.jpg)

9) Disconnect the drain tube from the canister.

NOTE: Disconnect the quick connector as shown in the figure.

![](images/02c942c629b8b58d09f7d833638525c5e6a2a7d2b7a46e654373e1a54cb34989.jpg)

10) Disconnect the fuel filler hose (A) and evaporation hose (B).

![](images/065bbe2d5b309d7a03d1370aa27e77b7027894728711f6d0ad5013fe70cab1e7.jpg)

11) Disconnect the drain tube from the drain pipe of the fuel filler pipe assembly. NOTE:
Disconnect the quick connector as shown in the figure.

![](images/f454fd2dbca7b3a95db71729be805f5f646152740c83ed025913a4ff08c784dd.jpg)

![](images/4f4beb3c0f5c779f139d830bcbb79edb541f1fa6e3adbc7e21086f7a2bbcd22d.jpg)

12) Disconnect the connector from the leak check valve assembly.

![](images/410c84e992faddbbe5be4d979b31e8bc2e3af3510c4ba7809d38a60ec37aba5e.jpg)

13) Remove the bolt and clip (A) which secure the leak check valve assembly to the vehicle, and remove the leak check valve assembly.

![](images/481dc82c0f9c5d166972fb6d77c832f8d677b6e78fd22a2079ad1032e72fc3c2.jpg)

### B: INSTALLATION

1) Install the leak check valve assembly to the vehicle with the bolt and clip (A).

Tightening torque: 7.5 N·m (0.8 kgf-m, 5.5 ft-lb)

![](images/6dadebaae56c2ab137a40a1a789410b69421f782fcf37bd7c0f16db70863a976.jpg)

2) Connect the connector to the leak check valve assembly.

![](images/b33f962cc90935c9d41207f50ab838976278515898208fbd6ec37695945c0de4.jpg)

3) Connect the drain tube to the drain pipe of the fuel filler pipe assembly.

CAUTION:

• Check that there is no damage or dust on the quick connector. If necessary, clean the seal surface
of the pipe. Make sure that the quick connector is securely connected.

NOTE:

Connect

![](images/5a5b6c398901d6ada18153f0247031b18be8f87d84cef33098bbb2e875a351b1.jpg)

4) Securely insert the fuel filler hose (A) and evaporation hose (B) until the hose end contacts the spool, then attach the clamp and clip as shown in the figure.

Tightening torque: 2.5 N·m (0.3 kgf-m, 1.8 ft-lb)

![](images/d4703cf41490dac5f0fcd59320c43935064f1271213a3f8314227b8e52db39d2.jpg)

(1) Hose (3) Spool (4) Pipe (2) Clamp and clip

5) Connect the drain tube to the canister.

CAUTION:

• Check that there is no damage or dust on the quick connector. If necessary, clean the seal surface
of the pipe. Make sure that the quick connector is securely connected.

NOTE: Connect the quick connector as shown in the figure.

![](images/c080f9c9cc1fdfb717d95e9ef3f5815109bc36cf888f1d5682a0d3db63c3f4bd.jpg)

6) Lift up the transmission jack gradually, and set the rear differential to the rear sub frame assembly. NOTE:

When inserting the stud bolt into the bushing portion of the rear sub frame assembly, adjust the angle and location of transmission jack and jack stand.

![](images/14cebfcfa3e3d18256e3f4c6038c198e6d6b7cc6165c302b98f9671e17e7e887.jpg)

7) Temporarily tighten the self-locking nuts which hold the rear differential to the rear sub frame assembly. NOTE:
Use a new self-locking nut.

![](images/3adeed8b8db4f716e3e0224a7483710267171e58ddced83a28a64e8deb145dde.jpg)

8) Set the rear differential member to the rear sub frame assembly and rear differential, and temporarily tighten the self-lock nuts which secure the rear differential member to the rear sub frame assembly and rear differential.

NOTE: Use a new self-locking nut.

![](images/bd5b0c4f459b06b85e80e65854e589e95fcb37beaec0e530c4f101df7e52948a.jpg)

9) Remove the transmission jack from the rear differential.
10) Tighten the self-locking nuts which secure the rear differential member to the rear sub frame assembly and rear differential.

Tightening torque: T1: 50 N·m (5.1 kgf-m, 36.9 ft-lb) T2: 110 N·m (11.2 kgf-m, 81.1 ft-lb)

![](images/6b4510fc15b006fd1e96d3d80ce7efd5b12cd1eab75363d2d486ffa1a91dbfe1.jpg)

11) Tighten the self-locking nuts which secure the rear differential to the rear sub frame assembly.

Tightening torque: 70 N·m (7.1 kgf-m, 51.6 ft-lb)

![](images/1eaa5ee07b46b8f8dd2b47ea130c0d4f11fdacb73765d66905be057c9f588edf.jpg)

12) Install the propeller shaft. <Ref. to DS-13, INSTALLATION, Propeller Shaft.>

### B: INSTALLATION

13) Install the rear exhaust pipe. <Ref. to EX(H4DO)-19, INSTALLATION, Rear Exhaust Pipe.>
14) Lower the vehicle.
15) Connect the battery ground terminal.

### C: DISASSEMBLY

1) Disconnect the drain tube from the leak check valve assembly. NOTE: Disconnect the quick connector as shown in the figure.

![](images/c58cb8bbb13bd334652aafa4d7359244d9db9eaabe8c6da3f9ce6a7cef35b43e.jpg)

2) Remove the bracket from the leak check valve assembly.

![](images/546fd21918ad439f6b1549f032635af0b07343efbf3cab5a64381837982a0aac.jpg)

### D: ASSEMBLY

1) Install the bracket to the leak check valve assembly.

Tightening torque: 18 N·m (1.8 kgf-m, 13.3 ft-lb)

![](images/de81f5221b56a2a8cbf99a6cc5f48b01bfae219dd16093d14061443b840955e0.jpg)

2) Install the drain tube to the leak check valve assembly.

> ⚠️ **Внимание:** 
> • Check that there is no damage or dust on the quick connector. If necessary, clean the seal surface
> of the pipe. Make sure that the quick connector is securely connected.
>
> NOTE: Connect the quick connector as shown in the figure.
>
> ![](images/696878ece1996e1fa2a162905fc1686fff82c95f4d7d8b996dc9a3a81c213455.jpg)

### 1. CHECK SWITCHING VALVE

1) Check the resistance between switching valve terminals.

![](images/557de54f4d0ef54c712b4eeae572e498e38a34602bd56c7123bbc211f41f5879.jpg)

EC-02813

![](images/ee7085a2441a53073048991dabd1211429b45c95ef5d1b303b5fe4230de7487a.jpg)

2) Check that air is discharged from (B) when air is blown into (A).

![](images/059c9be0ef57261abec5fa339462bdc91c15f9b6eae69034158cc423141a0438.jpg)

EC-03403

### Leak Check Valve Assembly

3) Connect the battery positive terminal to the terminal No. 5 and the battery negative terminal to the terminal No. 1. Check that air does not come out from (B) when air is blown into (A).

![](images/e819004e1c7736f904dc03f1d5e6095f8b216f963284f0acd591323569c21b32.jpg)

### 2. CHECK VACUUM PUMP

1) Connect the battery positive terminal to terminal No. 3 and the battery ground terminal to terminal No. 4, and inspect the vacuum pump operation.

CAUTION: Do not operate the vacuum pump for 5 minutes or more.

![](images/00d80f93e67251938c101abe02c63206bd096ed9cec7a5fa0277814c9fcab683.jpg)

### 3. CHECK PRESSURE SENSOR

1) Connect dry-cell battery positive terminal to terminal No. 6 and dry-cell battery ground terminal to terminal No. 8, circuit tester positive terminal to terminal No. 7 and the circuit tester negative terminal to terminal No. 8.

NOTE:

Use new dry-cell batteries.

Using circuit tester, check the voltage of a single dry-cell battery is 1.6 V or more. And also check the voltage of three batteries in series is between 4.8 V and 5.2 V.

![](images/81b294610fc053408165143b2baaad9444c61483a6657b516b5ebb8a04c124e5.jpg)

2) Check the voltage at a normal atmospheric pressure.

NOTE:

The atmospheric pressure at higher altitude is lower than normal. Therefore, the voltage is lower than the standard value.

![](images/86b4a209b48f39a449fbd47f0da655f66f2d26d401319c366967316b720b53fb.jpg)

3) Connect the battery positive terminal to terminal No. 3 and the battery ground terminal to terminal No. 4, and check that there is a voltage drop from the voltage measured in step 2) when the vacuum pump is operated.

![](images/717ce48e2492a03e55f56a55c63d8e84d1ab0a0e195d36db21cd85c5a0f252d0.jpg)

### 4. OTHER INSPECTIONS

1) Check that the leak check valve assembly has no deformation, cracks or other damages.
2) Check that the tube or hose have no cracks, damage or loose part.

### 12.PCV Hose

A: REMOVAL

CAUTION: Do not remove except when the PCV hose is broken.

1) Disconnect the PCV hose A from the intake manifold and the PCV valve, and then remove the PCV hose A.

![](images/299b709f22b1b09bc1d30602fe93a5c65739269eaf6736ca827287580ab25487.jpg)

2) Remove the intake manifold. <Ref. to FU(H4DO)-19, REMOVAL, Intake Manifold.>
3) Remove the PCV hose B from the PCV connector.

![](images/f94fe0a6a163e8b01460b9170dd6d1bb7472d6f31eb65151f6994b3482900209.jpg)

### B: CAUTION

Prior to starting work, pay special attention to the following: 1. Always wear work clothes, safety cap, protective shoes. Additionally, wear a helmet, protective goggles, etc. if necessary. 2. Protect the vehicle using a seat cover, fender cover, etc. 3. Prepare the service tools, clean cloth, containers to catch grease and oil, etc. • Vehicle components are extremely hot immediately after driving. Be wary of receiving burns from heated parts. • When performing a repair, identify the cause of trouble and avoid unnecessary removal, disassembly and replacement. • Before disconnecting connectors of sensors or units, be sure to disconnect the ground cable from battery. • Always use the jack-up point when the shop jacks or rigid racks are used to support the vehicle. • Remove contamination including dirt and corrosion before removal, installation, disassembly or assembly. • Keep the removed parts in order and protect them from dust and dirt. • All removed parts, if to be reused, should be reinstalled in the original positions with attention to the correct directions, etc. • Bolts, nuts and washers should be replaced with new parts as required. • Be sure to tighten the fasteners including bolts and nuts to the specified torque.

### A: REMOVAL

1) Remove the clips from air cleaner case (front).

![](images/e6f83fb3170cfae025558f6aada60c4087f253d3ab4dda6ac5bb1de5cde65b82.jpg)

### B: INSTALLATION

Install in the reverse order of removal.

CAUTION: Be sure to use SUBARU genuine air cleaner element depending on the engine type when replacing the air cleaner elements. Using other air cleaner element may affect the engine performance.

NOTE:

• Check that there are no foreign objects in the air cleaner case.
• When installing the air cleaner case (rear), align the protrusion of the air cleaner case (rear) to the hole on the air cleaner case (front) to install.

![](images/cf632e02fae0a9d7e17146b330d06700c3d747916de5c61f89217e2a1c56d1c5.jpg)

### C: INSPECTION

1) Check that the air cleaner element has no deformation, cracks or other damages.
2) Check the air cleaner element for excessive dirt.
3) Replace the air cleaner case (rear) if the HC absorption filter is damaged.

### A: REMOVAL

1) Disconnect the ground cable from battery.

2) Remove the air intake duct (rear). <Ref. to IN(H4DO)-12, REMOVAL, Air Intake Duct.> 3) Disconnect the connector (A) from the mass air flow and intake air temperature sensor, and remove the clip (B).

### C: CAUTION

Prior to starting work, pay special attention to the following:

1. Always wear work clothes, a safety cap, protective shoes. Additionally, wear a helmet, protective goggles, etc. if necessary. 2. Protect the vehicle using a seat cover, fender cover, etc. 3. Prepare the service tools, clean cloth, containers to catch grease and oil, etc.
• Vehicle components are extremely hot immediately after driving. Be wary of receiving burns from heated
parts.
• When performing a repair, identify the cause of trouble and avoid unnecessary removal, disassembly and
replacement.
• Before disconnecting connectors of sensors or units, be sure to disconnect the ground cable from battery.
• Always use the jack-up point when the shop jacks or rigid racks are used to support the vehicle.
• Remove or install the engine in an area where chain hoists, lifting devices, etc. are available for ready use.
When lifting up the vehicle, make sure to support the vehicle at the jack-up points.
• Be careful not to let any oil or grease contact the clutch disc or flywheel.
• Remove contamination including dirt and corrosion before removal, installation, disassembly or assembly.
• Keep the removed parts in order and protect them from dust and dirt.
• All removed parts, if to be reused, should be reinstalled in the original positions with attention to the correct
directions, etc.
• Rotating parts and sliding parts such as piston, bearing and gear should be coated with oil when being as
sembled.
• Bolts, nuts and washers should be replaced with new parts as required. Be sure to tighten the fasteners including bolts and nuts to the specified torque.

### A: INSPECTION

CAUTION:

After warming-up, engine becomes very hot. Be careful not to burn yourself during measurement.

1) After warming-up the engine, turn the ignition switch to OFF.
2) Make sure that the battery is fully charged.
3) Check the starter motor for satisfactory performance and operation.
4) Remove the fuse of fuel pump from main fuse box.
5) Start the engine and run it until it stalls.
6) After the engine stalls, crank it for five more seconds.
7) Turn the ignition switch to OFF.
8) Remove all spark plugs. <Ref. to IG(H4DO)-4, REMOVAL, Spark Plug.>
9) Connect the battery ground terminal.
10) Install the compression gauge to the spark plug hole.

![](images/df2a8a94dea73688aacac2dae0a1818a48875f85319111536be693e4be0caff4.jpg)

NOTE:

When using a screw-in type compression gauge, the screw should be less than 25 mm (0.98 in) long.

![](images/066bac318d7a22cea70e52e6a5d2081e672fffd4ed77cf05ec6b301439e2330f.jpg)

### ME(H4DO)-24

11) Turn the ignition switch to ON.
12) Fully open the throttle valve.
13) Crank the engine by starter motor and read the value when the needle of the compression gauge becomes stable.

NOTE:

Perform at least two measurements per cylinder, and make sure that the values are correct. If the compression pressure is out of standard, check or adjust the pistons, valves and cylinders

Compression (fully open throttle): Standard 1,050 — 1,400 kPa (11 — 14 kgf/cm2, 152 — 203 psi) Difference between cylinders 100 kPa (1 kgf/cm2, 14 psi) or less
14) After inspection, install the related parts in the reverse order of removal.

### A: INSPECTION

1) Before checking the idle speed, check the following item:

(1) Check the air cleaner element is free from clogging, ignition timing is correct, spark plugs are in good condition, and hoses are connected properly.
(2) Check the malfunction indicator light does not illuminate. 2) Warm up the engine.
3) Read the engine idle speed using Subaru Select Monitor. <Ref. to EN(H4DO)(diag)-36, DISPLAY CURRENT ENGINE DATA, OPERATION, Subaru Select Monitor.>

NOTE:

Idle speed cannot be adjusted manually, because the idle speed is automatically adjusted.
• If idle speed is out of standard, refer to the General Diagnosis Table under “Engine Control System”. <Ref.
to EN(H4DO)(diag)-2, Basic Diagnostic Procedure.> (1) Check the idle speed when no-loaded. (Headlight, heater fan, rear defroster, radiator fan, A/C and etc. are OFF)
Idle speed (No load, and for CVT model, select lever in “P” or “N” range, for MT model, gear shift lever
in neutral position.): Standard 675100 rpm (CVT model) 650100 rpm (MT model) (2) Check the idle speed when loaded. (Turn the A/C switch to ON and operate the compressor for at least one minute before measurement.)
Idle speed (A/C on, and for CVT model, select lever in “P” or “N” range, for MT model, gear shift lever
in neutral position.): Standard 850100 rpm

### A: INSPECTION

CAUTION:

After warming-up, engine becomes very hot. Be careful not to burn yourself at measurement.

1) Before checking the ignition timing, check the following item: (1) Check the air cleaner element is free from clogging, spark plugs are in good condition, and hoses are connected properly. (2) Check the malfunction indicator light does not illuminate.
2) Warm up the engine.
3) Read the ignition timing using Subaru Select Monitor. <Ref. to EN(H4DO)(diag)-36, DISPLAY CURRENT
ENGINE DATA, OPERATION, Subaru Select Monitor.>
NOTE:
If ignition timing is out of standard, check the ignition control system. Refer to “Engine Control System”. <Ref.
to EN(H4DO)(diag)-2, Basic Diagnostic Procedure.>

Ignition timing [BTDC/rpm]: Standard 16°10°/675 (CVT model) 16°10°/650 (MT model)

### 5. Intake Manifold Vacuum A: INSPECTION

1) Warm up the engine.
2) Disconnect the brake booster vacuum hose from the intake manifold.

![](images/ddf56c4798229b658614099f06f3c1e126ffc189723491e84ca7348dce4fc6f7.jpg)

3) Connect the vacuum gauge to the intake manifold.

![](images/75eb22e9b70fbd2d060c0cb1bce707536430eb700a5928ce7328f682e5460bb6.jpg)

4) Keep the engine at idle speed and read the vacuum gauge indication.

NOTE:

Condition of engine inside can be diagnosed by observing the behavior of the vacuum gauge needle as described in table below.

Intake manifold vacuum (at idling, A/C OFF): Standard –60.0 kPa (–450 mmHg, –17.72 inHg) or more
![](images/76af0bf913e4f583d8887f5c2f5b0daef56bb39345e81bab7588f6e335f1c2a1.jpg)

5) After inspection, install the related parts in the reverse order of removal.

### 6. Engine Oil Pressure A: INSPECTION

1) Disconnect the ground cable from battery.
2) Remove the oil pressure switch. <Ref. to LU(H4DO)-42, REMOVAL, Oil Pressure Switch.>
3) Install the oil pressure gauge to the chain cover.
4) Connect the battery ground terminal.
5) Start the engine, and check the oil pressure.

![](images/6758f47a72487ddaa5994008f0c93e1a02f87aa0f67ff4570a1030910eec7eb6.jpg)

NOTE:

• Standard value is based on an engine oil temperature of 80°C (176°F).
• If the oil pressure is out of specification, check oil pump, oil filter and lubrication line. <Ref. to LU(H4DO)- 105, INSPECTION, Engine Lubrication System Trouble in General.>
• If the oil pressure warning light is ON and oil pressure is within standard, check the oil pressure switch. <Ref. to LU(H4DO)-105, INSPECTION, Engine Lubrication System Trouble in General.>

Engine oil pressure: Standard 50 kPa (0.5 kgf/cm2, 7 psi) or more (at 600 rpm) 350 kPa (3.6 kgf/cm2, 51 psi) or more (at 6,000 rpm)

6) After inspection, install the related parts in the reverse order of removal.

### 7. Fuel Pressure

A: INSPECTION

CAUTION:

Be careful not to spill fuel.
Catch the fuel from the tubes using a container or cloth.
1) Release the fuel pressure. <Ref. to FU(H4DO)-106, RELEASING OF FUEL PRESSURE, PROCEDURE, Fuel.>
2) Open the fuel filler lid and remove the fuel filler cap.
3) Disconnect the fuel delivery tube from the fuel delivery pipe, and connect the fuel pressure gauge. (1) Disconnect the quick connector on the fuel delivery tube from the fuel pipe assembly, and remove the clip (A) securing the fuel delivery tube to the fuel pipe assembly.

NOTE: Disconnect the quick connector as shown in the figure.

![](images/ef67b73003541cc730d1113df20e2a54d08c98e9ae278e13c3202e323208de96.jpg)

(a) Slider

![](images/9a847414ec3668c71fdf33a7349bfc708fb3b8856567ad1e1e0b4188991cc5b3.jpg)
ME(H4DO)-31

(2) Connect the fuel pressure gauge with ST1 and ST2.

CAUTION:

Check that there is no damage or dust on the quick connector. If necessary, clean the seal surface of the ST2. • Make sure that the quick connector is securely connected.

NOTE:

ST1 is a SUBARU genuine part.
When connecting the ST2 to the quick connector on the fuel delivery tube, connect as shown in the figure.

![](images/4653277c6d3770a814d7f60daf0bc6ae3fd7f44e7314bc058dc9ae501171d315.jpg)

(a) Slider

4) Start the engine.

### Fuel Pressure

5) Check the fuel pressure after warming up the engine.

NOTE:

• The fuel pressure gauge registers 10 to 20 kPa (0.1 to 0.2 kgf/cm2, 1 to 3 psi) higher than standard values during high-altitude operations. Check or replace the fuel pump and fuel delivery line if the fuel pressure is out of the standard.

Fuel pressure: Standard 340 — 400 kPa (3.5 — 4.1 kgf/cm2, 49 — 58 psi)

6) After inspection, install the related parts in the reverse order of removal.

> ⚠️ **Внимание:** 
> • Before removing the fuel pressure gauge, release the fuel pressure. Be careful not to spill fuel.
> • Catch the fuel from hoses and tubes using a container or cloth.
> • Check that there is no damage or dust on the quick connector. If necessary, clean the seal surface
> of the pipe.
> • When connecting the quick connector with slider, make sure to insert the pipe all the way in before
> locking the slider. When it is difficult to lock the slider, check that the pipe is fully inserted. Make sure that the quick connector is securely connected.
>
> NOTE:
>
> • When disconnecting the ST1, install the ST2 to the fuel pipe assembly, and press the ST2 in the direction of arrow to disconnect the quick connector on the ST1.

### 1. WHEN TIMING CHAIN ASSEMBLY IS NOT REMOVED

CAUTION:

When working on the vehicle, if engine oil is spilt onto the exhaust pipe, wipe it off with cloth to avoid emission of smoke or causing a fire.

NOTE:

• Inspection of cam clearance should be performed while engine is cold.
• If the engine is removed from vehicle, performing the step 1) is not necessary.
1) Disconnect the ground cable from battery.
2) Remove the V-belts. <Ref. to ME(H4DO)-83, V-BELT, REMOVAL, V-belt.>
3) When inspecting #1 and #3 cylinders (1) Remove the rocker cover RH. <Ref. to ME(H4DO)-147, ROCKER COVER RH, REMOVAL, Rocker Cover.>
NOTE:
When working on the vehicle, place a suitable container under the vehicle. (2) Set #1 cylinder piston to top dead center of compression stroke by rotating the crank pulley clockwise using the socket wrench.

> ℹ️ **Примечание:** 
> When the timing mark (A) on crank pulley is aligned to the 0° in timing gauge (B) on chain cover as shown in the figure, the #1 cylinder piston is located at TDC of compression stroke if the intake camshaft and exhaust camshaft does not depress the #1 cylinder intake side roller rocker arm (intake valve) and exhaust side roller rocker arm (exhaust valve). If roller rocker arm (valve) is depressed, turn the crank pulley by 360° in order to make #1 cylinder piston at TDC of compression stroke.
>
> ![](images/7a91c11ee219078c46e9b7dd9d734dc24083cb8580c3c79f876d8909c4689393.jpg)
>
> (3) Check the cam clearance for #1 cylinder intake, #1 cylinder exhaust and #3 cylinder exhaust. NOTE:
>
> Measure the roller surface of cam base circle and roller rocker arm using thickness gauge (A).
>
> If the measured value is out of standard, take notes of the value in order to adjust the cam clearance later on.
>
> Cam clearance: Intake Standard 0.13+0.02 –0.03 mm (0.0051+0.0008 –0.0012 in) Exhaust Standard 0.220.02 mm (0.00870.0008 in)
>
> ![](images/605655cb743ac12660da3c8c22099c2675065d3463ee4539575a25b268f46f58.jpg)
>
> (4) Turn the crank pulley by 360°.
>
> ![](images/4698f68dc20176585d179593519a0386c4918beb7b07abe2a309ce530774e520.jpg)

### Cam Clearance

(5) Check the clearance of #3 cylinder intake.

NOTE: Measure the roller surface of cam base circle and roller rocker arm using thickness gauge (A). If the measured value is out of standard, take notes of the value in order to adjust the cam clearance later
on.

Cam clearance: Standard 0.13+0.02 –0.03 mm (0.0051+0.0008 –0.0012 in)

![](images/266fd9e8d03de56bc2a6a70a98941a1cf9f775b3ccfc0c73aea2580aef991d7b.jpg)

4) When inspecting #2 and #4 cylinders

(1) Remove the rocker cover LH. <Ref. to ME(H4DO)-150, ROCKER COVER LH, REMOVAL, Rocker Cover.>

NOTE:

When working on the vehicle, place a suitable container under the vehicle. (2) Set #2 cylinder piston to top dead center of compression stroke by rotating the crank pulley clockwise using the socket wrench.

> ℹ️ **Примечание:** 
> When the timing mark (A) on crank pulley is aligned to the 0° in timing gauge (B) on chain cover as shown in the figure, the #2 cylinder piston is located at TDC of compression stroke if the intake camshaft and exhaust camshaft does not depress the #2 cylinder intake side roller rocker arm (intake valve) and exhaust side roller rocker arm (exhaust valve). If roller rocker arm (valve) is depressed, turn the crank pulley by 360° in order to make #2 cylinder piston at TDC of compression stroke.
>
> ![](images/66b53e31d1d8c5e1836d0d7d9608271e1a9f82065eb12474502f850c9dac61fd.jpg)
>
> (3) Check the cam clearance for #2 cylinder intake, #2 cylinder exhaust and #4 cylinder exhaust. NOTE: • Measure the roller surface of cam base circle and roller rocker arm using thickness gauge (A). • If the measured value is out of standard, take notes of the value in order to adjust the cam clearance later on.
>
> Cam clearance: Intake Standard 0.13+0.02 –0.03 mm (0.0051+0.0008 –0.0012 in) Exhaust Standard 0.220.02 mm (0.00870.0008 in)
>
> ![](images/2d0100b0ab9356e9e9c8b18df4329669e2743ae687ff09a3c3ac33a84efdc7c7.jpg)
>
> (4) Turn the crank pulley by 360°.
>
> ![](images/cf2d4f93e8c5f9ff15890b25ac296cc34302dd8212d45304e3f62c55ee5ed9d0.jpg)
>
> (5) Check the clearance of #4 cylinder intake.
>
> NOTE:
>
> Measure the roller surface of cam base circle and roller rocker arm using thickness gauge (A).
>
> If the measured value is out of standard, take notes of the value in order to adjust the cam clearance later on.
>
> Cam clearance: Standard 0.13+0.02 –0.03 mm (0.0051+0.0008 –0.0012 in)
>
> ![](images/7c0aafb5f4583668552565a2ec7ec36c259049bd8475848122b546273566b594.jpg)
>
> 5) If necessary, adjust the cam clearance. <Ref. to ME(H4DO)-43, ADJUSTMENT, Cam Clearance.>
> 6) After inspection, install the related parts in the reverse order of removal.

### 2. WHEN TIMING CHAIN ASSEMBLY IS REMOVED

NOTE: Inspection of cam clearance should be performed while engine is cold.

1) When inspecting #1 and #3 cylinders

(1) Remove the rocker cover RH. <Ref. to ME(H4DO)-147, ROCKER COVER RH, REMOVAL, Rocker Cover.>

NOTE:

When working on the vehicle, place a suitable container under the vehicle. (2) Check the #1 and #3 cylinder cam clearance.

> ⚠️ **Внимание:** 
> Intake and exhaust camshafts can be independently rotated with the timing chain removed. When the intake valve and exhaust valve lift at the same time, the valve heads contact each other and valve stem may bend. Do not turn 1 to the outside of range of zero lift (cam base circle position) (in range where it can be turned lightly by hand).
>
> NOTE:
>
> • For cam clearance inspection, adjust the cam base circle position so that the thickness gauge (A) can be inserted easily by hand turning the camshaft (cam sprocket) to be measured. Measure the roller surface of cam base circle and roller rocker arm using thickness gauge (A).
>
> If the measured value is out of standard, take notes of the value in order to adjust the cam clearance later on.
>
> Cam clearance: Intake Standard 0.13+0.02 –0.03 mm (0.0051+0.0008 –0.0012 in) Exhaust Standard 0.220.02 mm (0.00870.0008 in)
>
> ![](images/def97c6b01eda37462f1547fc9cf791d8c85b43f8ff9c00c069476a1f2eb477c.jpg)
>
> 2) When inspecting #2 and #4 cylinders
>
> (1) Remove the rocker cover LH. <Ref. to ME(H4DO)-150, ROCKER COVER LH, REMOVAL, Rocker Cover.>
>
> NOTE:
>
> When working on the vehicle, place a suitable container under the vehicle. (2) Check the #2 and #4 cylinder cam clearance.

> ⚠️ **Внимание:** 
> Intake and exhaust camshafts can be independently rotated with the timing chain removed. When the intake valve and exhaust valve lift at the same time, the valve heads contact each other and valve stem may bend. Do not turn it to the outside of range of zero lift (cam base circle position) (in range where it can be turned lightly by hand).
>
> NOTE:
>
> • For cam clearance inspection, adjust the cam base circle position so that the thickness gauge (A) can be inserted easily by hand turning the camshaft (cam sprocket) to be measured.
>
> Measure the roller surface of cam base circle and roller rocker arm using thickness gauge (A).
>
> If the measured value is out of standard, take notes of the value in order to adjust the cam clearance later on.
>
> Cam clearance: Intake Standard 0.13+0.02 –0.03 mm (0.0051+0.0008 –0.0012 in) Exhaust Standard 0.220.02 mm (0.00870.0008 in)
>
> ![](images/d249f4ef3e07e8f58e1e2ed43b606ade479fc003752640fd7d8a6f2079f3fad2.jpg)
>
> 3) If necessary, adjust the cam clearance. <Ref. to ME(H4DO)-43, ADJUSTMENT, Cam Clearance.>
> 4) After inspection, install the related parts in the reverse order of removal.

### B: ADJUSTMENT

1) Remove the engine from the vehicle. <Ref. to ME(H4DO)-46, REMOVAL, Engine Assembly.>
2) Remove the chain cover. <Ref. to ME(H4DO)-100, REMOVAL, Chain Cover.>
3) When adjusting #1 and #3 cylinders (1) Remove the timing chain RH. <Ref. to ME(H4DO)-117, TIMING CHAIN RH, REMOVAL, Timing Chain Assembly.> (2) Remove the cam carrier RH. <Ref. to ME(H4DO)-161, CAM CARRIER RH, REMOVAL, Cam Carrier.> (3) Measure the thickness of valve shim using micrometer.

NOTE: Measurement should be performed at a temperature of 20°C (68°F).

![](images/cc7852cc7d3acbb2b1b215104a2929955b55eaf2792191ea41190058113ca827.jpg)

(4) Select a valve shim of suitable thickness using the measured cam clearance and valve shim thickness.

NOTE: Use a new valve shim.

![](images/873ee45d761e2ac098e4b904958f7eb9cfb60a2646c008e4e5ed5f2a5593939d.jpg)

(5) Install the cam carrier RH. <Ref. to ME(H4DO)-172, CAM CARRIER RH, INSTALLATION, Cam Carrier.>

(6) Check all the cam clearance of RH side at this time. If the cam clearance is not within the standard value, repeat the procedure over again from step 2).

NOTE:

When the removing/installing of cam carrier RH has been performed, cam clearance may be outside the standard value. Checking of all cam clearance of RH side is necessary. Refer to INSPECTION of “Cam Clearance” for the cam clearance inspection. <Ref. to ME(H4DO)-41, WHEN TIMING CHAIN ASSEMBLY IS REMOVED, INSPECTION, Cam Clearance.>

Cam clearance: Intake Standard 0.13+0.02 –0.03 mm (0.0051+0.0008 –0.0012 in) Exhaust Standard 0.220.02 mm (0.00870.0008 in)

4) When adjusting #2 and #4 cylinders

(1) Remove the timing chain LH. <Ref. to ME(H4DO)-119, TIMING CHAIN LH, REMOVAL, Timing Chain Assembly.>
(2) Remove the cam carrier LH. <Ref. to ME(H4DO)-166, CAM CARRIER LH, REMOVAL, Cam Carrier.> (3) Measure the thickness of valve shim using micrometer.

NOTE: Measurement should be performed at a temperature of 20°C (68°F).

![](images/cc59f83c7c9bf347cc09107719691a808725aa14747a1206a9e67bdabfce4c5d.jpg)

(4) Select a valve shim of suitable thickness using the measured cam clearance and valve shim thickness.

NOTE: Use a new valve shim.

![](images/a1473cdae445232ce9fe45b779688c560176e57630da18f66229b1df57108986.jpg)

(5) Install the cam carrier LH. <Ref. to ME(H4DO)-183, CAM CARRIER LH, INSTALLATION, Cam Carrier.>

### Cam Clearance

(6) Check all the cam clearance of LH side at this time. If the cam clearance is not within the standard value, repeat the procedure over again from step 2).

> ℹ️ **Примечание:** 
> When the removing/installing of cam carrier LH has been performed, cam clearance may be outside the standard value. Checking of all cam clearance of LH side is necessary. Refer to INSPECTION of “Cam Clearance” for the cam clearance inspection. <Ref. to ME(H4DO)-41, WHEN TIMING CHAIN ASSEMBLY IS REMOVED, INSPECTION, Cam Clearance.>
>
> Cam clearance: Intake Standard 0.13+0.02 –0.03 mm (0.0051+0.0008 –0.0012 in) Exhaust Standard 0.220.02 mm (0.00870.0008 in)
> 5) After adjustment, install the related parts in the reverse order of removal.

### A: REMOVAL

1) Open the front hood, and remove the upper grille bracket from the front hood.

![](images/1451851c745d5d4f857cc2533808a47b578376e67e995ef912cc255ebbba456b.jpg)

2) Using a marker pen, make alignment marks (A) on both the front hood and the front hood striker.

![](images/da8ba4ba0c9dfc2074ab2f8c28f17b133c0812b078533426a28bb4bd4993e6b3.jpg)

3) Remove the front hood striker from the front hood.

![](images/114bd6b81b3335be1aee289449409e664752c7d91e0e34d1a720e954eb7f9a52.jpg)

4) Remove the front center grille assembly from the front hood.

![](images/0f278bc179733d44cdb5bf22ba256b56b730c56fe55498b11bc7cf3e3e73835a.jpg)

5) Change the front hood damper mounting position from (A) to (B), and completely open the front hood.

Tightening torque: 20 N·m (2.0 kgf-m, 14.8 ft-lb)

![](images/af21eea44401ec3d34e4e1b66d6732179362c6047b3c319a951f38d5983f4fc3.jpg)

6) Remove the V-belt covers.

![](images/8fe0dd0c58c04b4f82e528a157e87476a247d1fb72434ad7b3c41e7197125e8b.jpg)

7) Collect the refrigerant from A/C system. <Ref. to AC-26, Refrigerant Recovery Procedure.>
8) Release the fuel pressure. <Ref. to FU(H4DO)-106, RELEASING OF FUEL PRESSURE, PROCEDURE,
Fuel.>
9) Disconnect the ground cable from battery.
10) Remove the air intake duct. <Ref. to IN(H4DO)-12, REMOVAL, Air Intake Duct.>
11) Remove the air intake boot. <Ref. to IN(H4DO)-11, REMOVAL, Air Intake Boot.>

12) Disconnect the connector (A) from the mass air flow and intake air temperature sensor, and remove the clip (B) which holds the mass air flow and intake air temperature sensor harness.

![](images/79d354f0e98ef5e99459dd9269e8b1820da0042ae4c219381896d5be971555be.jpg)

13) Remove the air cleaner case (rear).

![](images/956a2aecc2aa1883b33bf592e51001831dd53bbb5f35f4fc7ea44f92995c6991.jpg)

14) Remove the radiator. <Ref. to CO(H4DO)-50, REMOVAL, Radiator.>

15) Disconnect the brake booster vacuum hose from the intake manifold.

![](images/3aa704ef4d84e5f1eb59b49470d5dc2ccfa8b580780497099878ce84dd6b824a.jpg)

16) Disconnect the engine harness connector. (1) Remove the bolt securing the bulkhead harness connector bracket.

![](images/c78d35402134401679222440cc13946da809263efb2eaec79cc03b6b1fa9e1d6.jpg)

(2) Disconnect the bulkhead harness connector from the engine harness connector (black) and engine harness connector (brown).

![](images/439acf93dfd64421933e6af956b160afffd85d4ca292c13807f57f4894060b59.jpg)

17) Remove the bolt which secures the generator cord stay A to the chain cover.

![](images/99659e50ab9a157d83e9c6611cbb8f6a800c3762d2f7065cd2fc0e4818552e16.jpg)

18) Disconnect connector (A) and terminal (B) from the generator, and disconnect connector (C) from A/C compressor. 19) Remove the bolt (E) securing the generator cord stay B to the generator bracket.

20) Remove the generator cord from the clip (D) and move the generator cord to the left side wheel apron.

![](images/a0cbe17d8849d83440a2b47ba0b1adfbfdf39d74b17fdc8f70198992145a2d55.jpg)

21) Disconnect the following hoses.

### A: REMOVAL

(1) A/C pressure hose <Ref. to AC-70, REMOVAL, Hose and Pipe.> (2) Heater inlet hose and heater outlet hose

![](images/344d1b04f1f08c30d2a4c09afb1df96e7076faabf2e29a6e2445255cccb8391b.jpg)

22) Disconnect the water hose from CVTF cooler (with warmer feature). (CVT model)

![](images/a169f0ae5f7d42937af5cef0e60a65fe4bd1bdf33a37b0aa402ee31bb60450cb.jpg)

23) Remove the bolt which secures the CVTF cooler (with warmer feature) to the transmission, and move the CVTF cooler (with warmer feature) to the right side of the transmission. (CVT model)

![](images/83a5ee9111a585da12fa0744aed37b01870db94dbc3f731f8e1e7bee6c75de30.jpg)

24) Lift up the vehicle.
25) Remove the front exhaust pipe. <Ref. to EX(H4DO)-6, REMOVAL, Front Exhaust Pipe.>
26) Remove the under cover front - transmission.

### ME(H4DO)-53

27) Disconnect the ground cable on the engine side.

![](images/5e8998ce24d0fc30557aa4e84ee284d47b58e3edf8fd0a006d601bd6f1348ec8.jpg)

28) Remove the bolts and nuts which hold the lower side of transmission to the engine. • CVT model

![](images/0f9d01191947f3227258e1964b4e11166fb565798922fb4687af017f0b0409ee.jpg)

MT model

![](images/4eedebbe062d2988ed46e0797e519067280e4fdfce4ba2eb09756d8da17c88ee.jpg)

29) Remove the nuts which secure the engine mounting to the front crossmember. (Hydraulic engine mounting model)

![](images/8fed0d29f0350be015ec9a95b1bfd9a43050422b0ab5309b753e34062688410d.jpg)

30) Remove the nuts which secure the engine mounting to the front crossmember. (Solid engine mounting model)

![](images/90c318abc96680e7ad7a0072630aea0cab73a0b1c0e3abb6d94beb349b2abf10.jpg)

31) Lower the vehicle.

32) Separate the torque converter clutch from the drive plate. (CVT model)

(1) Remove the service hole plug.
(2) Insert the wrench into the crank pulley bolt and rotate the crank pulley to remove the bolts which hold torque converter clutch to drive plate.

![](images/20eb742474af8f51725dd5ea80bf9ed711a8a8b1363e46fc74e4c2b7e8d6dc48.jpg)

33) Disconnect the bulkhead harness connector from the transmission harness connector (A) and the inhibitor harness connector (B), and disconnect the transmission radio ground terminal (C) from the vehicle body. (CVT model)

![](images/d4a58c3399601d1b57d7d4d1849824b23c99fe4c1381334563cba99cef9cedc3.jpg)

34) Remove the pitching stopper.

![](images/137e4981796d6b9f2c56dc3dbc7f3ff5f191879de50f6ca0f305085947d89eb5.jpg)

35) Remove the transmission case cover. (CVT model)

![](images/44391369d625d5dc4406675f3eb08dfd99133060583496cea54c394a46e423da.jpg)

36) Remove the transmission harness stay and move to the engine side. (CVT model)

![](images/063d4901cc8c2beb661b714e29fb76ce76bfc129d8a835daa9800848202c2d87.jpg)

37) Remove the bolt which holds the transmission harness to the control valve body, and turn the transmission harness clockwise till the bolt hole can be seen as shown in the figure, and tighten the bolt to temporary lock the harness. (CVT model)

> ℹ️ **Примечание:** 
> This procedure is required to prevent the transmission harness from touching the vehicle body during engine removal/installation.
>
> ![](images/98fe7d0763f1d8d8d7b42dd9db1ddd1951774a073a4fa5c21f53c755f1cbb98d.jpg)
>
> 38) Disconnect the fuel delivery tube and evaporation hose.

> ⚠️ **Внимание:** 
> Be careful not to spill fuel.
> Catch the fuel from the tubes using a container or cloth.
> (1) Disconnect the quick connector on the fuel delivery tube from the fuel pipe assembly, and remove the clip (A) securing the fuel delivery tube.
>
> NOTE: Disconnect the quick connector as shown in the figure.
>
> ![](images/e8fe590accc0dc16b94bfb10f06eaa36031043d14019d630ed55ac5627305d3d.jpg)
>
> (a) Slider
>
> ![](images/59c99e1907b9715b4fef4720a16bc4b15c819ec742c0c53a284401e077aa5bb6.jpg)
>
> (2) Disconnect the evaporation hose from the fuel pipe assembly.
>
> ![](images/ddcd7ffa7050cfc4202389500fc0273663d4aed5c9ba6df8683c9dcd96612805.jpg)
>
> 39) Support the engine with a lifting device and wire ropes.
>
> ![](images/fdf018bbe3b1f82af9ed5d03fc3f8b2c178ce92e3814909af9e01db972854446.jpg)
>
> 40) Support the transmission with a garage jack.
>
> CAUTION: Be sure to perform this procedure to prevent the transmission from lowering by its own weight.
>
> ![](images/f84762fb2e16c508ee3b3af8ea099a06830b3c3340d393f0245b5095f8be32c4.jpg)
>
> (A) Transmission (B) Garage jack
>
> 41) Separate the engine and transmission.

> ⚠️ **Внимание:** 
> Before removing the engine away from transmission, check to be sure no work has been overlooked. (1) Remove the starter. <Ref. to SC(H4DO)-8, REMOVAL, Starter.> (2) Attach the ST to the torque converter clutch case. (CVT model)
> ST 498277200 STOPPER SET
>
> ![](images/d849228e82e7da16785fc8910ddf5daf635a46ef1a019c511eaf20c29358e4b3.jpg)
>
> (3) Remove the bolts which hold the upper side of the transmission to the engine. CVT model
>
> ![](images/efb02a605b2d0232e6e98a1f04377a17cfc9b6523a14c92299dea027c54cfc12.jpg)
>
> ME-05858
>
> MT model
>
> ![](images/8eb0237815a02703d78f5aa654cce72b217f894fd7c06262a49cd835f0d82085.jpg)
>
> 42) Remove the engine from the vehicle.
>
> NOTE:
>
> e careful not to damage adjacent parts or body panels with crank pulley, oil level gauge, etc.
>
> (1) Slightly raise the engine.
> (2) Raise the transmission with garage jack.
> (3) Move the engine horizontally until main shaft is withdrawn from clutch cover. (MT model) (4) Slowly move the engine away from engine compartment.
>
> 43) Remove the engine mounting from the engine.

### B: INSTALLATION

1) Install the engine mounting onto the engine.

Tightening torque: 35 N·m (3.6 kgf-m, 25.8 ft-lb)
2) Apply a small amount of grease to splines of main shaft. (MT model)

Grease: NICHIMOLY N-130 or equivalent

3) Position the engine in engine compartment and align it with transmission.

NOTE:
Be careful not to damage adjacent parts or body panels with crank pulley, oil level gauge, etc. 4) Install the bolts which hold upper side of transmission to engine.

Tightening torque: 50 N·m (5.1 kgf-m, 36.9 ft-lb)

CVT model

![](images/9e153915b1087b42ca4627ffba4471bb4f26e5e61a2fb988bcd208f812126d49.jpg)

ME-05858

MT model

![](images/39dbb90b1f36cdb9315854836849968c4c93d1765dc4b84a16fa0d9ff029ab94.jpg)

ME-05109

5) Remove the lifting device and wire ropes.

![](images/85f9fd97cd8b10616a7dda98dbc0296599608b533c05d6bd88af793f106c7f98.jpg)

6) Remove the garage jack.
7) Remove the bolt and turn the transmission harness counterclockwise to install the transmission harness to the control valve body. (CVT model)

Tightening torque: 7 N·m (0.7 kgf-m, 5.2 ft-lb)

![](images/813e36a7a2802925101ffb23651e180c0a0f33599a7823311cecdea8b91d0e32.jpg)

8) Install the transmission harness stay. (CVT model)

Tightening torque: 7 N·m (0.7 kgf-m, 5.2 ft-lb)

![](images/4d7e9d7e5d8a9eb6ae411be8bdb1e088cd54f179bfea7bbb1bffc030f1eb0c3b.jpg)

9) Install the transmission case cover. (CVT model)

Tightening torque: 8 N·m (0.8 kgf-m, 5.9 ft-lb)
