### 9. Transfer Clutch Pressure Test A: INSPECTION

1) Lift up the vehicle.
2) Remove the under cover front transmission.
3) Remove the rear exhaust pipe from center exhaust pipe.
4) Remove the center exhaust cover.
5) Set the transmission jack under the transmission.
6) Remove the mounting bolt of rear crossmember.
7) Lower the rear side of transmission until the transfer clutch pressure test plug can be removed.
8) Remove the transfer clutch pressure test plug.

![](images/6e09b0ba72a8597be388f67491e5971d726d5ed6b864bef1813f41ba3a7835b8.jpg)

![](images/2f05328bfdda6ded9882cc4700a2e6450b9a396b3c1ea10c780dbc6c7856749e.jpg)

9) Set the ST1, ST2, ST3 and ST4 to the transmission.

NOTE:

• Use ST1 ADAPTER HOSE B with genuine union screw (part No. 801914010) and gasket (part No. 803914060) attached.
• Use ST3 PRESSURE GAUGE ADAPTER with genuine O-ring (part No. 806911080) attached. ST1 34099AC020 ADAPTER HOSE B
ST2 34099AC010 ADAPTER HOSE A
ST3 18681AA000 PRESSURE GAUGE ADAPTER
ST4 498575400 OIL PRESSURE GAUGE ASSY

![](images/ae8ffc0f409c629df7c68c317b1b1bbd2108734aa0366ea7835d376e7f21029f.jpg)

(A) Gasket (genuine part) (B) Union screw (genuine part)

![](images/0a54563a8bb6d22435bed0f103e2e2c40641639b95f90a222fa2d506c0503cf9.jpg)

(A) O-ring (genuine part)

10) Raise the transmission, and install the rear crossmember.

Tightening torque: 70 N·m (7.1 kgf-m, 51.6 ft-lb)

![](images/6df87405e68a1ba6eba572adac95f6e1d675967bca19dd38f4d8859b85d42f5d.jpg)

11) Install the rear exhaust pipe to center exhaust pipe.

Tightening torque: 18 N·m (1.8 kgf-m, 13.3 ft-lb)

![](images/c167f2224c2b3fa9cd419ea306b86be42a4df954a53b3accd8ec3002aebc7a2a.jpg)

12) Lower the vehicle.
13) Connect the Subaru Select Monitor to the data link connector and read the current data.

### CVT(TR580)-53

14) Check the transfer clutch pressure as in secondary pressure (line pressure) test. <Ref. to CVT(TR580)-
48, Secondary Pressure (Line Pressure) Test.>

NOTE:

• For models with X mode switch, turn OFF the switch for inspection.
• Use Subaru Select Monitor for switching to FWD mode. <Ref. to CVT(TR580)-43, AWD ON/OFF Switching Mode.>
• If no oil pressure is produced, if it does not change in AWD mode or if oil pressure is produced in FWD mode, there may be a problem in the control valve body.

![](images/4cba09457a67c228a993497dcd3fbfcb8c5a2e75568cc6fdb02f21e4ba0c31b2.jpg)

15) Lift up the vehicle.
16) Remove the rear exhaust pipe from center exhaust pipe.

![](images/fa69119343b076c67da11164ae7049d93b21e30ba171d9f765301a5ebbbf1c1a.jpg)

17) Set the transmission jack under the transmission.

18) Remove the mounting bolt of rear crossmember.

![](images/39b5f3e7581aed4e89ab53c5bd23ad7d682f5f60172b1fa38f9333f037a952c3.jpg)

19) Lower the rear side of transmission until the ST can be removed.
20) Remove the ST and install the plug.

NOTE: Use new O-rings. Apply CVTF to the O-ring.

Tightening torque: 25 N·m (2.5 kgf-m, 18.4 ft-lb)
21) Raise the transmission, and install the rear crossmember.

Tightening torque: 70 N·m (7.1 kgf-m, 51.6 ft-lb)

![](images/6abcb313d218da32290324d12ff99853352ddb299d3c14798f8a8aa431dd4021.jpg)

22) Install the center exhaust cover.

Tightening torque: 18 N·m (1.8 kgf-m, 13.3 ft-lb)

23) Install the rear exhaust pipe to center exhaust pipe.

NOTE: Use a new gasket.

Tightening torque: 18 N·m (1.8 kgf-m, 13.3 ft-lb)

![](images/807e0912f8e55c4d25496bc21b2c48fb9d9ff98f0ece3d77e7c07b06cd87c669.jpg)

24) Install the under cover front transmission.

Tightening torque: 18 N·m (1.8 kgf-m, 13.3 ft-lb)

25) Lower the vehicle.

### A: REMOVAL

1) Disconnect the ground cable from battery.
2) Remove the clip (A) from the air intake boot.
3) Loosen the clamp (B) connecting the air intake boot and air cleaner case (rear).
4) Loosen the clamp (C) which connects the air intake boot and throttle body.

![](images/69582c5500e03e9c6f1a4626a6cb4b113f52cbcd1f5ced9365fff0f0bac29fc1.jpg)

5) Remove the air intake boot from the throttle body, and move the air intake boot to the left side wheel apron.

![](images/1cf032bac4420051eee121ab386c61bcc79a2b0dc7bfeaa136a8391957dc71de.jpg)

6) Disconnect the following connectors.

Transmission harness connectors Inhibitor harness connector Transmission radio ground terminal (A) Transmission harness connectors (B) Inhibitor harness connector (C) Transmission radio ground terminal

![](images/8e8f2b7260fe3d8d6462decdb9faba80a2e5ec248b3f980f0b380a89a4aac964.jpg)

7) Remove the starter. <Ref. to SC(H4DO)-8, REMOVAL, Starter.>
8) Remove the pitching stopper.

![](images/19f8aa7742d4ae529477a1999ad58cfddba9742bb66e25791128dae00992136c.jpg)

9) Remove the harness bracket, and then remove the engine harness connector.

![](images/6a43eeef623df691b145c9379e74b9bd20bb43ca523f229c0426de2886b57a11.jpg)

10) Disconnect the EGR control valve harness connector, throttle position sensor harness connector and manifold absolute pressure sensor harness connector.
11) Remove the engine hanger rear.

![](images/d98bc4543ee65c641cd8af1b031466c780f9e117db2878e5cafbea5f744f8847.jpg)

12) Remove the service hole plug.

![](images/b52c185d788436613d5b37f538c11368ca60850a918f5d8bd52ab927b80dd0a1.jpg)

13) Remove the four bolts combining the torque converter and drive plate while rotating the crank pulley a little at a time in the same direction as engine revolution.

> ⚠️ **Внимание:** 
> Be careful not to drop bolts into the converter housing.
> Be careful not to damage the mounting bolts.
>
> ![](images/23042cc6f1c36c85d4c53c405a86e86f530457ed3ca9d2fbf29c702c1aa1d003.jpg)
>
> 14) Make sure the torque converter moves freely by rotating with finger through the starter installation hole.
>
> 15) Attach the ST to the converter case. ST 498277200 STOPPER SET
>
> ![](images/138c587a977f9da9d8cc89a0614b1c044a2bc50b8c05b07ccc54b45508fc7317.jpg)
>
> 16) Remove the air breather hose from the pitching stopper bracket, and then remove the pitching stopper bracket and transmission radio ground cord.
>
> ![](images/38b00f8b4796f0198c4da71de38316b6be73fbf9984a2bf3c82f003067429812.jpg)
>
> 17) Remove the engine ground terminal.
>
> ![](images/135733c1ee35c20da27ff614ec3582f4c83b5e3284ef1b09c50fb98fd363bf50.jpg)
>
> 18) Remove the CVTF cooler (with warmer feature) from the transmission, and using a piece of wire, affix to a location of the body where it will not interfere with the removal of the transmission.
>
> ![](images/2ffb213ddba9968553b8638b3a2b3dce6f99a7cdb8af9b3ce57b02a7efb793a1.jpg)
>
> 19) Remove the CVTF inlet hose and outlet hose from the pipe.
>
> ![](images/b5c6d4807389dd3dfc7e81358f8894b3b18d434ecc8335dd81a963ae8be0be39.jpg)
>
> 20) Set the ST. ST1 41099AA010 ENGINE SUPPORT BRACKET ST2 41099AA020 ENGINE SUPPORT
>
> ![](images/c09ba4c02b02c5eadeace2b00e455ba8c192c92c85ff6f600a429e3c29014c34.jpg)
>
> 21) Remove the three transmission connecting bolts.
>
> ![](images/5551a4ceea53bd4b3e05b1f540e7f98ef97082e1ef949e6b605d5b6549ac2f89.jpg)
>
> 22) Lift up the vehicle.
> 23) Remove the front wheels. <Ref. to WT-5, REMOVAL, Tire and Wheel.>
> 24) Remove the under cover - front and the under cover front transmission.
> 25) Remove the center exhaust pipe. <Ref. to EX(H4DO)-18, REMOVAL, Rear Exhaust Pipe.>
> 26) Remove the center exhaust cover.
> 27) Remove the CVTF drain plug to drain CVTF. <Ref. to CVT(TR580)-36, REPLACEMENT, CVTF.>
> 28) Drain differential gear oil. <Ref. to CVT(TR580)-41, REPLACEMENT, Differential Gear Oil.>
>
> ![](images/62ca874e43b94c05c633c187bd7718fbfacc6a6cf094aa80a2b19de777a13faf.jpg)
>
> 29) Remove the snap pin and washer from shifter arm and remove the select cable from shifter arm.
>
> ![](images/4d732ed889ad4781fc6d3d21c77a7776a2dfdd293daa15933d9a519c7afa207a.jpg)
>
> (A) Shifter arm (B) Snap pin (C) Select cable (D) Washer
>
> 30) Remove the plate assembly from the transmission case.
>
> ![](images/d255b9cf91b84bfd6d571c300119816006c2e5142184b038632c153f1d05bdc4.jpg)
>
> (A) Select cable (B) Plate ASSY
>
> 31) Remove the propeller shaft. <Ref. to DS-11, REMOVAL, Propeller Shaft.>
>
> 32) Disconnect the stabilizer link from the front arm.
>
> ![](images/1d4add997bfe67f00881ae79997f11492598572241ae9f4346bef7bc97aa5027.jpg)
>
> 33) Remove the bolts which secure to the front housing, and separate the front arm and housing.
>
> ![](images/c318212a4df4def12264a02231a4c593aa0d41d19dd385cbd9a4484baa99a1c9.jpg)
>
> 34) Using a tire lever or a crow bar, etc., pull out until the front drive shaft transmission side joint slides mov smoothly.

> ⚠️ **Внимание:** 
> NOTE:
>
> Place cloth between the tire lever or bar and the transmission in order to avoid damaging the transmission side retainer.
> 35) Hold the transmission side joint of the front drive shaft by hand and extract the housing from the transmission while pressing the housing outward, so as not to stretch the boot.

> ℹ️ **Примечание:** 
> Before pulling RH front drive shaft from transmission, turn the steering wheel to left hand full lock.
> Before pulling LH front drive shaft from transmission, turn the steering wheel to right hand full lock.
>
> 36) Remove the two transmission connecting bolts and two nuts (lower side).
>
> ![](images/829faf025b7875f0a880efafb65ef96cc298a4f832569de200b2a775ff64dc01.jpg)
>
> AT-06598
>
> 37) Set the transmission jack under the transmission.
>
> NOTE:
>
> Make sure that the support plates of transmission jack do not touch the oil pan.
> 38) Remove the transmission rear crossmember from the vehicle. 39) While lowering the transmission jack gradually, fully retract the engine support, and then tilt the engine rearward.
> 40) Remove the transmission assembly.
>
> ![](images/baddeb09fbe4e04a21bebae58e1f7c00d1b3505ebea4a30d7f350c195f3d9b97.jpg)
>
> NOTE:
>
> Remove it while moving the transmission jack up and down so that the engine and transmission remain directly aligned.
>
> 41) Remove the rear cushion rubber.
>
> ![](images/38de4328f153677049ce3b4cb596eb5a5fd4cd04e3ba0306504e075b6bcca87b.jpg)

### B: INSTALLATION

1) Attach the ST to converter case. ST 498277200 STOPPER SET

![](images/f3def834bce03331620a6727435b9e8a61fd0f83b0e0b18d95be1420218e59ee.jpg)

2) When completely overhauling the transmission, refill CVTF through the transmission right side plug. <Ref. to CVT(TR580)-165, Preparation for Overhaul.>
3) Replace the front differential side retainer oil seal. <Ref. to CVT(TR580)-87, REPLACEMENT, Differential Side Retainer Oil Seal.>

NOTE:

• Be sure to replace the differential side retainer oil seal with a new part whenever the front drive shaft is removed from the transmission. When a new differential side retainer oil seal has been installed, replacement is not required.

4) Install the rear cushion rubber on the transmission.

Tightening torque: 40 N·m (4.1 kgf-m, 29.5 ft-lb)

![](images/57da5c380b68e21e533f23f69d6241bd1cd13e45aef6a49c087a83479e9313b7.jpg)

5) Mount the transmission onto the transmission jack.
6) Strike and bend the transmission hanger of transmission rear with a rubber hammer etc. so that it gets in contact with the transmission case.

CAUTION: Do not apply extra overload or impact to the transmission case.

![](images/7c11c67251a071921446160016556270def7276a93a62745440ebcf8f212a34a.jpg)

7) Remove the pitching stopper bracket, if mounted.
8) Install the transmission onto the engine.

> ℹ️ **Примечание:** 
> While raising the transmission jack gradually, turn the screw of engine support, then tilt the engine forward Temporarily attach the two engine connecting bolts and two nuts (lower side).
>
> 9) Install the transmission rear crossmember.
>
> Tightening torque: T1: 35 N·m (3.6 kgf-m, 25.8 ft-lb) T2: 70 N·m (7.1 kgf-m, 51.6 ft-lb)
>
> ![](images/7c36c190e29e45097971f3f5cfdd5c28482de8f9f48702ed69048703ebf811e1.jpg)
>
> 10) Tighten the two engine connecting bolts and two nuts (lower side).
>
> Tightening torque: 50 N·m (5.1 kgf-m, 36.9 ft-lb)
>
> ![](images/ed46a249f9929aaed76528c966875db339db40eca55026bd0ddc41ae5a2966e2.jpg)
>
> AT-06598
>
> 11) Remove the transmission jack.
> 12) Lower the vehicle.
>
> 13) Install the three engine mounting bolts (upper side).
>
> Tightening torque: 50 N·m (5.1 kgf-m, 36.9 ft-lb)
>
> ![](images/47532b898b1bd65d7fd83d1d009508f37f2b52146310c47a3b0d3928530bdca2.jpg)
>
> 14) Remove the ST (STOPPER SET) from converter case.
> 15) Remove the ST (ENGINE SUPPORT BRACKET and ENGINE SUPPORT). ST1 41099AA010 ENGINE SUPPORT BRACKET
> ST2 41099AA020 ENGINE SUPPORT
>
> ![](images/28d6af6573c3cd8e8b0e76638ec00253c8b2e6e8cfa6ea70cea58cf4c4e61c42.jpg)
>
> 16) Match the torque converter screw hole with drive plate hole to install the bolt.

> ⚠️ **Внимание:** 
> Do not drop the mounting bolt in the converter housing.
> Do not damage the mounting bolt.
>
> Tightening torque: 25 N·m (2.5 kgf-m, 18.4 ft-lb)
>
> 17) Install the remaining three bolts by rotating the crank pulley a little at a time in the same direction as engine revolution.
>
> Tightening torque: 25 N·m (2.5 kgf-m, 18.4 ft-lb)
>
> 18) Install the service hole plug.
>
> ![](images/cbcd419a9adb254ba125b5ff9478048bef9218bd664dc8862281c14c7334747f.jpg)
>
> 19) Install the engine ground terminals.
>
> Tightening torque: 19 N·m (1.9 kgf-m, 14.0 ft-lb)
>
> ![](images/8a24c334ddc153dd73cbe77ea0115df042a65bc5a9e55acac8f92672ac3ed0dc.jpg)
>
> 20) Replace the CVTF inlet hose and CVTF outlet hose. <Ref. to CVT(TR580)-154, DISASSEMBLY, CVTF Cooler (With Warmer Function).>
>
> 21) Install the CVTF inlet hose and CVTF outlet hose to transmission.
>
> ![](images/0dc43435816a526087ebe6dac02f6d3baa80addb6cfb866afc0c4a1c3c3a9d81.jpg)
>
> 22) Install the CVTF cooler (with warmer feature) to the transmission.
>
> Tightening torque: 23 N·m (2.3 kgf-m, 17.0 ft-lb)
>
> ![](images/f0856db8b3c3d2da34c5f6feb2ae13828adfcf498dcc8b4a68f37c646c8fab9f.jpg)
>
> 23) Install the starter. <Ref. to SC(H4DO)-12, INSTALLATION, Starter.>
>
> 24) Install the engine hanger rear.
>
> Tightening torque: 21 N·m (2.1 kgf-m, 15.5 ft-lb)
>
> ![](images/de04611d4e05903a5096526fde53efb0586f1518f05d664ff4b1c47c6b9aa38c.jpg)
>
> 25) Install the pitching stopper bracket and transmission radio ground cord.
>
> Tightening torque: 41 N·m (4.2 kgf-m, 30.2 ft-lb)
>
> ![](images/0b1c5fcbb4cc42b9fcac1c88d3c4717228a88a06dbcd06b8239cf0d7b42e0573.jpg)
>
> 26) Install the air breather hose to the pitching stopper bracket.
>
> 27) Install the pitching stopper.
>
> Tightening torque: T1: 50 N·m (5.1 kgf-m, 36.9 ft-lb) T2: 58 N·m (5.9 kgf-m, 42.8 ft-lb)
>
> ![](images/f03734b04502d56c3e812fc534f024e12e6f365efe0034c32953366905942967.jpg)
>
> 28) Connect the EGR control valve harness connector, throttle position sensor harness connector and manifold absolute pressure sensor harness connector. 29) Connect the engine harness connectors, then install the harness connector bracket.
>
> Tightening torque: 7.5 N·m (0.8 kgf-m, 5.5 ft-lb)
>
> 30) Lift up the vehicle. 31) Apply grease to the side retainer oil seal lip. 32) Set the ST to side retainer. ST 28399SA010 OIL SEAL PROTECTOR
>
> ![](images/6e69e659d21815754634e6847da12371236a27121a0fb379aa87af6c753b735f.jpg)
>
> 33) Replace the circlip of the drive shaft with a new part.
>
> 34) Insert the front drive shaft spline section into transmission and remove the ST (OIL SEAL PROTECTOR). NOTE:
>
> Before inserting RH front drive shaft into transmission, turn the steering wheel to left hand full lock. Before inserting LH front drive shaft into transmission, turn the steering wheel to right hand full lock. 35) Insert the drive shaft into the transmission securely by pressing the housing from outside of the vehicle. 36) Insert the ball joint into housing and secure with bolt.
>
> Tightening torque: 50 N·m (5.1 kgf-m, 36.9 ft-lb)
>
> CAUTION:
>
> Do not apply grease to the tapered portion of ball stud.

> ⚠️ **Внимание:** 
> • Before tightening, make sure the lower side of housing and stepped section of ball joint are in contact.
>
> ![](images/b9a12aae96842814bb6f95a99f94eb7dd5bd6c35f8ac4e5ac28236d1225b3455.jpg)
>
> 37) Attach the stabilizer link to the front arm.
>
> Tightening torque: 60 N·m (6.1 kgf-m, 44.3 ft-lb)
>
> ![](images/1446f9779940534e5c752e2a7e5a85d9b1ac402f8316087e4f3c3c8759db694e.jpg)
>
> 38) Install the plate assembly to transmission.
>
> Tightening torque: 25 N·m (2.5 kgf-m, 18.4 ft-lb)
>
> ![](images/4ea46124b4c83fc73ad898994737eb8c9354fa7903c45706860eaa73dd693bd6.jpg)
>
> (A) Select cable (B) Plate ASSY
>
> 39) Install the washer and snap pin to the shifter arm.
>
> ![](images/385723a0579cd08c4be4f3091a760aae1198f1577b56025e3342299f249085e7.jpg)
>
> (A) Shifter arm (B) Snap pin (C) Select cable (D) Washer
>
> 40) Install the propeller shaft. <Ref. to DS-13, INSTALLATION, Propeller Shaft.>
>
> 41) Install the center exhaust cover.
>
> Tightening torque: 18 N·m (1.8 kgf-m, 13.3 ft-lb)
>
> ![](images/f6afc9f64510cd13da8d1eea4373f6bca95967afb7255d4f0a4404b2e6a68c53.jpg)
>
> 42) Install the center exhaust pipe. <Ref. to EX(H4DO)-8, INSTALLATION, Front Exhaust Pipe.>
> 43) Install the under cover - front.
> 44) Install the under cover front - transmission.
>
> Tightening torque: 18 N·m (1.8 kgf-m, 13.3 ft-lb) 45) Lower the vehicle.
>
> 46) Connect the following harness connectors.
>
> Transmission harness connectors Inhibitor harness connector Transmission radio ground terminal
>
> Tightening torque: 13 N·m (1.3 kgf-m, 9.6 ft-lb)
>
> ![](images/5ab9ed3804147525e9637d1459e5fb78b40333a76b9237a8cb924c1dd35a190e.jpg)
>
> (A) Transmission harness connectors (B) Inhibitor harness connector (C) Transmission radio ground terminal
>
> 47) Install the air intake boot assembly. <Ref. to IN(H4DO)-11, INSTALLATION, Air Intake Boot.>
> 48) Install the front wheels. <Ref. to WT-5, INSTALLATION, Tire and Wheel.>
> 49) Connect the battery ground terminal.
> 50) Refill differential gear oil to adjust the differential gear oil amount. <Ref. to CVT(TR580)-39, Differential
> Gear Oil.>
> 51) Refill CVTF to adjust the CVTF level. <Ref. to CVT(TR580)-35, CVTF.>
> 52) Perform the operation for clearing AT learning value. <Ref. to CVT(diag)-24, Clear Memory Mode.>
> 53) Perform the operation of AT learning mode. <Ref. to CVT(diag)-26, Learning Control.>
> 54) Execute the rear differential inspection mode. <Ref. to DI-66, Rear Differential Inspection Mode.>

> ⚠️ **Внимание:** 
> Always execute the rear differential inspection mode at the replacement of the following. Replacement of transmission assembly • Replacement of front differential hypoid gear set
> 55) Perform the road test to make sure there is no fault. <Ref. to CVT(TR580)-44, INSPECTION, Road
> Test.>

### A: REMOVAL

1. PITCHING STOPPER

1) Disconnect the ground cable from battery.
2) Remove the clip (A) from the air intake boot.
3) Loosen the clamp (B) connecting the air intake boot and air cleaner case (rear).
4) Loosen the clamp (C) which connects the air intake boot and throttle body.

![](images/9e70a3701e772a6aba3f3c632be36234574a424bfffebb397704c8fcdcbac9a4.jpg)

5) Remove the air intake boot from the throttle body, and move the air intake boot to the left side wheel apron.

![](images/7b09fcbbeee109ac5809182d37bb01c020614a6e470c0c3d2e533aa2573f198a.jpg)

6) Remove the pitching stopper.

![](images/1e1eaccec66a85275f885a3447eb74b8d91b7ac51cedd0a98b32ebd3c3dd934e.jpg)

### 2. TRANSMISSION REAR CROSSMEMBER AND REAR CUSHION RUBBER

1) Disconnect the ground cable from battery.
2) Lift up the vehicle.
3) Remove the under cover front transmission.
4) Remove the center exhaust pipe. <Ref. to EX(H4DO)-14, REMOVAL, Center Exhaust Pipe.>
5) Remove the center exhaust cover.

![](images/c4602bfd3096aca82d9c51cb84c85a36a192e0527100a9ce6a6a268e51cac3e5.jpg)

6) Set the transmission jack under the transmission. Make sure that the support plate of transmission jack does not touch the oil pan.

7) Remove the transmission rear crossmember.

![](images/50eabd356dd418bf7c7ca21cb6648e096df46f57345d9edc134b7c3725ec5ee6.jpg)

8) Remove the rear cushion rubber.

![](images/b946c1c14d86106a987b5d738c55c0858613fa9f210d27fc61647392ea7b177f.jpg)

AT-06858

### 1. PITCHING STOPPER

1) Install the pitching stopper.

Tightening torque: T1: 50 N·m (5.1 kgf-m, 36.9 ft-lb) T2: 58 N·m (5.9 kgf-m, 42.8 ft-lb)

![](images/ba7b461794c8ff363c7d71f4b1c810c7fa937214e38a021c98274bbe56b8a535.jpg)

2) Install the air intake boot assembly. <Ref. to IN(H4DO)-11, INSTALLATION, Air Intake Boot.>
3) Connect the battery ground terminal.

### 2. TRANSMISSION REAR CROSSMEMBER AND REAR CUSHION RUBBER

1) Attach the rear cushion rubber to the transmission.

Tightening torque: 40 N·m (4.1 kgf-m, 29.5 ft-lb)

![](images/ce41a67d46e3e07017622fbdf029034777fef9806e2fd8f3ab9719020ca9174f.jpg)

2) Install the crossmember.

Tightening torque: T1: 35 N·m (3.6 kgf-m, 25.8 ft-lb) T2: 70 N·m (7.1 kgf-m, 51.6 ft-lb)

![](images/7660e6dfa247e9cd5678f18ef9cae291edd6a83aeeaa24e72cfec929f9728b4e.jpg)

3) Remove the transmission jack.
4) Install the center exhaust cover.

Tightening torque: 18 N·m (1.8 kgf-m, 13.3 ft-lb)

![](images/1ba040588bae7e0821a0eeb9b0c4851a59247ed458dc51bf70b337cc14a84793.jpg)

5) Install the center exhaust pipe. <Ref. to EX(H4DO)-15, INSTALLATION, Center Exhaust Pipe.>
6) Install the under cover front transmission.

Tightening torque: 18 N·m (1.8 kgf-m, 13.3 ft-lb) 7) Connect the battery ground terminal.

Check the crossmember for bends or damage.
Check that the cushion rubber is not stiff, cracked or otherwise damaged.

### A: INSPECTION

Check for leakage of CVTF from the joint section of transmission and propeller shaft. If a leak is found, inspect the propeller shaft and replace the oil seal.

> ⚠️ **Внимание:** 
> Immediately after the vehicle has been running or after idling for a long time, the CVTF will be hot. Be careful not to burn yourself.
>
> 1) Lift up the vehicle.
> 2) Remove the center exhaust pipe. <Ref. to EX(H4DO)-14, REMOVAL, Center Exhaust Pipe.>
> 3) Remove the center exhaust cover.
> 4) Clean the transmission exterior.
> 5) Remove the propeller shaft. <Ref. to DS-11, REMOVAL, Propeller Shaft.>
> 6) Using a screwdriver or ST, remove the oil seal trying not to damage the extension case.
> ST 398527700 PULLER ASSY
> 7) Using the ST, install the oil seal.
>
> ![](images/7b798aa1236e5e95a02ca8db630c4288a2c0dc5450bc60126b74cc2d517d5012.jpg)
>
> NOTE:
>
> Use a new oil seal.
> • Apply CVTF to the oil seal lip and press-fitting surface.
> ST 498057300 OIL SEAL INSTALLER
> 8) Install the propeller shaft. <Ref. to DS-13, INSTALLATION, Propeller Shaft.>
>
> 9) Install the center exhaust cover.
>
> Tightening torque: 18 N·m (1.8 kgf-m, 13.3 ft-lb)
>
> ![](images/5631922d7159889ee22a4af775e96d6576c7b9efaa40f2bd2f726c815d7aba6b.jpg)
>
> 10) Install the center exhaust pipe. <Ref. to EX(H4DO)-15, INSTALLATION, Center Exhaust Pipe.>
> 11) Adjust the CVTF level and check there is no leakage. <Ref. to CVT(TR580)-35, ADJUSTMENT, CVTF.>

### A: INSPECTION

Check for leakage of gear oil from differential side retainer oil seal part. If there is an oil leak, inspect the front drive shaft and replace the oil seal.

B: REPLACEMENT

CAUTION:

• Immediately after the vehicle has been running or after idling for a long time, the differential gear oil will be hot. Be careful not to burn yourself. • Be careful not to spill the differential gear oil on exhaust pipe to prevent it from emitting smoke or fire. If differential gear oil is spilled on the exhaust pipe, wipe it off completely.

1) Remove the front wheels. <Ref. to WT-5, REMOVAL, Tire and Wheel.>
2) Remove the center exhaust pipe. <Ref. to EX(H4DO)-14, REMOVAL, Center Exhaust Pipe.>
3) Remove the differential gear oil drain plug using TORX® bit T70, and then drain differential gear oil.

![](images/8a8b7736287d010ed06d4e5610b7a92e49323c09e2308a561ab45b9cc3442544.jpg)

4) Tighten the differential gear oil drain plug. NOTE:
Use a new gasket.

Tightening torque: 70 N·m (7.1 kgf-m, 51.6 ft-lb)

5) Disconnect the stabilizer link from the front arm.

![](images/fb9c2a7b2b7e1baa7ed289ae80dcf8df3eb781bdf32610977ba7fc8acafb34ad.jpg)

6) Remove the bolts which secure to the front housing, and separate the front arm and housing.

![](images/8e8b12b40308227d22eda6d710e071fabc6096d17959d928fda1f030a2ba48ed.jpg)

7) Using a crowbar, etc., pull out until the front drive shaft transmission side joint slides move smoothly.

NOTE:

Place cloth between the crowbar and the transmission in order to avoid damaging the transmission side retainer.
8) Hold the transmission side joint of the front drive shaft by hand and extract the housing from the transmission while pressing the housing outward, so as not to stretch the boot.

> ℹ️ **Примечание:** 
> Before pulling RH front drive shaft from transmission, turn the steering wheel to left hand full lock. Before pulling LH front drive shaft from transmission, turn the steering wheel to right hand full lock. 9) Remove the differential side retainer oil seal using driver wrapped with vinyl tape etc.
>
> 10) Using the ST, install the differential side retainer oil seal by lightly tapping with a hammer.
>
> NOTE:
>
> • Apply differential gear oil to the lip surface, so that the oil seal lip is not deformed.
> • Apply differential gear oil to the press-fitting surface of oil seal and the differential side retainer.
> • Oil seal has an identification mark (R, L). When installing oil seals, do not confuse the left and right.

### ST 18675AA000 DIFFERENTIAL SIDE OIL SEAL INSTALLER

![](images/581ccbee0fdfece1d54cc887b22287d4f476bfd6fd1d5e153d071650057717dc.jpg)

AT-06602

11) Set the ST to side retainer. ST 28399SA010 OIL SEAL PROTECTOR

![](images/c29f47fb957d4ec8760000f91a17b4a6d14ed0655b8ea4a4214b0ef6b91fa16c.jpg)

12) Replace the circlip of the drive shaft with a new part.
13) Insert the front drive shaft spline section into transmission and remove the ST (DIFFERENTIAL SIDE OIL SEAL INSTALLER).

NOTE:

Apply grease to the side retainer oil seal lip. Before inserting RH front drive shaft into transmission, turn the steering wheel to left hand full lock.
• Before inserting LH front drive shaft into transmission, turn the steering wheel to right hand full lock.
14) Insert the drive shaft into the transmission securely by pressing the housing from outside of the vehicle.

### CVT(TR580)-89

15) Insert the ball joint into housing and secure with bolt.

Tightening torque: 50 N·m (5.1 kgf-m, 36.9 ft-lb)

> ⚠️ **Внимание:** 
> • Do not apply grease to the tapered portion of ball stud. Before tightening, make sure the lower side of housing and stepped section of ball joint are in contact.
>
> ![](images/08ccc4345985648a61e27e11bc991268c4915f10e7b6fbb8e3dc4dc75ffb7fda.jpg)
>
> 16) Attach the stabilizer link to the front arm.
>
> Tightening torque: 60 N·m (6.1 kgf-m, 44.3 ft-lb)
>
> ![](images/f0a5465a0ea5aa3e704c7087680be8a30b9998f0c5059f7bb220562011664423.jpg)
>
> 17) Install the center exhaust pipe. <Ref. to EX(H4DO)-15, INSTALLATION, Center Exhaust Pipe.>
> 18) Fill differential gear oil. <Ref. to CVT(TR580)-39, Differential Gear Oil.>
> 19) Adjust the differential gear oil level, and check for leakage. <Ref. to CVT(TR580)-39, ADJUSTMENT, Dif
> ferential Gear Oil.>
> 20) Install the under cover front transmission.
>
> Tightening torque: 18 N·m (1.8 kgf-m, 13.3 ft-lb)
>
> 21) Install the front wheels. <Ref. to WT-5, INSTALLATION, Tire and Wheel.>

### A: INSPECTION

When the driving condition or starter motor operation is improper, first check the shift linkage for improper operation. If the shift linkage is functioning properly, check the inhibitor switch.

1) Remove the clip (A) from the air intake boot.
2) Loosen the clamp (B) connecting the air intake boot and air cleaner case (rear).
3) Loosen the clamp (C) which connects the air intake boot and throttle body.

![](images/a6bc5f71f3483041ba3fe0fcded168849093d94b9889ee77b13a921b4c7fc9c7.jpg)

4) Remove the air intake boot from the throttle body, and move the air intake boot to the left side wheel apron.

![](images/cad5bfe53fe8b7fc52f386ccf54521e505be6206467ec86215078be849881d04.jpg)

5) Disconnect the inhibitor harness connector.

![](images/168a66c535f06c59bcc79597d725229f587e2d38457b032f02de9e7e11d6bffd.jpg)

6) Check for continuity in inhibitor switch circuit by shifting the select lever in “P”, “R”, “N” and “D” respectively.

NOTE:

Check that there is no continuity in the starter circuit when the select lever is in the “R” and “D” ranges. When inhibitor switch is normal, check there is no poor contact in vehicle side connector and no open circuit in harness.

![](images/5036a6695d07b485ade7c38b2670d2c80431e0123fe194466fc2820dc9d71fcc.jpg)

![](images/8235f32d31532767ae72739794d8d8ff50303a714e08a142a5415b43ef9f87ae.jpg)

### Inhibitor Switch

7) Check that there is continuity at equal points when the select lever is moved 1.5° in both directions from the “N” range.
If there is continuity in only one direction or in other points, adjust the inhibitor switch. <Ref. to CVT(TR580)- 93, ADJUSTMENT, Inhibitor Switch.>

![](images/bf3b8448197dc3c583f10d975aa14e5a6bb63bb0e98ab11d4d2ab48768142caa.jpg)

(A) Continuity does not exist. (B) Continuity exists. (C) 1.5°

8) Repeat the above inspection in other gear ranges. If there is fault, adjust the inhibitor switch and select cable. <Ref. to CVT(TR580)-93, ADJUSTMENT, Inhibitor Switch.> <Ref. to CS-52, ADJUSTMENT, Select Cable.>

### B: ADJUSTMENT

1) Shift the select lever to “N” range.
2) Loosen the two bolts holding the inhibitor switch.
3) Insert the ST vertically into the holes of the shifter arm and switch body.

![](images/dce0ae58393c8937efa1ce054aabccce71321c706f261209f75d4d0c1097b9c6.jpg)

### CVT(TR580)-93

4) Tighten the two bolts holding the inhibitor switch.

Tightening torque: 5 N·m (0.5 kgf-m, 3.7 ft-lb)

5) Repeat the inspection of the inhibitor switch. If the inhibitor switch is determined to be “faulty”, replace it.

### C: REMOVAL

1) Shift the select lever to “N” range.
2) Disconnect the ground cable from battery.
3) Lift up the vehicle.
4) Remove the center exhaust pipe. <Ref. to EX(H4DO)-14, REMOVAL, Center Exhaust Pipe.>
5) Remove the snap pin and washer from the shifter arm.

![](images/bff05abab5abad3c03072b477b5c947463f03220dc9fab608941af926bbb0a3b.jpg)

(A) Shifter arm (B) Snap pin (C) Select cable (D) Washer

6) Remove the spring pin and shifter arm.

![](images/1b993b45bc65db39e41cc6556fc9ce1f76d3feb64f97bb1e3e744dbaf36665c7.jpg)

(A) Spring pin (B) Shifter arm

7) Remove the inhibitor harness connector from inhibitor switch.
8) Remove the two inhibitor switch securing bolts.

![](images/58de4853cfc164ef0005cc9c95c417f0b7474398ce0e9ab1fee89afb2dbf5df9.jpg)

9) Remove the inhibitor switch from the transmission case.

### D: INSTALLATION

1) Install the inhibitor switch to the transmission case temporarily.

![](images/bdbfdf18b15f9d500fb56f299c7070b68af948f74516dde57a03184f79742501.jpg)

2) Connect the inhibitor harness connector to the inhibitor switch.
3) Install the shifter arm and fix with the spring pin.

NOTE: Use new spring pin.

![](images/026b5fc1c8f02a8498eb933a431190d331fa52e425c81c4c133e0a21b87f51f7.jpg)

(A) Spring pin (B) Shifter arm

4) Shift the shifter arm to “N” range.

### Inhibitor Switch

5) Install the ST vertically in the cutout of shifter arm and the hole of switch body. ST 499267300 STOPPER PIN

![](images/03281b5671114c8371fb7869f884ccd9ed95427c4b5f2c274733fdc2c14c07b9.jpg)

6) Tighten the two bolts holding the inhibitor switch.

### Tightening torque: 5 N·m (0.5 kgf-m, 3.7 ft-lb)

7) Install the select cable to the shifter arm.
8) Install the washer and snap pin to the shifter arm.

![](images/e1f4cffe4378c4330ca23b211e53a3efaa6aa4b62910f1c61adadd04a9311c19.jpg)

(A) Shifter arm (B) Snap pin (C) Select cable (D) Washer

9) Install the center exhaust pipe. <Ref. to EX(H4DO)-15, INSTALLATION, Center Exhaust Pipe.>
10) Lower the vehicle.
11) Connect the battery ground terminal.
12) Check the inhibitor switch. <Ref. to CVT(TR580)-91, INSPECTION, Inhibitor Switch.>

### 15.Turbine Speed Sensor

A: REMOVAL

CAUTION:

Be sure to prevent water or oil from contacting the connector terminal of turbine speed sensor. If adhesion occurs, replace with a new part.

1) Lift up the vehicle.
2) Remove the under cover front transmission.
3) Remove the harness connector from turbine speed sensor.
4) Remove the turbine speed sensor.

![](images/a4459c13d5e0e87551282e252b53166d4ca583891dcbf29074dc69213a488fcb.jpg)

### B: INSTALLATION

CAUTION:

Be sure to prevent water or oil from contacting the connector terminal of turbine speed sensor. If adhesion occurs, replace with a new part.
Install in the reverse order of removal.

NOTE:

Use new O-rings.
Apply CVTF to the O-ring.

Tightening torque: Turbine speed sensor 7 N·m (0.7 kgf-m, 5.2 ft-lb) Under cover front - transmission 18 N·m (1.8 kgf-m, 13.3 ft-lb)

(A) + probe (B) – probe

2) Start and warm up the engine.
3) Check the waveform and output voltage of the turbine speed sensor with engine idling.

NOTE: The waveform cycle changes as the speed changes.

### 18.Secondary Pressure Sensor

A: REMOVAL

CAUTION:

• Be sure to prevent water or oil from contacting the connector terminal of secondary pressure sensor. If adhesion occurs, replace with a new part.

• When secondary pressure sensor is removed, CVTF leaks. After installing the secondary pressure sensor, adjust the CVTF level.

1) Disconnect the ground cable from battery.
2) Lift up the vehicle.
3) Remove the secondary pressure sensor connector.
4) Remove the secondary pressure sensor.

### B: INSTALLATION

CAUTION:

• Be sure to prevent water or oil from contacting the connector terminal of secondary pressure sensor. If adhesion occurs, replace with a new part.
• After installing the secondary pressure sensor, adjust the CVTF level.
Install in the reverse order of removal.

NOTE: Use new O-rings.

Tightening torque: 39 N·m (4.0 kgf-m, 28.8 ft-lb)

### C: INSPECTION

1) Start and warm up the engine.
2) Shift the select lever to “P” or “N” range.
3) Depress the brake pedal and hold it.
4) Check “secondary pressure sensor voltage” by using Subaru Select Monitor while the engine is idling.
<Ref. to CVT(diag)-19, OPERATION, Subaru Select Monitor.>

Standard Approx. 0.8 V

5) Check “secondary pressure sensor voltage” by using Subaru Select Monitor while the engine is stopped and the ignition switch is turned on. <Ref. to CVT(diag)-19, OPERATION, Subaru Select Monitor.>

Specification: Approx. 0.5 V

### 19.Oil Pan and Strainer

A: REMOVAL

CAUTION:

• Directly after the vehicle has been running or the engine has been idling for a long time, the CVTF is hot. Be careful not to burn yourself.

• Be careful not to spill CVTF on the exhaust pipe to prevent it from emitting smoke or causing a fire.
If the CVTF adheres, wipe it off completely.

1) Lift up the vehicle.
2) Clean the transmission exterior.
3) Remove the CVTF drain plug to drain CVTF.
4) Remove the oil pan.

> ⚠️ **Внимание:** 
> Be careful not to allow foreign matter such as dust or dirt to enter the oil pan.
>
> ![](images/7e1bd3b44f1000daafdd506e02aea36d2f1343be272c90a03b426e5d219aed16.jpg)
>
> 5) Remove the magnet.
> 6) Remove the oil strainer.
>
> ![](images/236501d84c9821d7286dec7e79420d51a39c05af5788c34f27c1ec51ca1a9551.jpg)
>
> 7) Remove the O-ring from oil strainer.
>
> ![](images/f5c6cd8973d59ca98836e40b2bbc11416034f98814d110166bf7f388ce80de8e.jpg)

### B: INSTALLATION

1) Clean the mating surface of oil pan and transmission case.
2) Install the O-ring to the oil strainer.

> ℹ️ **Примечание:** 
> Use new O-rings.
> Apply CVTF to the O-ring.
>
> ![](images/4b23b31d416a0e2cf596044d0d3e26753f40674883f317fd3d321ea235ce41c6.jpg)
>
> 3) Install the oil strainer.
>
> Tightening torque: 9 N·m (0.9 kgf-m, 6.6 ft-lb)
>
> ![](images/9fa560183267a425b7f4fa081f91efa60adfe3f4f64d891969c483c082ac145d.jpg)
>
> 4) Clean the magnet.
> 5) Attach the magnet at the specified position of the oil pan.
> 6) Apply liquid gasket all around the oil pan mating surface seamlessly.
>
> Liquid gasket: THREE BOND 1217B (Part No. K0877YA020) or equivalent
>
> ![](images/b9a3e29d46a659b870db78a924b3351d3789a270317761cf7e52d67b908edd5f.jpg)
>
> 7) Install the oil pan by equally tightening the bolts.
>
> Tightening torque: 5 N·m (0.5 kgf-m, 3.7 ft-lb)
>
> ![](images/11f917f4068fa99c1189f08ec0a1f932ec337b639e5775e250e1b067edf579b9.jpg)
>
> 8) Refill CVTF and adjust the level. <Ref. to CVT(TR580)-36, REPLACEMENT, CVTF.>

### 20.Control Valve Body

A: REMOVAL

CAUTION:

• Directly after the vehicle has been running or the engine has been idling for a long time, the CVTF is hot. Be careful not to burn your self.
• Be careful not to spill CVTF on the exhaust pipe to prevent it from emitting smoke or causing a fire.
If the CVTF adheres, wipe it off completely.
• Always clean the engine compartment before removal.

NOTE:

The control valve body is replaced as an assembly only, because it is a non-disassembly part.

1) Disconnect the ground cable from battery.
2) Remove the clip (A) from the air intake boot.
3) Loosen the clamp (B) connecting the air intake boot and air cleaner case (rear).
4) Loosen the clamp (C) which connects the air intake boot and throttle body.

![](images/b17f2bf2007bce63c4d0c8b7c7dc489fc3b1daee5cd02550db4b593e8be34667.jpg)

5) Remove the air intake boot from the throttle body, and move the air intake boot to the left side wheel apron.

![](images/d2066aab132ee281314fb80d870261b29e2ed9fbd8749f996d6b50e6a88166a7.jpg)

6) Disconnect the following connectors.

Transmission harness connectors Inhibitor harness connector Transmission radio ground terminal (A) Transmission harness connectors (B) Inhibitor harness connector (C) Transmission radio ground terminal

![](images/aa4f3e09dfc900cc50e704b4d56afbc6a3338045da2f9262af6049525cba2c62.jpg)

7) Remove the pitching stopper.

![](images/6dfe423ed34022e12dde8385c8a1dad0020f85ff965a893b7691254e240fa3a7.jpg)

8) Remove the air breather hose from the pitching stopper bracket, and then remove the pitching stopper bracket and transmission radio ground cord.

![](images/191a2a95db9690456d9f4cac5781b3b68f6c06b72decf5663fd4dcb931755fcb.jpg)

9) Remove the transmission case cover.

![](images/1908349380a582806b42bb228c33530701f7f095bbf727aea80eac43eae31974.jpg)

10) Remove the transmission harness stay and ground terminal.

![](images/f0dc08c2a5d80b3306cad1bf54ce625266d18a9039811b1c71449b27cf651380.jpg)

11) Remove the transmission harness connector from the harness stay.
12) Remove the throttle body, and move it aside so that it will not interfere with the removal of the control valve. <Ref. to FU(H4DO)-15, REMOVAL, Throttle Body.>

NOTE:

Do not remove the preheater hose.
13) Clean the transmission exterior.
14) Fix the ST with tape, and set the ST to the vehicle.

NOTE:

When replacing the control valve body, the sheet is included in the control valve body for repairs. ST 18761AA010 SHEET SPECIAL TOOL

![](images/217bfb4fdfd0bb4c039217f92a013fa0457d2eb201d8fff4753acfe9c1c03073.jpg)

15) Remove the valve cover and gasket.

![](images/cd1141d61f5ff8257d60aac2469d6a073816c8c81759125bfc6eb82fc457361f.jpg)

16) Remove the transmission harness from the valve cover.

![](images/749902525d31b96c3026e8e106f7ecfc3523b17e8ccd964f56a5db72c5fb068a.jpg)

17) Remove the O-ring from the transmission harness.

![](images/6d90f06b975bdf271ce7214033c02c26e0a9667b61dfaedc5dccf40b3615a972.jpg)

18) Disconnect the harness connector from the control valve body.

### 20.Control Valve Body

19) Remove the control valve body.

![](images/f46ec896020e9b962a3c36ad9c8c41a70f554da589c23f2a67334114d4a9da62.jpg)

AT-06792

20) Remove the O-ring from the transmission.

![](images/82c4931b7cc45e8ebecc5836cbc8f41ba7061757657a86ad294d7cad2cfdbcfd.jpg)

### 22.X MODE Switch

A: REMOVAL

1) Disconnect the ground cable from battery.
2) Remove the cover shift lever. <Ref. to EI-65, REMOVAL, Console Box.>
3) Remove the X mode switch from the cover shift lever.

![](images/ca2f933aeaa35024ae28934539f22fc4b6bb391d365519a50c1bda94fde603ce.jpg)

4) Remove the X mode switch connector from the cover shift lever.

### 1. CHECK SWITCH UNIT

Measure the resistance between harness connector terminals of the X mode switch.

![](images/1f2dd9f043b3833534b8fd44ffe997c3fdcca7ecc4583a5e1a2d328c267dc925.jpg)

![](images/67e2f240175833f19e5465b9c05db79b2a473cfef4729dd05147ba4d215afcc0.jpg)

> ⚠️ **Внимание:** 
> Note that the system performs the following controls when switching to X MODE. 1. When turning the engine OFF and then ON again, it switches to (intelligent) mode although in the mode prior to engine OFF. 2. Switches to S (Sport) when the malfunction indicator light illuminates while the engine is running. In this case, switching to S# (Sport Sharp), (Intelligent) or X is not available. 3. If there is a possible engine coolant or engine oil temperature overheat condition, it will not be possible to switch to X MODE. Switches to S (Sport) while driving in X MODE. 4. If the ignition switch is in ON position before starting engine, switching to X MODE is not available.

### 3. PRESSING X MODE SWITCH DOES NOT CHANGE THE X MODE DISPLAY IN THE COMBINATION METER AND MODE DOES 

WIRING DIAGRAM: <Ref. to WI-144, WIRING DIAGRAM, CVT Control System.>

![](images/cc5c3642fad29076e105425a516d01f75b5299fb2a8a3b084fd3549aebe54a27.jpg)

AT-08063

![](images/61e8625b2c524071cef4142e9f181fa6c34f4172269dc71de04b59aa5b64ca4e.jpg)

### X MODE Switch

![](images/0f49fa00ecc2c3a022eb3a1b74c7a465b58ebb65b35815a4f00cbf581cdc1d8c.jpg)

4. WHEN SWITCHED TO X MODE, “S”, “I”, “S#” OR “X” MODE DISPLAY IN COMBINATION METER FLASHES IN APPROX. 5 SECONDS
![](images/f6a5a9d3f85674bdf058644e092a666412f5832eb60c0850781d09d0acffa11b.jpg)

5. WHEN SWITCHED TO X MODE, “S”, “I”, “S#” OR “X” MODE DISPLAY IN COMBINATION METER FLASHES

NOTE: In this case, there may be a fault other than in X MODE system.

### 23.Transmission Control Module (TCM)

A: REMOVAL

### B: INSTALLATION

1) Install the TCM to the bracket.

CAUTION:
To avoid the damage to bracket and TCM, do not remove after installing TCM to bracket. If installed by mistake, the part must be replaced with a new part.

![](images/30eca223f65dab297b252872df92fe426e4d330669062c6c7c202a78460357da.jpg)

(A) 22-pin connector side (B) 26-pin connector side

2) Install the TCM.

![](images/e252ef3f5de6726882e3ea3969ca6f621b62a6d8d745fbb29f0e42708c453d72.jpg)

3) Install the harness connector to TCM.
4) Perform AT learning mode. <Ref. to CVT(diag)-26, Learning Control.>

### 24.CVTF Cooler (With Warmer Function)

A: REMOVAL

CAUTION:
If the CVTF and engine coolant is spilt over exhaust pipe, wipe it off with cloth to avoid emitting smoke or causing a fire.

1) Disconnect the ground cable from battery.
2) Drain engine coolant. <Ref. to CO(H4DO)-14, REPLACEMENT, Engine Coolant.>
3) Remove the clip (A) from the air intake boot.
4) Loosen the clamp (B) connecting the air intake boot and air cleaner case (rear).
5) Loosen the clamp (C) which connects the air intake boot and throttle body.

![](images/4260229ea717b3bc8456d669d32a01ac0721714b4c959d85e69de51b1d75fa53.jpg)

6) Remove the air intake boot from the throttle body, and move the air intake boot to the left side wheel apron.

![](images/f6beb2597531ec89195fbd3a843228367a85bbbd279e16591697f38f7a9d550b.jpg)

7) Remove the harness bracket, and then remove the engine harness connector.

![](images/08b3bd08178bb5f99c6d461c58e5eac335090d9a1888faedf6b93ad38cbd8307.jpg)

8) Disconnect the EGR control valve harness connector, throttle position sensor harness connector and manifold absolute pressure sensor harness connector.
9) Remove the engine hanger rear.

![](images/03ab2fa0a51f40a195cfa449aa11f58da8227ee784a444dcd47472b1404d7a3d.jpg)

10) Disconnect the engine coolant outlet hose.

![](images/44c9031f0cc9a66d18363e6dac20e6d17a502ed793ee0627962643e40c64c7d7.jpg)

11) Remove the CVTF cooler (with warmer feature) from the transmission.

![](images/8820059a5625042ec3b0dfbf85c141f22e20b0df6c6806c1ab67883de6548693.jpg)

12) Remove the CVTF inlet hose and outlet hose from the pipe on the transmission side.

![](images/70f175aff598a3c6d35e9bb0a71179a16628d8cca0609f862274dc4dc6688220.jpg)

13) Disconnect the engine coolant inlet hose from the CVTF cooler (with warmer feature) assembly.

![](images/0e643f0c31573c3090d39df50cd3b481c5559cace6f1697f0e9624ee4f4d6452.jpg)

14) Remove the electric power steering harness from the clip, and remove the engine coolant inlet hose from the engine coolant pipe.

![](images/d21aa3880beb003aa53102ab391a79e271e2b4b34d1eb5e0bc80a30764de88cf.jpg)

### B: INSTALLATION

1) Install the engine coolant inlet hose to the engine coolant pipe, and secure the electric power steering harness to the clip.

NOTE:

With the triangle mark on the engine coolant inlet hose facing the vehicle outside, install the hose to the engine side pipe.

![](images/0df8d404058cfd1bc5bed3d20e001300f314ac1e58304c85dffc09ebf52b1f2b.jpg)

2) Install the engine coolant inlet hose to the CVTF cooler (with warmer feature) assembly.

![](images/a8cd0fe802f28eb3abc057a7080d232d04384c76c08fb5715ebe6babd548a523.jpg)

3) Install the CVTF inlet hose and CVTF outlet hose to transmission.

![](images/8b0d1306266c96b202d9c9f7d07edadb37490370e5060cebc04413db0ba4612a.jpg)

4) Install the CVTF cooler (with warmer feature) to the transmission.

Tightening torque: 23 N·m (2.3 kgf-m, 17.0 ft-lb)

![](images/c4649580378fc39fcbcdd667c97bff1e8088376b2c6ac712cea008845d0b33a3.jpg)

5) Connect the engine coolant outlet hose.

![](images/d8340774982924afd9c85779699aa2e6f4c1005cf8259cf08cc02eda85e4261f.jpg)

6) Check installation condition of each hose. Make sure the hoses do not interfere with each other or with other components. Check each hose for bent, excess curve, and twisting conditions.

7) Install the engine hanger rear.

Tightening torque: 21 N·m (2.1 kgf-m, 15.5 ft-lb)

![](images/4e7ad168513bebe39d7ce1d207ba9e2c3479fb747e0254b08332534b15149664.jpg)

8) Connect the EGR control valve harness connector, throttle position sensor harness connector and manifold absolute pressure sensor harness connector. 9) Connect the engine harness connectors, then install the harness connector bracket.

### Tightening torque: 7.5 N·m (0.8 kgf-m, 5.5 ft-lb)

10) Install the air intake boot assembly. <Ref. to IN(H4DO)-11, INSTALLATION, Air Intake Boot.>
11) Connect the battery ground terminal.
12) Fill engine coolant. <Ref. to CO(H4DO)-14, REPLACEMENT, Engine Coolant.>
13) Adjust the CVTF level. <Ref. to CVT(TR580)-35, ADJUSTMENT, CVTF.>

### C: DISASSEMBLY

1) Remove the hoses from the CVTF cooler (with warmer feature).

![](images/5dac54e4f037ef18276ddc5087cc882b1ee3f47fe069a7992cd3717845771b78.jpg)

(A) CVTF cooler inlet hose (B) CVTF cooler outlet hose (C) Engine coolant outlet hose

![](images/55cd6a0d6294f8dc7c26a440a6738bb2724645be00ec97fc76751be953f4d099.jpg)

### D: ASSEMBLY

1) Attach the bracket.

Tightening torque: 23 N·m (2.3 kgf-m, 17.0 ft-lb)

![](images/0ee0176a23a7534a3c0faa71dbb196b33efb72a829fdcd2eed17d2979da32ad8.jpg)

2) Attach hoses to the CVTF cooler (with warmer feature). NOTE:

Use a new CVTF cooler hose.
Install so that the CVTF cooler hose is not folded over, excessively bent or twisted.
Insert the CVTF cooler hose to the specified position in the proper direction.

![](images/cab9259e35abf2f583ca7f4139301ee6dfc8a1d2f7a23e18263e88626b0f457a.jpg)

(A) CVTF cooler inlet hose (B) CVTF cooler outlet hose (C) Engine coolant outlet hose

### E: INSPECTION

Replace any faulty CVTF cooler hoses, CVTF cooler pipes and clamps found in the inspection below.

1) Check that there are no CVTF or engine coolant leaks from the connections.
2) Check the clamp for deformation.
3) Lightly bend the CVTF cooler hose and check for cracks in the surface or other damages.
4) Pinch the CVTF cooler hose with your fingers and check for poor elasticity. Also check for poor elasticity
in the parts where the clamp was installed by pressing with your fingernail.
5) Check for peeling, cracks, and deformation at the tip of the hose.
6) Check the CVTF cooler (with warmer feature) for any damage.

### 1. FRONT DIFFERENTIAL SIDE

1) Remove the clip (A) from the air intake boot.
2) Loosen the clamp (B) connecting the air intake boot and air cleaner case (rear).
3) Loosen the clamp (C) which connects the air intake boot and throttle body.

![](images/d8b8b66a39997e9624fbd0b06216a27844d1eeb182696d189e5a30936719ee37.jpg)

4) Remove the air intake boot from the throttle body, and move the air intake boot to the left side wheel apron.

![](images/81f533313afee0dd18dd1d2aa29fa7a80088da01220283e0823628ddd3ca0b26.jpg)

5) Remove the air breather hose.

![](images/25019b4500e35709caa7707d24fac766da86ba025fdf7634958d73b955f113c9.jpg)

### 2. TRANSMISSION CASE SIDE

1) Remove the transmission assembly. <Ref. to CVT(TR580)-57, REMOVAL, Automatic Transmission Assembly.>
2) Remove the transmission case cover.

![](images/d494e5329d4fdd27906da5b374544659fdd95c056df464d3077733bb0afa6ca2.jpg)

3) Remove the air breather hose.

![](images/52555c6cb7904061925dfb7b1325f1f252cc8649055011b7c1cf9c6ab9e54a7f.jpg)

### 1. FRONT DIFFERENTIAL SIDE

Install in the reverse order of removal.

NOTE: Securely insert the air breather hose until the hose end contacts the catch of the pitching stopper bracket.

![](images/8b270dc005663989d58d1c3e2edb310b70a8baf1065b7b358f0c5b689b8f77da.jpg)

AT-07630

### 2. TRANSMISSION CASE SIDE

Install in the reverse order of removal.

Tightening torque: Transmission case cover 8 N·m (0.8 kgf-m, 5.9 ft-lb) Air breather hose 5 N·m (0.5 kgf-m, 3.7 ft-lb)

### A: REMOVAL

1) Remove the transmission assembly from the vehicle. <Ref. to CVT(TR580)-57, REMOVAL, Automatic Transmission Assembly.>
2) Set the ST.

ST 498497300 CRANKSHAFT STOPPER

![](images/f1c56dcd32cf5e1b4a20bf28d13b8e8a107311358943ddba2021ebcf462d3941.jpg)

3) Remove the drive plate and reinforcement drive plate.

### B: INSTALLATION

1) Temporarily install the drive plate and reinforcement drive plate.

NOTE:

Align the knock pin hole of the crankshaft position sensor plate to the knock pin of the crankshaft to secu the knock pin.

ST 498497300 CRANKSHAFT STOPPER

![](images/11fb4d7b56e13ac111fec042a8ac3f6fe8818dcfd85dd82f50f2b178842be04e.jpg)

3) Tighten the drive plate mounting bolt in two stages.

(1) Tighten the drive plate mounting bolt.

Tightening torque: 30 N·m (3.1 kgf-m, 22.1 ft-lb)

(2) While checking the tightening angle with the angle gauge, tighten the drive plate mounting bolts to the specified angle.

Tightening angle: 30° — 35°

![](images/e4f2a7719ec4bc475a8d395fb18e88b3819e83d04324d24de108dd1d43aa3156.jpg)

4) Install the transmission assembly to the vehicle. <Ref. to CVT(TR580)-68, INSTALLATION, Automatic Transmission Assembly.>

### 27.Torque Converter Assembly

A: REMOVAL

1) Remove the transmission assembly from the vehicle. <Ref. to CVT(TR580)-57, REMOVAL, Automatic Transmission Assembly.>
2) Pull out the torque converter assembly horizontally.

CAUTION: Do not scratch the inside of engaging parts.

![](images/df9c6ae17a998ec64015d41a2c8cca8db19a6aa452c8a6349b3b72591be5da3a.jpg)

3) Remove the O-ring from the input shaft.

### B: INSTALLATION

1) Install the O-ring to the input shaft.

NOTE: Use new O-rings. Apply CVTF to the O-ring.

2) While holding the torque converter assembly by hand, carefully install it into the torque converter case.

NOTE:

• Apply CVTF to the oil seal lip.
• Do not damage the oil seal and O-ring.
3) Engage the splines while gently rotating the torque converter assembly by hand, and securely insert the assembly.
4) Measure depth “A”, from converter case end surface to drive plate contacting surface.

Standard (reference): 6.8 mm (0.268 in) or less

![](images/0c9ef35ddc71d738317e2fde5a7445828cea738a2ef311d709610947dc5bb8df.jpg)

5) Install the transmission assembly to the vehicle. <Ref. to CVT(TR580)-68, INSTALLATION, Automatic Transmission Assembly.>

### C: INSPECTION

Check the protrusion of torque converter center (front boss) is not deformed or damaged.
Check the ring gear and exterior for break or damage.

### 28.Preparation for Overhaul

A: GENERAL DESCRIPTION

Before disassembling and assembling the transmission, follow the following procedures to prepare.

### B: PROCEDURE

1) Clean the transmission exterior.
2) Remove the torque converter assembly. <Ref. to CVT(TR580)-163, Torque Converter Assembly.> 3) Attach the ST on the transmission.
ST 18632AA000 STAND ASSY

![](images/ceeb2656b387c8481f16545214a006a72d050cae3cf356d39910110e55247bd4.jpg)

4) Remove the transmission case cover on the transmission upper side.

NOTE: Install using the following tightening torque.

Tightening torque: 8 N·m (0.8 kgf-m, 5.9 ft-lb)

![](images/3c630bfc110083106a435fe875cd1b850024d60b9a00fd12c3f32a77de8a75a0.jpg)

5) Place the transmission assembly on end.

6) When completely overhauling the transmission, refill approx. 10 L (2.6 US qt, 8.8 Imp qt) of CVTF through the transmission right side plug, and install the plug. Finally, install the transmission case cover.

> ⚠️ **Внимание:** 
> Always use specified CVTF. Using other fluid will cause malfunction. <Ref. to CVT(TR580)-4, HYDRAULIC CONTROL AND LUBRICATION, SPECIFICATION, General Description.>
>
> NOTE: Use a new gasket.
>
> Tightening torque: 50 N·m (5.1 kgf-m, 36.9 ft-lb)
>
> ![](images/02ae480ca07abac250e451fbe98248b8e495199aaa85d085abd05d7a3bb4cba8.jpg)
>
> AT-08049

### A: REMOVAL

1) Remove the transmission assembly from the vehicle. <Ref. to CVT(TR580)-57, REMOVAL, Automatic Transmission Assembly.>
2) Remove the extension case and transmission hanger.

NOTE: The total number of extension case mounting bolts is 13.

![](images/98317db2b8ca79312057ac4ec6ce5713401532a8f5c6dc6b3961a525bf2995d0.jpg)

AT-06404

3) Remove the O-ring.

![](images/d8e13d6c18c6e8c829f1bed5520da96684e88e3b26a827f77bcf0882af3faf1e.jpg)

### B: INSTALLATION

1) Clean the mating surface of extension case and transmission case.
2) Select the transfer drive gear shim. <Ref. to CVT(TR580)-221, ADJUSTMENT, Reduction Drive Gear.>
3) Select the transfer driven gear shim. <Ref. to CVT(TR580)-183, ADJUSTMENT, Transfer Clutch.>
4) Attach the selected transfer drive gear shim to extension case with vaseline.
5) Attach the selected transfer driven gear shim to extension case with vaseline.
6) Install the O-ring to the transmission case.

NOTE:

Use new O-rings.
Apply CVTF to the O-ring.

![](images/6431a959dd19d84018ae16ec62998fddbc223c66bfd36b95991a43e140606a51.jpg)

7) Apply liquid gasket to extension case seamlessly.

Liquid gasket: THREE BOND 1215 (Part No. 004403007) or equivalent

![](images/190987a73c1a0462565b464efe51fc4589ff3e1497adc58cecdfeee920ca3e97.jpg)

8) Install the extension case to transmission hanger.

Tightening torque: 25 N·m (2.5 kgf-m, 18.4 ft-lb)

![](images/2e94e6c69b609e0a197e3d767d173c06ddd2936704b73a1c4b576a113a5f46ea.jpg)

9) Install the transmission assembly. <Ref. to CVT(TR580)-68, INSTALLATION, Automatic Transmission Assembly.>

### C: DISASSEMBLY

1) Remove the dust cover from extension case.
2) Remove the extension case oil seal from the extension case. <Ref. to CVT(TR580)-85, REPLACEMENT, Extension Case Oil Seal.>
3) Remove all plugs.

### D: ASSEMBLY

1) Press-fit the dust cover into extension case.
2) Install the extension case oil seal to extension case. <Ref. to CVT(TR580)-85, REPLACEMENT, Extension Case Oil Seal.>
3) Install all plugs.

NOTE:

Use a new O-ring or a gasket.
Apply CVTF to the O-ring.

Tightening torque: T1: 25 N·m (2.5 kgf-m, 18.4 ft-lb) T2: 35 N·m (3.6 kgf-m, 25.8 ft-lb)

![](images/d15068772d89922a5d805d24ae943bdf8907cd2a274e11000f136e6bfbce35f1.jpg)

### E: INSPECTION

Check there is no leak of CVTF from the joint between extension case and transmission case.
Check there is no damage or cracks on the extension case and other parts.

### F: ADJUSTMENT

NOTE:

When replacing the extension case, select the transfer drive gear shim and transfer driven gear shim. <Ref. to CVT(TR580)-221, ADJUSTMENT, Reduction Drive Gear.> <Ref. to CVT(TR580)-183, ADJUSTMENT, Transfer Clutch.>

### A: REMOVAL

1) Remove the transmission assembly from the vehicle. <Ref. to CVT(TR580)-57, REMOVAL, Automatic Transmission Assembly.>

2) Remove the extension case. <Ref. to CVT(TR580)-167, REMOVAL, Extension Case.>
3) Remove the transfer clutch assembly.

![](images/850bcd4c219fde1a8c3c03f593180dbd2f7d236b73eb4f172cca75d97d914244.jpg)

AT-06407

4) Remove the thrust bearing.

![](images/b8edd6d5eb2acc6e335dda542de8db2ad89a0e721def52cf376cdb347d92dc56.jpg)

5) Remove the seal ring from transfer clutch assembly.

![](images/acb2ec51e745b592599370df91b6d9cc8678b4efff640f01e7ff75bf71032f19.jpg)

6) Remove the seal ring from the transfer driven gear assembly.

![](images/f24a4a410b87615f5ec84da617e249e23216673296dcbf23dba278beea194b08.jpg)

### B: INSTALLATION

1) Install the thrust bearing. NOTE: Make sure to install in the right direction.

![](images/4798e1cce4f7f5b445221baff195591b7b8bcb6ecea4ff07bccb0b6d7e36d2ce.jpg)

2) Install the transfer clutch assembly.

![](images/023cbcf29049ea430d032a2ec96a078278587380425ca179878a1d3816a1c4ea.jpg)

3) Select the transfer driven gear shim. <Ref. to CVT(TR580)-183, ADJUSTMENT, Transfer Clutch.>
4) Attach the selected transfer driven gear shim to extension case with vaseline.
5) Remove the transfer clutch assembly.

6) Install the seal ring to the transfer clutch assembly.

> ℹ️ **Примечание:** 
> Use a new seal ring.
> When installing the seal ring, do not expand the seal ring too much.
> Apply CVTF to the seal rings.
>
> ![](images/d68652c2ba08c71247655d4e687c8fa2328ba8d504ad12a08c2d4ff4039697d4.jpg)
>
> 7) Install the seal ring to the transfer driven gear assembly.
>
> NOTE:
>
> Use a new seal ring.
> When installing the seal ring, do not expand the seal ring too much.
> Apply CVTF to the seal rings. 8) Install the transfer clutch assembly.
> 9) Install the extension case. <Ref. to CVT(TR580)-168, INSTALLATION, Extension Case.>
> 10) Install the transmission assembly to the vehicle. <Ref. to CVT(TR580)-68, INSTALLATION, Automatic Transmission Assembly.>
>
> ![](images/131a1b78437c2ebe59bb2cf2d14aa6ab3ae3f344a4f6fdfcab49a5665cd42074.jpg)

### C: DISASSEMBLY

1) Remove the snap ring, and then remove the retaining plate, drive plate and driven plate.

![](images/63f9157897be84a89758ec1460e9112925ad4ddca532f864e832fd5c1c7026d0.jpg)

AT-07214

(A) Snap ring

2) Compress the return spring using the ST to remove the snap ring. ST 18762AA000 COMPRESSOR SPECIAL TOOL

![](images/12fcbc63455e9df601b22256027decef33418fe21ebe66ebe5400eecfe962332.jpg)

(A) Snap ring (B) Transfer clutch piston seal

3) Remove the transfer clutch piston seal.

4) Remove the return spring.

![](images/d01268bbaa3c48d044f29b47ddff3c95f051c867c9c494bf9168478fda9e7c3a.jpg)

5) Remove the transfer clutch piston by blowing compressed air through transfer clutch assembly hole. NOTE:
Plug the holes through which the compressed air is not blown.

![](images/fd1254860f5603b73ccd7a22e53a999ecdb294ae722d1a505bfa322927cc7d53.jpg)

6) Remove the ball bearing using ST. ST1 18767AA010 BEARING REMOVER ST2 18723AA000 REMOVER

![](images/2706275aa5af04b7900255e448f36dd668caf6b1e685c6c7acbe58839578ffcc.jpg)

### D: ASSEMBLY

1) Install the transfer clutch piston.

NOTE:

Apply CVTF to the transfer clutch piston lip.
2) Install the return spring.

![](images/8053d066a697cf682a20d426facf9af69529e0c352b3d90f0d0f7e36c3f09656.jpg)

3) Install the transfer clutch piston seal.

NOTE: Apply CVTF to the lip section of transfer clutch piston seal.

![](images/bcfc822bf316436882443d1e2bda18cdc3342452b46544eb711147abfe52db94.jpg)

### 4) Compress the return spring using the ST to install the snap ring. ST 18762AA000 COMPRESSOR SPECIA

![](images/82cd1e95fdf8875f1d288092f08c1c378e421ecec0b108ab1716b0c30e90f854.jpg)

(A) Snap ring (B) Transfer clutch piston seal

### Transfer Clutch

5) Install the pressure plate, driven plate, drive plate and snap ring.

![](images/3d8451f9241823ddb688278a1d81c40e340cbaa09fb3deeb2e3e9348012afa06.jpg)

(A) Snap ring

6) Blow compressed air through transfer clutch assembly hole, and check the transfer clutch piston operation.

NOTE:

Plug the holes through which the compressed air is not blown.

![](images/4568cd4f901d63661f9c9f56cdf6c0566658f44cd420179ab8393ffa0f5ee65c.jpg)

7) Before measuring clearance “A”, place same thickness shims on both sides to prevent the plate from tilting.

### Transfer Clutch

8) When clearance “A” exceeds the limit for use, replace the drive plate and driven plate as a set, and select and adjust the pressure plate within the initial specified value.

Initial standard: 0.7 — 1.1 mm (0.028 — 0.043 in)

Limit thickness: 1.45 mm (0.057 in)

![](images/495d63fc2d41baa0e34b0211bbdbd3d83416935b7efc78a635c7e645ef077023.jpg)

![](images/a5b876c5ceb618c1ef6556b68d2c95dc4cc94dbf7b77af1023bd99d043b1847f.jpg)

9) Recheck the clearance. <Ref. to CVT(TR580)- 182, INSPECTION, Transfer Clutch.>

10) Using the ST, install the ball bearing.

NOTE: Use a new ball bearing.

ST1 398177700 INSTALLER ST2 499277000 INSTALLER

![](images/dfa3c3d9d167588499a58a5745dc83e472b5e446c7c889bb56f01fb131641dc1.jpg)

### E: INSPECTION

Inspect the drive plate facing for wear and damage. • Driven plate for discoloration (burned color) • Make sure the snap ring is not worn and the return spring has no permanent distortion, damage, or deformation. Check the lip seal for damage. • Inspect the extension end play, and adjust it to within the standard value. <Ref. to CVT(TR580)-183, ADJUSTMENT, Transfer Clutch.> 1) Before measuring clearance “A” between snap ring and driven plate, place same thickness shims on both sides to prevent the plate from tilting. 2) When clearance “A” exceeds the limit for use, replace the drive plate and driven plate as a set, and select the pressure plate within the initial specified value.

Initial standard: 0.7 — 1.1 mm (0.028 — 0.043 in)

Limit thickness: 1.45 mm (0.057 in)

![](images/fb20c7a3f430118a8b47e8d367073abbdd4efeb956241b5015ae22e812369615.jpg)

3) Check for tight corner braking phenomenon when the vehicle is moved forward with the steering fully turned. If tight corner braking occurs, perform the following procedures.

NOTE:

For models with X MODE switch, turn OFF the switch for inspection.

(1) With the steering wheel held at fully turned position, drive the vehicle in “D” range and with vehicle speed at approx. 5 km/h (3 MPH) in both clockwise and counterclockwise directions for approx. ten times each, while repeating acceleration and braking intermittently. (2) If the tight corner braking phenomenon still persists, drive the vehicle again in a circle for several laps.

### F: ADJUSTMENT

1) Install the transfer clutch assembly to the extension case with the transfer driven gear shims and thrust bearings removed.

![](images/4feb1b5c518a77c5dadde56a19dbdcb9bf420fb2baf0de689dc8ba7c3b674243.jpg)

2) Install the thrust bearing to the transfer driven gear.

NOTE: Make sure to install in the right direction.

![](images/23e8ef91445325ff0639634caf1befc62e7c48576425e40913289254d3fd9798.jpg)

3) Using the ST, measure the height “A” from the ST end face to the thrust bearing catch surface of the transfer clutch assembly.

![](images/7891e2524723f08f2763982ce7f7a0e876cd28d91602adee45ef2950022b90f3.jpg)

4S)TUsi4n9g9t5h7e55S0T0, measure the height “B” from the transmission case mating surface to the end of ST. GAUGE

![](images/4ccc73aad84cb519ffd4c3acf7357f693089a5a6196dae87c8c12ba7c4bb063d.jpg)

### Transfer Clutch

5) Obtain the thickness of transfer driven gear shim using the following formula to select one to three transfer driven gear shims.
T (mm) = A – B – (0.05 — 0.25)
[T (in) = A – B – (0.002 — 0.01)]
T: Transfer driven gear shim thickness
A: Height from the ST end face to the transfer clutch assembly thrust bearing catch surface
B: Height from the mating surface of the transmission case to the end of the ST
0.05 — 0.25 mm (0.002 — 0.01 in): Clearance

![](images/fc12895305c1323362e9a0751688fb58b9ae60300ffa21e2192bcbe54504f315.jpg)

### D: ASSEMBLY

![](images/4756586182fd49a5fb9e758ee880a9bc3748c6beb4a351257e6de6d4544922c3.jpg)

### E: INSPECTION

Check the ball bearing for smooth rotation.
Check the ball bearing for excessive looseness.
Check the transfer driven gear for breakage or damage.

### F: ADJUSTMENT

NOTE:
When the transfer driven gear or bearing is replaced, select the transfer driven gear shim. <Ref. to
CVT(TR580)-183, ADJUSTMENT, Transfer Clutch.>

### A: REMOVAL

1) Remove the transmission assembly from the vehicle. <Ref. to CVT(TR580)-57, REMOVAL, Automatic Transmission Assembly.>

2) Shift the range select lever to “N” range.

(A) Parking pawl shaft (B) Return spring (C) Parking pawl

### B: INSTALLATION

2) Install the parking pawl shaft, return spring and parking pawl.

NOTE:

Make sure that the end of return spring sticks out of parking pawl as shown in (a). Make sure that the other end contacts the rib of transmission case as shown in (b).

![](images/1052ae97b4f80801a952cc88c25912a3e35bc8ecd9c7519dd71163e14e8d1de9.jpg)

(A) Parking pawl shaft (B) Return spring (C) Parking pawl

3) Install the extension case. <Ref. to CVT(TR580)-168, INSTALLATION, Extension Case.> 4) Install the transmission assembly to the vehicle. <Ref. to CVT(TR580)-68, INSTALLATION, Automatic Transmission Assembly.>

### A: REMOVAL

1) Remove the transmission assembly from the vehicle. <Ref. to CVT(TR580)-57, REMOVAL, Automatic Transmission Assembly.>

2) Remove the extension case. <Ref. to CVT(TR580)-167, REMOVAL, Extension Case.>
3) Remove the transfer clutch assembly. <Ref. to CVT(TR580)-171, REMOVAL, Transfer Clutch.>
4) Remove the transfer driven gear assembly. <Ref. to CVT(TR580)-186, REMOVAL, Transfer Driven
Gear.>

![](images/2bab500a767d7a8368dc470b19002c1f7dc0cfab797cc5a0cff33db94983dfc0.jpg)

### C: DISASSEMBLY

1) Flatten the tab of the lock nut.
2) Using the ST, counter the rotation of the reduction driven gear assembly, and remove the lock nut. ST1 18355AA000 PULLEY WRENCH
ST2 18334AA000 PIN SET
ST3 499987003 SOCKET WRENCH (35)

![](images/ef9ae91d7bf8759ae9201932aea2d343d9eac8adcbe63bb3f472e1290ed4a72e.jpg)

NOTE:

When collar has been removed, do not reuse the reduction driven gear and/or shaft, and replace it with reduction driven gear COMPL.

ST 899580100 INSTALLER

![](images/9f2445b44e528d6950c990df56f3c6f324ad7b891999b3f5c06aa5687587c1c2.jpg)

2) Using the ST, install the parking gear. ST 499757002 INSTALLER

![](images/f443c61ca5de51dc37bcdfce0467807aa6b85de611b15437057b6e254a6d3020.jpg)

3) Using the ST, install the transfer drive gear.

![](images/b72a77951ec498c2804c2b7be8e1b1bee247b9ff6d6b65871bc04b4b15a613f2.jpg)

NOTE: Use a new ball bearing.

![](images/8d925aadc25e7e646a7f96cb9385ea41c695ea2dc29d2f430d50df9c726dec5c.jpg)

5) Using the ST, counter the rotation of the reduction drive gear assembly, and install the lock nut.

NOTE:

Use a new lock nut. ST1 18355AA000 PULLEY WRENCH ST2 18334AA000 PIN SET ST3 499987003 SOCKET WRENCH (35)

Check the ball bearing for excessive looseness.
Make sure each gear is not broken or damaged.

### F: ADJUSTMENT

1) Measure the height “A” from the ST upper face to the ball bearing catch surface. ST 499575600 GAUGE

![](images/2983f39f9cd7829cd0dc06c98b5e94c34849c36c0b6cd6e72526fa6ea7e3095d.jpg)
2) Measure the height “B” from the ST to the mating surface of the transmission case. ST 499575600 GAUGE

![](images/779ef88747b1ad2e7add9ee7c99eda1851d5c38fcaf564fafd75ebf0553b822f.jpg)

3) Obtain the thickness of transfer drive gear shim using the following formula to select one to three transfer drive gear shims.

T (mm) = A – B – (0.05 — 0.25) [T (in) = A – B – (0.002 — 0.01)]

T: Shim thickness

A: Height from the ST upper face to the ball bearing catch surface B: Height from ST to transmission case mating surface

0.05 — 0.25 mm (0.002 — 0.01 in): Clearance

![](images/5bffec33bce5a3751336e8b74ad3858310ccb3a900638c6b5bf6b0e39887ca45.jpg)

### A: REMOVAL

1) Remove the transmission assembly from the vehicle. <Ref. to CVT(TR580)-57, REMOVAL, Automatic
Transmission Assembly.>
2) Remove the inhibitor switch. <Ref. to CVT(TR580)-94, REMOVAL, Inhibitor Switch.>
3) Remove the oil pan and oil strainer. <Ref. to CVT(TR580)-107, REMOVAL, Oil Pan and Strainer.>
4) Shift the manual plate to “N” range, and remove the spring pin.

NOTE: Prevent the spring pin from dropping in the transmission using paper towel etc.

![](images/4893026b8206c4e84ed1a115af21ee6d43ddb99fbe949095dfba76fba6d6bc2e.jpg)

5) Remove the detent spring.

![](images/2da43b61751e1272857f1913a05845df4e8f00b1ad53e90fcb7fc2c44df7e2d8.jpg)

6) Remove the manual plate from the shifter arm shaft, and remove the shift connecting rod of the manual valve.

1) Face the O-ring side of the CVTF filter to the transmission case side, and install the CVTF filter. NOTE:

Apply CVTF to the O-ring of CVTF filter.

NOTE:

Use a new oil seal.

NOTE:

Use new O-rings.
Apply CVTF to the O-ring.

Tightening torque: T1: 13 N·m (1.3 kgf-m, 9.6 ft-lb) T2: 25 N·m (2.5 kgf-m, 18.4 ft-lb) T3: 50 N·m (5.1 kgf-m, 36.9 ft-lb)

Use a new bolt.

Check the transmission case for damage.
Check for leakage of CVTF from the connection between converter case and transmission case.
Check the bearing for smooth operation.
Check the bearing for seizure or wear.

Select the transfer driven gear shim. <Ref. to CVT(TR580)-183, ADJUSTMENT, Transfer Clutch.> Select the transfer drive gear shim. <Ref. to CVT(TR580)-197, ADJUSTMENT, Reduction Driven Gear.> Select the reduction drive gear shim. <Ref. to CVT(TR580)-221, ADJUSTMENT, Reduction Drive Gear.>

### 36.CVTF Filter

A: REMOVAL

• Although CVTF filter is a maintenance-free part, replace it if a large quantity of wear debris and metal particles are found in CVTF and CVTF filter. • For removal of CVTF filter, refer to “Transmission Case”. <Ref. to CVT(TR580)-205, REMOVAL, Transmission Case.> <Ref. to CVT(TR580)-211, DISASSEMBLY, Transmission Case.>

Check for broken part or damaged O-ring.

### D: ADJUSTMENT

1) Remove the retaining springs and reduction drive gear shims.
2) Install the transmission case, and secure it with four or five bolts.

Tightening torque: 22 N·m (2.2 kgf-m, 16.2 ft-lb)
3) Measure depth “A” from the ST upper face to the reduction drive gear end face.
ST 499575400 GAUGE

![](images/8d52ac131fef58d49bbeacb8a177dc1c7b463a9619e6a43eebcbc228d04f750f.jpg)

4) Raise and hold the reduction drive gear.

![](images/913255a4b26369e0ccfe2934ee0f0c6dcd300445992d818d38fe21908613eb7b.jpg)

AT-06720

5) Measure depth “B” from the ST upper face to the reduction drive gear end face. ST 499575400 GAUGE

![](images/632b29a105b9aa749c4fa540f8b744452fa4f376bb2e15f517cee28a3f7f5bf3.jpg)

6) Calculate the following formula.
T mm = A – B – 1.0
[T in = A – B – 0.039]
T: Moving distance of reduction drive gear
A: Depth from the ST upper face to the reduction drive gear end surface B: Depth from the ST upper face to the reduction drive gear end surface 1.0 mm (0.039 in): Thickness of spring retainer

![](images/638e78f317d1dc23ab0401910fc03c87d5eda4fe76b307a9907626b57e6d9f38.jpg)

7) Select one to three reduction drive gear shims so that the total thickness meets the value obtained from step 6).

![](images/f259362aeb818185524372233127a1f20f851650f7f931b6293d910f9cba2c1f.jpg)

2) Remove the air breather hose. <Ref. to CVT(TR580)-157, REMOVAL, Air Breather Hose.>

4) Remove the transmission harness. <Ref. to CVT(TR580)-125, REMOVAL, Transmission Harness.> 5) Remove the turbine speed sensor. <Ref. to CVT(TR580)-98, REMOVAL, Turbine Speed Sensor.> 6) Remove the secondary speed sensor. <Ref. to CVT(TR580)-100, REMOVAL, Secondary Speed Sensor.>
7) Remove the primary speed sensor. <Ref. to CVT(TR580)-102, REMOVAL, Primary Speed Sensor.> 8) Remove the inhibitor switch. <Ref. to CVT(TR580)-94, REMOVAL, Inhibitor Switch.>
9) Remove the extension case. <Ref. to CVT(TR580)-167, REMOVAL, Extension Case.>
10) Remove the transfer clutch assembly. <Ref. to CVT(TR580)-171, REMOVAL, Transfer Clutch.> 11) Remove the transfer driven gear assembly. <Ref. to CVT(TR580)-186, REMOVAL, Transfer Driven Gear.>
12) Remove the parking pawl. <Ref. to CVT(TR580)-189, REMOVAL, Parking Pawl.>
13) Remove the reduction driven gear assembly. <Ref. to CVT(TR580)-191, REMOVAL, Reduction Driven Gear.>
14) Remove the oil pan and oil strainer. <Ref. to CVT(TR580)-107, REMOVAL, Oil Pan and Strainer.> 15) Remove the transmission control device. <Ref. to CVT(TR580)-199, REMOVAL, Transmission Control Device.>
16) Remove the transmission case. <Ref. to CVT(TR580)-205, REMOVAL, Transmission Case.> 17) Remove the reduction drive gear. <Ref. to CVT(TR580)-218, REMOVAL, Reduction Drive Gear.> 18) Set the ST to secondary pulley, expand the V groove of pulley, and then completely loosen the variator chain.

### B: INSTALLATION

1) Select shims for pulley alignment. <Ref. to CVT(TR580)-237, ADJUSTMENT, Primary Pulley and Secondary Pulley.>
2) Install the seal ring to the input shaft.

NOTE:

Use a new seal ring.
When installing the seal ring, do not expand the seal ring too much.
Apply CVTF to the seal rings.

![](images/0bfb69edfbfa82fa115dccf0c03030cbf11a1d30791664a12ba32462077136a6.jpg)

3) Install the seal ring to drive pinion retainer.

NOTE:

Use a new seal ring.
Apply CVTF to the seal rings.

![](images/f3419d6509ed98b9fdd23445b4166c16405f4a2d2582864cb6386081a3090d36.jpg)

4) Install the selected shims to the primary pulley bearing catch surface.

5) Install the secondary pulley to the drive pinion retainer.

![](images/f8fb8fcc1516ec64ae649a901dc14886e73a76097549765e9958460f6e261a9f.jpg)

6) Install and tighten the secondary pulley securing bolts. (1) Tighten the three bolts until the seating surfaces contact the bearing retainer.
NOTE: Be careful not to tilt the bearing retainer of the secondary pulley. Apply CVTF to the bolt.

### C: INSPECTION

Check the surface of primary and secondary pulley cones for damage or wear.
Check the primary and secondary pulley for damage.
Check the bearing for seizure or wear.
Apply CVTF to bearing and rotate the bearing to check for noise or dragging etc.

### 1. PROCEDURE IN REPLACEMENT OF PRIMARY AND SECONDARY PULLEY, OR IN REPLACEMENT OF PRIMARY PULLEY, SE

1) Measure depth “Lp” from the ST upper face to the primary pulley bearing catch surface at several points and calculate the average.
ST 499575400 GAUGE

![](images/eb15810eef0ee432465a0c5ea4beeb6363fea136c5b1184a6db1bb2b64731b36.jpg)

2) Measure the depth “Ls” from the ST upper face to the secondary pulley bearing catch surface at several points and calculate the average.

![](images/e300208d211c39a281a0c70b674c0542e8b4c19a733ff4d6b576ef5fa2c83e14.jpg)

3) Calculate the following formula.
Calculation formula:
T (mm) = B – A + Lp – Ls – 28.602
[T (in) = B – A + Lp – Ls – 1.126]
T: Pulley alignment
A: Specified primary pulley dimension
B: Specified secondary pulley dimension
Lp: Depth from the ST upper face to the primary pulley bearing catch surface Ls: Depth from the ST upper face to the secondary pulley bearing catch surface 28.602 mm (1.126 in): Constant

![](images/01a861b6d9eabd4532181f27dd196422277124dfc2b0937daeacae1cce96bebd.jpg)

4) Select one to two shims so that the total thickness meets the value obtained from step 3).
![](images/4988cfa5bfaea2583a4cf296202b39e8c6aac2ecdb24eb9b814ca4802900f228.jpg)

### 2. PROCEDURE WHEN REPLACING ONLY DRIVE PINION RETAINER OR REVERSE BRAKEHOUSING

1) Clean the mating surface of current drive pinion retainer and converter case.
2) Measure and record the shim thickness that is attached on the current reverse brake housing. 3) Using the current drive pinion retainer, measure depth “Lp1” from the ST upper face to the primary pulley bearing catch surface at several points and calculate the average.

ST 499575400 GAUGE

![](images/75d95ecf72be333d91e53a7fa47927d14840738387c2b3b38134f036d7d4a2e7.jpg)

### Primary Pulley and Secondary Pulley

4) Using the current drive pinion retainer or current reverse brake housing, measure the depth “Ls1” from the ST upper face to the secondary pulley bearing catch surface at several points and calculate the average. ST 499575400 GAUGE

![](images/a025227ccd3bd94c6aab347400b16d50232d8afa1368543eeefcd95fdb1ca540.jpg)

5) Calculate the “LD1” using the following formula and record it.
Calculation formula:
LD1 mm (in) = Ls1 – Lp1
LD1: Height from the primary pulley bearing catch surface to the secondary pulley bearing catch surface Lp1: Depth from the ST upper face to the primary pulley bearing catch surface
Ls1: Depth from the ST upper face to the secondary pulley bearing catch surface
6) Using the new drive pinion retainer or new reverse brake housing, measure the depth “Lp2” from the S upper face to the primary pulley bearing catch surface at several points and calculate the average. ST 499575400 GAUGE

![](images/4584ac6974e662c3aa5c9eb8b7df6a2c82f32ed2db8e7a57d89f1b96f59901eb.jpg)

7) Using the new drive pinion retainer or new reverse brake housing, measure the depth “Ls2” from the ST upper face to the secondary pulley bearing catch surface at several points and calculate the average. ST 499575400 GAUGE

![](images/031406b25a3df0b502408042dd2b2910642fbb0bfc0f66ab54614fc593099332.jpg)

8) Calculate the “LD2” using the following formula and record it.
Calculation formula:
LD2 mm (in) = Ls2 – Lp2
LD2: Height from the primary pulley bearing catch surface to the secondary pulley bearing catch surface Lp2: Depth from the ST upper face to the primary pulley bearing catch surface
Ls2: Depth from the ST upper face to the secondary pulley bearing catch surface 9) Calculate the recorded values of “LD1” and “LD2” to obtain the positive number to select the shims. Calculation formula: T1 mm (in) = LD1 – LD2 or T2 mm (in) = LD2 – LD1
T1, T2: Difference between new drive pinion retainer or new reverse brake housing and current drive pinion retainer or current reverse brake housing
LD1: Calculated value of current drive pinion retainer or current reverse brake housing
LD2: Calculated value of new drive pinion retainer or new reverse brake housing

![](images/48b37ca21c82690e42fda92dc411d050bf28dcbe2d3b64ab2b7aab1d588d740d.jpg)

![](images/e9ad037eba401dc087925548269a9ca1e00a3b806367afad2c5bb70e41e09245.jpg)

![](images/dd14b15f0e75f846415f4c5d1cb5cd313310fbf2254dca476bfdb046fb7f1c09.jpg)

A: REMOVAL

For removal of variator chain, refer to “Primary Pulley and Secondary Pulley”. <Ref. to CVT(TR580)-223, REMOVAL, Primary Pulley and Secondary Pulley.>

B: INSTALLATION

For installation of variator chain, refer to “Primary Pulley and Secondary Pulley”. <Ref. to CVT(TR580)-230, INSTALLATION, Primary Pulley and Secondary Pulley.>
