### C: INSPECTION

Check the crossmember for bends or damage.
Check that the cushion rubber is not stiff, cracked or otherwise damaged.

### A: INSPECTION

Check for leakage of CVTF from the joint section of transmission and propeller shaft. If a leak is found, inspect the propeller shaft and replace the oil seal.

> ⚠️ **Внимание:** 
> Immediately after the vehicle has been running or after idling for a long time, the differential gear oil will be hot. Be careful not to burn yourself.
>
> 1) Lift up the vehicle.
> 2) Clean the transmission exterior.
> 3) Remove the center exhaust pipe. <Ref. to EX(H4DOTC)-30, REMOVAL, Center Exhaust Pipe.>
> 4) Remove the center exhaust cover.
>
> ![](images/1fdbed0c6f8c9066e0f564d0cfcb994b4dd53f3d1c06a74158b2e693f68eb591.jpg)
>
> 5) Remove the propeller shaft. <Ref. to DS-11, REMOVAL, Propeller Shaft.>
> 6) Using a screwdriver or ST, remove the oil seal trying not to damage the extension case. ST 398527700 PULLER ASSY
> 7) Using the ST, install the oil seal.
>
> NOTE:
>
> Use a new oil seal.
> ST 498057300 OIL SEAL DRIFT
> 8) Install the propeller shaft. <Ref. to DS-13, INSTALLATION, Propeller Shaft.>
>
> 9) Install the center exhaust cover.
>
> Tightening torque: 18 N·m (1.8 kgf-m, 13.3 ft-lb)
>
> ![](images/320be4c9a911822248295e424f43c58f401bae05cde61a7d749de948b19ff1be.jpg)
>
> 10) Install the center exhaust pipe. <Ref. to EX(H4DOTC)-35, INSTALLATION, Center Exhaust Pipe.>
> 11) Adjust the CVTF level and check there is no leakage. <Ref. to CVT(TR690)-36, ADJUSTMENT, CVTF.>

### A: INSPECTION

Check for leakage of gear oil from differential side retainer oil seal part. If there is an oil leak, inspect the front drive shaft and replace the oil seal.

### B: REPLACEMENT

CAUTION:

• Immediately after the vehicle has been running or after idling for a long time, the differential gear oil will be hot. Be careful not to burn yourself. • Be careful not to spill the differential gear oil on exhaust pipe to prevent it from emitting smoke or fire. If differential gear oil is spilled on the exhaust pipe, wipe it off completely.

1) Remove the front wheels.
2) Remove the center exhaust pipe. <Ref. to EX(H4DOTC)-30, REMOVAL, Center Exhaust Pipe.>
3) Remove the differential gear oil drain plug using TORX® bit T70, and then drain differential gear oil.

![](images/dde153fa7f794a266ab0d35260b445202ea4ea52a6d546223b8f81eecfa82037.jpg)

(A) Differential gear oil drain plug

4) Tighten the differential gear oil drain plug. NOTE:
Use a new gasket.

Tightening torque: 70 N·m (7.1 kgf-m, 51.6 ft-lb)

5) Remove the stabilizer link. <Ref. to FS-29, REMOVAL, Front Stabilizer.>
6) Disconnect the lower arm ball joint and housing.
7) Pull out the front drive shaft from transmission using a crowbar.

NOTE:

Place cloth between the tire lever or bar and the transmission in order to avoid damaging the transmission side retainer.
8) Holding the joint of front drive shaft from transmission side, pull out the drive shaft from transmission with care not to stretch the boot.

NOTE:

Before pulling RH front drive shaft from transmission, turn the steering wheel to left hand full lock. Before pulling LH front drive shaft from transmission, turn the steering wheel to right hand full lock. 9) Remove the differential side retainer oil seal using driver wrapped with vinyl tape etc.

### CVT(TR690)-88

10) Using the ST, install the differential side retainer oil seal by lightly tapping with a hammer. ST 18675AA000 DIFFERENTIAL SIDE OIL SEAL INSTALLER

NOTE:

Apply differential gear oil to the lip surface, so that the oil seal lip is not deformed.
Apply differential gear oil to the press-fitting surface of oil seal and the differential side retainer.
Oil seal has an identification mark (R, L). When installing oil seals, do not confuse the left and right.

![](images/bfcf392899ebae3314a29b9be1a7dbe3e4e4d30a885c9f63888a2e87c2ec55e0.jpg)

AT-05142

11) Set the ST to side retainer. ST 28399SA010 OIL SEAL PROTECTOR

2 B K A AT-07746

12) Replace the circlip of the drive shaft with a new part.
13) Insert the front drive shaft spline section into transmission and remove the ST (OIL SEAL PROTECTOR).
14) Insert the drive shaft into the transmission securely by pressing the housing from outside of the vehicle.

15) Insert the ball joint into housing and secure with bolt.

Tightening torque: 50 N·m (5.1 kgf-m, 36.9 ft-lb)

CAUTION:

• Do not apply grease to the tapered portion of ball stud.
• Before tightening, make sure the lower side of housing and stepped section of ball joint are in contact.
16) Install the stabilizer link.

Tightening torque: 60 N·m (6.1 kgf-m, 44.3 ft-lb)

17) Install the center exhaust pipe. <Ref. to EX(H4DOTC)-35, INSTALLATION, Center Exhaust Pipe.>
18) Lower the vehicle.
19) Refill differential gear oil from the charge pipe. <Ref. to CVT(TR690)-41, Differential Gear Oil.>
20) Adjust the differential gear oil level, and check for leakage. <Ref. to CVT(TR690)-41, ADJUSTMENT, Dif
ferential Gear Oil.>
21) Install the front wheels.

### A: INSPECTION

When the driving condition or starter motor operation is improper, first check the shift linkage for improper operation. If the shift linkage is functioning properly, check the inhibitor switch.
1) Remove the intercooler. <Ref. to IN(H4DOTC)-35, REMOVAL, Intercooler.>
2) Disconnect the inhibitor harness connector.

![](images/8405338e58cfc036d2fa5bfe849c78628e45949891ab9906187b7167df8e2419.jpg)

3) Check for continuity in inhibitor switch circuit by shifting the select lever in “P”, “R”, “N” and “D” respectively.

NOTE:

Check that there is no continuity in the starter circuit when the select lever is in the “R” and “D” ranges. When inhibitor switch is normal, check there is no poor contact in vehicle side connector and no open circuit in harness.

![](images/95603340679986a7a2e49f810041342a0efed2125efc12a6d1208d783c0898ac.jpg)

![](images/87f5c5177d8d5bcff67cce16c10dd1ffa900b759b38218be33cb17ebcca9c25f.jpg)

(A) Inhibitor harness connector

### Inhibitor Switch

4) Check that there is continuity at equal points when the select lever is moved 1.5° in both directions from the “N” range.
If there is continuity in only one direction or in other points, adjust the inhibitor switch. <Ref. to CVT(TR690)- 93, ADJUSTMENT, Inhibitor Switch.>

![](images/7452a128af67f94bdcd6f669278536bdb6f085e10a1bf8cdab1ddbb153d2b2c9.jpg)

(A) Continuity does not exist. (B) Continuity exists. (C) 1.5°

5) Repeat the above inspection in other gear ranges. If there is fault, adjust the inhibitor switch and select cable. <Ref. to CVT(TR690)-93, ADJUSTMENT, Inhibitor Switch.> <Ref. to CS-52, ADJUSTMENT, Select Cable.>

### B: ADJUSTMENT

1) Shift the select lever to “N” range.
2) Loosen the two bolts holding the inhibitor switch.
3) Insert the ST vertically into the holes of the shifter arm and switch body. ST 499267300 STOPPER PIN

![](images/69ea064d1b2071f97477302228a8bdf1f91f29104e82bf2600bcc09df5f8610e.jpg)

### CVT(TR690)-93

4) Tighten the two bolts holding the inhibitor switch.

Tightening torque: 5 N·m (0.5 kgf-m, 3.7 ft-lb)

5) Repeat the inspection of the inhibitor switch. If the inhibitor switch is determined to be “faulty”, replace it.

### C: REMOVAL

1) Shift the select lever to “N” range.
2) Disconnect the ground cable from battery.
3) Lift up the vehicle.
4) Remove the snap pin and washer from the shifter arm.

![](images/d09e5549c1926c72c4274471203149d048940c494e0d0062944b1fb38a07ccc8.jpg)

(A) Shifter arm (B) Snap pin (C) Select cable (D) Plate ASSY (E) Washer

### Inhibitor Switch

5) Using the ST, remove the spring pin and shifter arm. ST

![](images/ad87dc7a688681377930b69326a0a61e4895a633283777ae562916816398b259.jpg)

AT-07876

(A) Spring pin (B) Shifter arm

6) Remove the inhibitor harness connector from inhibitor switch.
7) Remove the two inhibitor switch securing bolts.

![](images/ef7f7623dece7b0c4dd12b072a30507cf0da7036e26cea6d983a9eef530a0c95.jpg)

AT-05688

8) Remove the inhibitor switch from the transmission case.

### D: INSTALLATION

1) Install the inhibitor switch to the transmission case temporarily.

![](images/bdb39f22859dbbd3f5c5a4ac0239ca200a1ed600b48815cd01eb71f21d61a779.jpg)

AT-05688

2) Connect the inhibitor harness connector to the inhibitor switch.
3) Install the shifter arm and fix with the spring pin.

NOTE: Use new spring pin.

![](images/4b175c25218b3758e3c4be6b9d9ac25b1f07a1766051fc363d684d29b97b9866.jpg)

AT-07876

(A) Spring pin (B) Shifter arm

4) Shift the shifter arm to “N” range.

### Inhibitor Switch

5) Install the ST vertically in the cutout of shifter arm and the hole of switch body. ST 499267300 STOPPER PIN

![](images/348a646ac4a3026d59db4a3ba9b0134e6a6e39b91dd23e38e7ef744da2b1188c.jpg)

6) Tighten the two bolts holding the inhibitor switch.

Tightening torque: 5 N·m (0.5 kgf-m, 3.7 ft-lb)

7) Install the select cable to the shifter arm.
8) Install the washer and snap pin to the shifter arm.

![](images/9d43b57697a8bff4b02cebe93ed031abebab0f8a53c0172db8ba85e128deea69.jpg)

(A) Shifter arm (B) Snap pin (C) Select cable (D) Plate ASSY (E) Washer

9) Lower the vehicle.
10) Connect the battery ground terminal.
11) Check the inhibitor switch. <Ref. to CVT(TR690)-91, INSPECTION, Inhibitor Switch.>

### 16.Secondary Speed Sensor

A: REMOVAL

CAUTION:
Be sure to prevent water or oil from contacting the connector terminal of secondary speed sensor. If adhesion occurs, replace with a new part. 1) Remove the transmission from the vehicle. <Ref. to CVT(TR690)-55, REMOVAL, Automatic Transmission Assembly.>
2) Remove the transmission cover on the transmission upper side.

![](images/2b1b7cb5fe8f8b9460c1f8e482269b2370cac17c6f3e0140b16d96d4d370b80e.jpg)

3) Remove the secondary speed sensor harness connector.
4) Remove the

AT-06554

### B: INSTALLATION

CAUTION:

Be sure to prevent water or oil from contacting the connector terminal of secondary speed sensor. If adhesion occurs, replace with a new part.

Install in the reverse order of removal.

NOTE: Use new O-rings. Apply CVTF to the O-ring.

Tightening torque: Secondary speed sensor 5 N·m (0.5 kgf-m, 3.7 ft-lb) Transmission cover 8 N·m (0.8 kgf-m, 5.9 ft-lb)

### C: INSPECTION

1) Set the probe of oscilloscope to TCM harness connector.

Connector & terminal (B54) No. 7 (+) — No. 14 (–):

![](images/890f762fcf2a1934bf8cb73fe9c2dad7dd6c8486ad1272994290dbb8e43cf38d.jpg)

(A) + probe (B) – probe

2) Start and warm up the engine.

3) Check the waveform of secondary speed sensor with engine idling.

The waveform cycle changes as the speed changes.

![](images/1331378ae1204571f0e1a4f99339b7381bf241f44cc4e78a2e2533035f1672b9.jpg)

AT-08035

### 17.Primary Speed Sensor

A: REMOVAL

CAUTION:

Be sure to prevent water or oil from contacting the connector terminal of primary speed sensor. If adhesion occurs, replace with a new part.

1) Disconnect the ground cable from battery.
2) Remove the intercooler. <Ref. to IN(H4DOTC)-35, REMOVAL, Intercooler.>
3) Clean the transmission exterior.
4) Remove the primary speed sensor harness connector.

![](images/ec3ded90b447bf66fe98b359e7189696921b60c7679643f2c5da2bf661b39a9d.jpg)

5) Remove the primary speed sensor and the spacer.

![](images/d0bbfc03eb938f71624b5994ebcbda742bea5f5c47d6b0b9f46ef8ade838e012.jpg)

### B: INSTALLATION

CAUTION:

Be sure to prevent water or oil from contacting the connector terminal of primary speed sensor. If adhesion occurs, replace with a new part.

Install in the reverse order of removal.

NOTE: Use new O-rings. Apply CVTF to the O-ring.

Tightening torque: Primary speed sensor 5 N·m (0.5 kgf-m, 3.7 ft-lb)

### C: INSPECTION

1) Set the probe of oscilloscope to TCM harness connector.

Connector & terminal (B54) No. 6 (+) — No. 14 (–):

![](images/62a0d77f2ba2201f18545beda5d597f50b6607d0e55ce75f09bfffaeebd2374b.jpg)

(A) + probe (B) – probe

2) Start and warm up the engine.

3) Check the waveform of primary speed sensor with engine idling. NOTE: The waveform cycle changes as the speed changes.

![](images/eca4d5c685ac1195c71cc7d65aa0a74c71746d8480793dc8d7f531a576cb2cd9.jpg)

AT-08034

### 18.Front Wheel Speed Sensor

A: REMOVAL

CAUTION:

• Be sure to prevent water or oil from contacting the connector terminal of front wheel speed sensor. If adhesion occurs, replace with a new part.
• When removing front wheel speed sensor, CVTF may let out. If CVTF has leaked, adjust the CVTF level after installing the front wheel speed sensor.

1) Disconnect the ground cable from battery.
2) Lift up the vehicle.
3) Clean the transmission exterior.
4) Remove the front wheel speed sensor harness connector.
5) Remove the front wheel speed sensor.

![](images/e889b26be344104ad7a151e749cc27967b562bfbefb6ff8c237c03ebb82c8a76.jpg)

### B: INSTALLATION

CAUTION:

• Be sure to prevent water or oil from contacting the connector terminal of front wheel speed sensor.
If adhesion occurs, replace with a new part.
• After installing the front wheel speed sensor, adjust the CVTF level.
Install in the reverse order of removal.

NOTE:

Use new O-rings.
Apply CVTF to the O-ring.

Tightening torque: 5 N·m (0.5 kgf-m, 3.7 ft-lb)

### C: INSPECTION

1) Set the probe of oscilloscope to TCM harness connector.

Connector & terminal (B54) No. 20 (+) — No. 14 (–):

![](images/f46005d97f7f90a2480d35c1c40c35ba407f6b607e88ecca58c66078bae5b29c.jpg)

(A) + probe (B) – probe

2) Lift up the vehicle and raise the vehicle speed up to 20 km/h (12 MPH).
3) Check the waveform of front wheel speed sensor when vehicle speed is at 20 km/h (12 MPH).

NOTE:

The waveform cycle changes as the speed changes.

![](images/06c9d869bbd958c28da42a95f9e14970da80077dc9e3c1b38f3388473856ba6a.jpg)

AT-08036

### 19.Secondary Pressure Sensor

A: REMOVAL

CAUTION:

• Be sure to prevent water or oil from contacting the connector terminal of secondary pressure sensor. If adhesion occurs, replace with a new part.

• When removing secondary pressure sensor, CVTF may let out. If CVTF has leaked, adjust the CVTF level after installing the secondary pressure sensor.

1) Disconnect the ground cable from battery.
2) Lift up the vehicle.
3) Clean the transmission exterior.
4) Remove the secondary pressure sensor harness connector.
5) Remove the secondary pressure sensor.

NOTE:

Use Ko-ken 3/8 12-point 27 mm (manufacturer product No. 3305M-27) deep socket.

![](images/aa2d53f097e80f5f54595c46c9ea7fe713940e46a35121f249243db13af1db3f.jpg)

### B: INSTALLATION

CAUTION:

• Be sure to prevent water or oil from contacting the connector terminal of secondary pressure sensor. If adhesion occurs, replace with a new part.
• After installing the secondary pressure sensor, adjust the CVTF level.
Install in the reverse order of removal

NOTE: Use new O-rings.

Tightening torque: 39 N·m (4.0 kgf-m, 28.8 ft-lb)

### C: INSPECTION

NOTE:

Leave it for 10 minutes or more after the engine stops, and then perform the inspection.
1) Check that the CVTF temperature is 10 — 80°C (50 — 176°F) using the Subaru Select Monitor.
2) Check the power supply voltage of the secondary pressure sensor.

Connector & terminal (B54) No. 2 (+) — No. 15 (–):

Standard 4.8 — 5.2 V

![](images/67b18fd4fad23d4d803c039b5eedbb7c1f6a421f02d80f3f0e3ac70df1ba65f6.jpg)

3) Check the voltage of the secondary pressure sensor.

Connector & terminal (B54) No. 17 (+) — No. 15 (–):

Standard 0.45 — 0.55 V

![](images/f7114cc7a380d9a4d03920018930ea38fdda34553fa897038320f3c2fa867b45.jpg)

### 20.Control Valve Body

A: REMOVAL

CAUTION:

• Directly after the vehicle has been running or the engine has been idling for a long time, the CVTF is hot. Be careful not to burn yourself.
• Be careful not to spill CVTF on the exhaust pipe to prevent it from emitting smoke or causing a fire. If the CVTF adheres, wipe it off completely.

NOTE:

The control valve body is replaced as an assembly only, because it is a non-disassembly part.

1) Disconnect the ground cable from battery.
2) Lift up the vehicle.
3) Clean the transmission exterior.
4) Remove the CVTF drain plug to drain CVTF.

![](images/d2e60f8c57f0ce74a0eb335e8bd6b52c3d8c8beb014b6593c94c24b8e04cb2c2.jpg)

(A) CVTF drain plug

5) Install the CVTF drain plug.

NOTE: Use a new gasket.

Tightening torque: 39.2 N·m (4.0 kgf-m, 28.9 ft-lb)

6) Remove the oil pan.

CAUTION: Be careful not to allow foreign matter such as dust or dirt to enter the oil pan.

![](images/14d0f0dc943ffd26f7b2a0c7711f5f32eaa466a630e33036646eb04dc315175d.jpg)

7) Remove the magnet.
8) Disconnect the control valve harness connector.

![](images/0a1dc31cab5c8f17a404e07287ee757ce02b548478eac4fcfd1edb626caa633b.jpg)

9) Remove the oil strainer.

![](images/fa3ef6403d26e1b28aee2deb8e80778d29c356d412a70bb1abafb9fcf2cc1314.jpg)

AT-07379

10) Remove the control valve body.

CAUTION: Do not let the manual valve drop off.

![](images/085c6670fd3e5d4d566b50ad919e3e523e6d8fff5377a780f30dd6fecdbb25c5.jpg)

AT-05166

11) Remove the pressure pipe.

NOTE: It may be located in transmission case side.

![](images/13c681b8a998c6b396a8f4e26f014693f36a397b8d35bbe91ea3dbc662eac5a7.jpg)

12) Remove the O-ring from oil strainer.

![](images/5533b33145ba802426a2a33e86176b9d749beb433211a39d83bcd0702068a2dc.jpg)

13) Remove the O-ring from pressure pipe.

![](images/6146a9c8d45e6f287db1c3d9bf38dea3bd6fcb36083d5c4303751bbd17536f03.jpg)

### B: INSTALLATION

1) Clean the mating surface of oil pan and transmission case.
2) Check the control valve body for dust and other foreign matter.
3) Install the O-ring to the pressure pipe.

NOTE:

Use new O-rings.
Apply CVTF to the O-ring.

![](images/ba9ac7f813fbae196409b364e3fd54d78ac6cd6c7cc2542de41e32475f4aca78.jpg)

AT-05190

4) Install the pressure pipe.

![](images/40352ec62e562d0adfc0fe703a3dcf6403fcc72ebda5ea04d8c08a2cc3ba73b0.jpg)

5) Install the control valve body to the transmission.

CAUTION:

• Beware of the transmission harness getting caught in between. Do not impact or bend the transmission harness because it has the oil temperature sensor inside.

NOTE:

Engage the manual valve to the manual plate.
Lead the transmission harness through from the point indicated by dashed line in the figure.

Tightening torque: 9 N·m (0.9 kgf-m, 6.6 ft-lb)

![](images/ab6a8e315a465f35e79a07a562f7fea9eaa373b9cd02d39eb22f875b3da49d9f.jpg)

(A) Short bolt (11 pcs) (B) Long bolt (1 pcs)

6) Install the O-ring to oil strainer and install the oil strainer.

NOTE:

Use new O-rings.
Apply CVTF to the O-ring.
Let the transmission harness run between control valve body and oil strainer.

Tightening torque: 9 N·m (0.9 kgf-m, 6.6 ft-lb)

![](images/46422dafb63ab1e66c324e367fbc22c34b9dde540d747f6b6ed2f5f1be946139.jpg)

AT-07379

7) Connect the control valve harness connector.

![](images/c4cb8403fe29638ad90738694267a7c9e330d1343484e399caed93c356cd0366.jpg)

8) Clean the magnet.

9) Attach the magnet at the specified position of the oil pan.

![](images/cb34b9100b069963218e293a7acac573a0fed3d55559c428e33887c29cd7eeee.jpg)

10) Apply liquid gasket all around the oil pan mating surface seamlessly.

Liquid gasket: THREE BOND 1217B (Part No. K0877YA020) or equivalent

![](images/df28ca7552b1d5b89dd96f73177c170ae5e0ffe2e8b142853881e2bb0067b008.jpg)

AT-07758

11) Install the oil pan by equally tightening the bolts.

CAUTION: Beware of the transmission harness getting caught in between.

Tightening torque: 5 N·m (0.5 kgf-m, 3.7 ft-lb)

![](images/c2c0b5c3568db0387f5fdb6e3b3861a5a54c1fa5591762e399259a86c8ae2e3f.jpg)

12) Connect the battery ground terminal.
13) Fill with CVTF. <Ref. to CVT(TR690)-38, REPLACEMENT, CVTF.>
14) Adjust the CVTF level. <Ref. to CVT(TR690)-36, ADJUSTMENT, CVTF.>

### C: INSPECTION

Check each part for damage or dust.
Check oil strainer for clogging.
Measure the resistance of each solenoid.

NOTE: Measurement should be performed at a temperature of 20°C (68°F).

![](images/fe2fe75de2e042ed1bed0bbd612cb1913571f2402c8c2cad543f197590dd246e.jpg)

AT-07380
![](images/359ed544bcfa561231fec22148077b5b71cbf0a483d8d93c8ba22672ea8c1645.jpg)

CVT(TR690)-117

### 21.Transmission Harness

A: REMOVAL

1) Remove the transmission from the vehicle. <Ref. to CVT(TR690)-55, REMOVAL, Automatic Transmission Assembly.>
2) Prepare for overhaul. <Ref. to CVT(TR690)-135, Preparation for Overhaul.>
3) Remove the transmission harness ground terminal and remove the harness connectors from front wheel speed sensor and secondary speed sensor.

![](images/cbfd486b3c8d3d9c9dc22ee890e17555077a49353456c4186f7f151b24da105c.jpg)

4) Remove the harness connectors from inhibitor switch, primary speed sensor and secondary pressure sensor.

![](images/cf42362b6d553322d6c266b03cf7e8aa5428f62045cc9f51270efd69bac58fc0.jpg)

5) Remove the transmission harness stay.

![](images/b9bf24a8683e4d80536103aaa508118a7c0eef3ecabbb27206584b9140ec11d3.jpg)

6) Remove transmission harness connector and inhibitor harness connector from harness stay. 7) Remove the control valve body. <Ref. to CVT(TR690)-108, REMOVAL, Control Valve Body.> 8) Remove the mounting bolt to pull out the bushing of transmission harness from transmission case round hole.

![](images/99af70b187b0282253e51ea0a972a415e10b00925882d6ffa8e4a67a98e9ab07.jpg)

9) Remove the harness clip from transmission assembly.

### B: INSTALLATION

Install in the reverse order of removal.

NOTE:

Use new O-rings.
Do not impact or bend the transmission harness because it has the oil temperature sensor inside.
Install the transmission ground terminal at an approximately 45° angle (A).

Tightening torque: T1: 5 N·m (0.5 kgf-m, 3.7 ft-lb) T2: 16 N·m (1.6 kgf-m, 11.8 ft-lb)

![](images/aa997c50acc4cf36ffd734a9af74eda7148b758213def49dcb63d69f22bcf9a2.jpg)

### C: INSPECTION

1) Visually check the harness and connector for damage or crack.
2) Check the harness terminal for rust, disconnection or poor contact.
3) Check the continuity between harness terminals and oil temperature sensor.

NOTE:
Refer to WIRING SECTION for transmission harness terminal and oil temperature sensor terminal. <Ref. to
WI-144, WIRING DIAGRAM, CVT Control System.>

Harness continuity standard Less than 1  Oil temperature sensor standard Approx. 2.6 k(at 20°C)

### A: REMOVAL

1) Disconnect the ground cable from battery.
2) Remove the cover - shift lever. <Ref. to EI-65, REMOVAL, Console Box.>
3) Remove the screws which secure the X mode switch from the cover - shift lever.

![](images/7b174d42e1e3385280ec4409d0f1ba7126561fbd08b03263beb7193cfc801426.jpg)

4) Disconnect the connector from the cover shift lever and remove the X mode switch.

![](images/ab26a85f0bc4646918ac61bd6012d68aea3945ced2ead7f3c893a5c2f75a9a31.jpg)

Measure the resistance between harness connector terminals of the X MODE switch.

![](images/c0915b8cc8d08cc13f6dcfd9bf76bbe11a850dac48bc8a62d815d9b962d389d7.jpg)

![](images/3d2d5341ae3e8808317a145b6fa4c6a98f92457e1ff8b3d5882b93fb39a3123f.jpg)

Refer to “CVT (TR580)” section for X mode system inspection. <Ref. to CVT(TR580)-139, CHECK X MODE SYSTEM, INSPECTION, X MODE Switch.>

### 24.CVTF Cooler (With Warmer Function)

A: REMOVAL

CAUTION:

If the CVTF and engine coolant is spilt over exhaust pipe, wipe it off with cloth to avoid emitting smoke or causing a fire.

1) Disconnect the ground cable from battery.
2) Drain engine coolant. <Ref. to CO(H4DOTC)-13, REPLACEMENT, Engine Coolant.>
3) Remove the intercooler. <Ref. to IN(H4DOTC)-35, REMOVAL, Intercooler.>
4) Remove the harness clip from the CVTF cooler bracket.

![](images/2a9c9f591abfb0d745fa0af670fbc54fc5af0d086dee07184d693f42d52a740d.jpg)

5) Remove the engine coolant outlet hose, engine coolant inlet hose, CVTF inlet hose and CVTF outlet hose.

![](images/3221ec351750806a79cf0462ee3523aa9ee0a7889ce812391f45c585a95dfc92.jpg)

6) Remove the CVTF cooler (with warmer feature) from the transmission.

![](images/247494e3d494ca23a79d40cfa3abb3e858afd5f2d51fd058aba706a58867491d.jpg)

7) Remove the intake manifold, EGR valve, and the insulator. <Ref. to FU(H4DOTC)-19, REMOVAL, Intake Manifold.> <Ref. to EC(H4DOTC)-29, REMOVAL, EGR Control Valve.>
8) Disconnect the engine coolant inlet hose.

![](images/0bb853efb8c5e4f32bbbfcfe07cba125e1959569323113da1b7bf35660dd5dbb.jpg)

### B: INSTALLATION

1) Connect the engine coolant inlet hose.

NOTE: When installing the engine coolant inlet hose, the triangle marking should face upward.

![](images/ec3927a3ce6e55ebf4ae4231d964455caaa6b9602a4bbd6d07cab6d9c2bac671.jpg)

2) Install the insulator, EGR valve, and the intake manifold. <Ref. to FU(H4DOTC)-29, INSTALLATION, Intake Manifold.> <Ref. to EC(H4DOTC)-30, INSTALLATION, EGR Control Valve.>
3) Replace the CVTF inlet hose and the outlet hose.
4) Install the CVTF cooler (with warmer feature) to the transmission.

Tightening torque: 23 N·m (2.3 kgf-m, 17.0 ft-lb)

![](images/e7329c58e6a587b9fe2841f1008cf3ab45c73b3acef7c4cd0cd666cca709127b.jpg)

5) Install the engine coolant outlet hose, engine coolant inlet hose, CVTF inlet hose and CVTF outlet hose. NOTE:
Use new CVTF hoses.

![](images/96b39588acbe41ab5154ef466151db9a74120e0ce57d6ad0ca218f9c0a864f1c.jpg)

6) Install the harness clip to the CVTF cooler bracket.

![](images/dda3d6b2bcbdd8cba24957e24c6c4e1ad90373cb25d9ce54fb56320533a71a39.jpg)

7) Install the intercooler. <Ref. to IN(H4DOTC)-37, INSTALLATION, Intercooler.>
8) Connect the battery ground terminal.
9) Fill engine coolant. <Ref. to CO(H4DOTC)-13, REPLACEMENT, Engine Coolant.>
10) Adjust the CVTF level. <Ref. to CVT(TR690)-36, ADJUSTMENT, CVTF.>

### C: DISASSEMBLY

1) Remove the hoses from the CVTF cooler (with warmer feature).

![](images/888f430fc6bbe2b7c124bec80d7636a3dd8d8cd6237fbc32f9b525a1c4e77ac2.jpg)

(A) CVTF cooler outlet hose (B) CVTF cooler inlet hose (C) Engine coolant outlet hose

2) Remove the bracket from the CVTF cooler (with warmer feature).

![](images/66062b7d6141b7e64f0c047d37c145d62fccbef5386ba50d4c170a7701ff1819.jpg)

### D: ASSEMBLY

1) Attach the bracket.

Tightening torque: 23 N·m (2.3 kgf-m, 17.0 ft-lb)

![](images/375d42a7bf0ff79b8c419e3a642211a07010ebf673df2f01eb00d0b2b49543a3.jpg)

AT-07842

2) Attach hoses to the CVTF cooler (with warmer feature).

NOTE:

Use a new CVTF cooler hose.
Install so that the CVTF cooler hose is not folded over, excessively bent or twisted.
Insert the CVTF cooler hose to the specified position in the proper direction.

![](images/f076dd63ab01cd06f66d023ae38feb69100650a21d1f10f7bcb9f9db19ead7e2.jpg)

AT-07843

(A) CVTF cooler outlet hose (B) CVTF cooler inlet hose (C) Engine coolant outlet hose

### E: INSPECTION

Replace any faulty CVTF cooler hoses, CVTF cooler pipes and clamps found in the inspection below.

1) Check that there are no CVTF or engine coolant leaks from the connections.
2) Check the clamp for deformation.
3) Lightly bend the CVTF cooler hose and check for cracks in the surface or other damages.
4) Pinch the CVTF cooler hose with your fingers and check for poor elasticity. Also check for poor elasticity
in the parts where the clamp was installed by pressing with your fingernail.
5) Check for peeling, cracks, and deformation at the tip of the hose.
6) Check the CVTF cooler (with warmer feature) for any damage.

### 25.Air Breather Hose

A: REMOVAL

1) Remove the intercooler. <Ref. to IN(H4DOTC)-35, REMOVAL, Intercooler.>
2) Remove the two air breather hoses.

![](images/9ff5b7fffa805374f61ba9dfa42087ee73a776ea0addd959a746bcee3a45db1f.jpg)

3) Remove the oil cap.

![](images/84b8883377f543dd6d9670f5d53e8bdb869873c28b8ab552b7e07139b83c38a0.jpg)

### C: INSPECTION

Check the hose for peeling, crack or clogging.
Check the oil cap is not cracked or clogged.
Check O-ring of oil cap is not damaged.

### A: REMOVAL

1) Remove the transmission assembly from the vehicle. <Ref. to CVT(TR690)-55, REMOVAL, Automatic Transmission Assembly.>
2) Set the ST.

### ST 498497300 CRANKSHAFT STOPPER

![](images/b3c76edf93119c7cd4cbe0ed6125a55e85f9609534b25f1d3a0314b521af743b.jpg)

3) Remove the drive plate and reinforcement drive plate.

### B: INSTALLATION

1) Temporarily install the drive plate and reinforcement drive plate.
2) Set the ST.

ST 498497300 CRANKSHAFT STOPPER

![](images/23793bb858e3922044bfb649502cee1b37aface4aa58b18c63a7c5be287d0a6f.jpg)

AT-07762

3) Tighten the drive plate mounting bolt in two stages.
NOTE:
Fix the engine unit. (1) Tighten the drive plate mounting bolt.

Tightening torque: 30 N·m (3.1 kgf-m, 22.1 ft-lb) (2) While checking the tightening angle with the angle gauge, tighten the drive plate mounting bolts to the specified angle.

Tightening angle: 30° — 35°
4) Install the transmission assembly to the vehicle. <Ref. to CVT(TR690)-68, INSTALLATION, Automatic
Transmission Assembly.>

### B: PROCEDURE

1) Clean the transmission exterior.
2) Remove the torque converter assembly. <Ref. to CVT(TR690)-136, REMOVAL, Torque Converter Assembly.>
3) Attach the ST on the transmission.
ST 18632AA000 STAND ASSY

![](images/10bc7b98297656971c2f9a01cfb04b3d91bfa69fa9f87dba80192682158eb98c.jpg)

4) Remove the transmission cover on the transmission upper side.

NOTE: Install using the following tightening torque.

Tightening torque: 8 N·m (0.8 kgf-m, 5.9 ft-lb)

![](images/d7232b670164d95a0b385acf5b30eb434b9592413ed7eccae8e9caed44a83fc9.jpg)

5) Place the transmission assembly on end.

### 28.Torque Converter Assembly

A: REMOVAL

1) Remove the transmission assembly from the vehicle. <Ref. to CVT(TR690)-55, REMOVAL, Automatic Transmission Assembly.>
2) Pull out the torque converter assembly horizontally.

CAUTION: Do not scratch the inside of engaging parts.

![](images/d89c1d3cd13ecb9308371fd66def5a7133b77b5f7423258fd0a460d5a3fcd31c.jpg)

3) Remove the O-ring from the front reduction drive gear.

### B: INSTALLATION

1) Install the O-ring to front reduction drive gear.

NOTE:

Use new O-rings.
Apply CVTF to the O-ring.

2) While holding the torque converter assembly by hand, carefully install it into the torque converter case.

NOTE:

Apply CVTF to the oil seal lip. Do not damage the oil seal and O-ring. 3) Engage the splines while gently rotating the torque converter assembly by hand, and securely insert the assembly.

4) Measure depth “A”, from converter case end surface to drive plate contacting surface.

Standard (reference): 6.8 mm (0.268 in) or less

![](images/70eb37dbc75bb5769c744fbbcf1320ed0170bbdc065b102d5a70f036d745cf82.jpg)

5) Install the transmission assembly to the vehicle. <Ref. to CVT(TR690)-68, INSTALLATION, Automatic Transmission Assembly.>

### C: INSPECTION

Check the protrusion of torque converter center (front boss) is not deformed or damaged.
Check the ring gear and exterior for break or damage.

### 29.Extension Case

A: REMOVAL

1) Remove the transmission assembly from the vehicle. <Ref. to CVT(TR690)-55, REMOVAL, Automatic Transmission Assembly.>
2) Remove the front wheel speed sensor. <Ref. to CVT(TR690)-104, REMOVAL, Front Wheel Speed Sensor.>
3) Remove the harness clip, and remove the extension case.

NOTE:

The total number of extension case mounting bolts is 10.

![](images/ad5f4213c9a514dc694347aa33f1a36a74e22b16cc95f6d5437534fd7dfc79f9.jpg)

### B: INSTALLATION

1) Clean the mating surface of the extension case and intermediate case.
2) Select the thrust needle bearing. <Ref. to CVT(TR690)-143, ADJUSTMENT, Rear Drive Shaft.>
3) Select the shim for transfer reduction driven gear. <Ref. to CVT(TR690)-161, ADJUSTMENT, Transfer
Reduction Driven Gear.>
4) Install the selected thrust needle bearing to transfer clutch assembly.

NOTE: Install the thrust needle bearing in the correct direction.

![](images/2f6f1ad393cfdf1e5cf2a58552ada9c25aa42ddbcacc4e616a8a172705dbf917.jpg)

5) Attach the selected shim to transfer reduction driven gear assembly.
6) Apply liquid gasket to extension case seamlessly.

Liquid gasket: THREE BOND 1215 (Part No. 004403007) or equivalent

![](images/8ff7f254bd0f42f8fce2fd267aa01477fc698b09086c22eb0a54d5145d59df15.jpg)

7) Install the extension case.

Tightening torque: 25 N·m (2.5 kgf-m, 18.4 ft-lb)

![](images/ae574e41261dff805a49672833afdeee7824319f9006be6b2855d553ed4f89e9.jpg)

8) Install the front wheel speed sensor. <Ref. to CVT(TR690)-104, INSTALLATION, Front Wheel Speed Sensor.>
9) Install the transmission assembly. <Ref. to CVT(TR690)-68, INSTALLATION, Automatic Transmission Assembly.>

### C: DISASSEMBLY

1) Remove the dust cover from extension case.
2) Remove the extension case oil seal from the extension case.

### D: ASSEMBLY

1) Press-fit the dust cover into extension case. 2) Install the extension case oil seal to extension case. ST 498057300 INSTALLER

### E: INSPECTION

Check there is no leak of CVTF from the joint between extension case and intermediate case.
Check there is no damage or cracks on the extension case.

### F: ADJUSTMENT

NOTE:

When replacing the extension case, select the shims for rear drive shaft thrust needle bearing and transfer reduction driven gear. <Ref. to CVT(TR690)-143, ADJUSTMENT, Rear Drive Shaft.> <Ref. to CVT(TR690)- 161, ADJUSTMENT, Transfer Reduction Driven Gear.>

### A: REMOVAL

1) Remove the transmission assembly from the vehicle. <Ref. to CVT(TR690)-55, REMOVAL, Automatic Transmission Assembly.>
2) Remove the extension case. <Ref. to CVT(TR690)-138, REMOVAL, Extension Case.>
3) Remove the rear drive shaft.

![](images/99d122bb8db9691610369ce85206415c0925085d4cdab7e305c34e0cca8ab0b1.jpg)

### B: INSTALLATION

1) Select the thrust needle bearing. <Ref. to CVT(TR690)-143, ADJUSTMENT, Rear Drive Shaft.>
2) Install the selected thrust needle bearing to transfer clutch assembly.

NOTE: Install the thrust needle bearing in the correct direction.

![](images/43515febec7c049e1150fa34b46da7006daf3d65a7aa4daf0971811090653018.jpg)

3) Install the rear drive shaft.

![](images/9271545ed970ed60d23cf0b309c258a9d5e434b50b657ed1237fa92f16ecd78a.jpg)

4) Install the extension case. <Ref. to CVT(TR690)-139, INSTALLATION, Extension Case.> 5) Install the transmission assembly to the vehicle. <Ref. to CVT(TR690)-68, INSTALLATION, Automatic Transmission Assembly.>

### C: DISASSEMBLY

1) Remove the ball bearing using ST. ST 498077600 REMOVER

![](images/c79564936b6cbc640f1e3bd61839c3ab28affdcbade0c6e666be106dab95e883.jpg)

### D: ASSEMBLY

1) Using the ST, install the ball bearing.

NOTE:

Use a new ball bearing. Apply CVTF to press -fitting surface of ball bearing. ST 399513600 INSTALLER

![](images/311716ddf6fa554e1925e52e6017676e22f8088f2d652e2b457a0bf5f0bbdc7a.jpg)

### E: INSPECTION

Check each part for crack, damage or dust.
Check the ball bearing for smooth rotation.
Check the ball bearing for excessive looseness.

### F: ADJUSTMENT

NOTE:

When replacing the rear drive shaft or bearing, select the thrust needle bearing. 1) Using the ST, measure the distance “A” from ST end face to rear drive shaft thrust needle bearing catch surface.

ST 398643600 GAUGE

![](images/2722df2b69814e243ba637fcf1426771979c85b5239b96a17ee63eea58d71595.jpg)

2) Using the ST, measure the height “B” from the intermediate case mating surface to the ST end face. NOTE:
Place the measurement tool at the dent on ST upper side to measure.
ST 499737100 PULLER SET

![](images/16fa09808095227ba70465fc014062a6438f7590d1e0360a66a2f0e4df763aff.jpg)

3) Using the ST, measure the height “C” from ST end face to transfer clutch assembly thrust needle bearing catch surface.

NOTE:

Place the measurement tool at the dent on ST upper side to measure. ST 499737100 PULLER SET

![](images/a462b533be3377b22609773bd5a8b21e6c31faecf9fef0ffb16883f11fd46de5.jpg)

### Rear Drive Shaft

4) Obtain the thickness of thrust bearing using the following formula to select the thrust bearing. T mm = (A – 15) – (B – C) – (0.05 — 0.25)
[T in = (A – 0.591) – (B – C) 1 (0.002 — 0.01)]
T: Thrust bearing thickness
A: Height from the ST end face to the rear drive shaft thrust needle bearing catch surface B: Height from the mating surface of the intermediate case to the ST end face
C: Height from the ST end face to the transfer clutch assembly thrust needle bearing catch surface 15 mm (0.591 in): Thickness of ST
0.05 — 0.25 mm (0.002 — 0.01 in): Clearance

![](images/be3d2c80f2529f7624f42663c2a045c2a795d72b40af67885c1e5808413cff83.jpg)

### 31.Transfer Clutch

A: REMOVAL

1) Remove the transmission assembly from the vehicle. <Ref. to CVT(TR690)-55, REMOVAL, Automatic Transmission Assembly.>

2) Remove the extension case. <Ref. to CVT(TR690)-138, REMOVAL, Extension Case.>
3) Remove the rear drive shaft. <Ref. to CVT(TR690)-141, REMOVAL, Rear Drive Shaft.>

### Transfer Clutch

1) Apply CVTF to the seal ring and attach it to the seal ring groove of transfer clutch assembly. NOTE:

![](images/39433a0f67da39e835052683095d63b49bd37f4bbd56c1d1416ed7ada81a5727.jpg)

![](images/4e5b2703dec83abb05652e4b96cf1a90603f6c45a5a9a22a76e30cd4d332030f.jpg)

5) Install the rear drive shaft. <Ref. to CVT(TR690)-141, Rear Drive Shaft.>

Transmission Assembly.>

### C: DISASSEMBLY

1) Remove the snap ring, and then remove the retaining plate, drive plate and driven plate.

AT-07912

(A) Snap ring

ST2 18767AA000 BEARING REMOVER

### D: ASSEMBLY

1) Using the ST, install the parking gear to transfer reduction drive gear. ST 398177700 INSTALLER

![](images/d318abd9dba1b0d1579f2fec2cada1d5a44fc189bd7f370eea119bb88b51d64a.jpg)

(A) Snap ring (B) Transfer clutch piston seal

![](images/6136e2f7da65217c5b15815f1b9e287ba4cf6923f8694ea7224bc747881ad187.jpg)

(A) Snap ring

10) Before measuring clearance “A”, place same thickness shims on both sides to prevent the retaining plate from tilting.

### Transfer Clutch

11) When clearance “A” exceeds the limit for use, replace the drive plate and driven plate as a set, and select and adjust the pressure plate within the initial specified value.

Initial standard: 0.7 — 1.1 mm (0.028 — 0.043 in)

Limit thickness: 1.6 mm (0.063 in)

![](images/588846eaade332539697cbf1c590c284acfa0601162ffdac410671450c7575f5.jpg)

![](images/529080d392a7927b0ecbdb857f1b3b292d93e5279a42985bb913bd1b930c843d.jpg)

12) Check the clearance between the snap ring and retaining plate. <Ref. to CVT(TR690)-157, INSPECTION, Transfer Clutch.>

### E: INSPECTION

• Inspect the drive plate facing for wear and damage.
• Driven plate for discoloration (burned color)
• Make sure the snap ring is not worn and the return spring has no permanent distortion, damage, or deformation.
• Check the lip seal for damage.
• Inspect the extension end play, and adjust it to within the standard value. <Ref. to CVT(TR690)-157, ADJUSTMENT, Transfer Clutch.>
1) Before measuring clearance “A” between snap ring and retaining plate, place same thickness shims on both sides to prevent the retaining plate from tilting.
2) When clearance “A” exceeds the limit for use, replace the drive plate and driven plate as a set, and select the pressure plate within the initial specified value.

Initial standard: 0.7 — 1.1 mm (0.028 — 0.043 in)

Limit thickness: 1.6 mm (0.063 in)

![](images/b534e81e46e6391465b5d1b31f2a26e8706ab930a2b9f1c1ec5f86153d87af59.jpg)

3) Check for tight corner braking phenomenon when the vehicle is moved forward with the steering fully turned. If tight corner braking occurs, perform the following procedures.

NOTE:

Turn OFF the X MODE switch and perform inspection.

(1) With the steering wheel held at fully turned position, drive the vehicle in “D” range and with vehicle speed at approx. 5 km/h (3 MPH) in both clockwise and counterclockwise directions for approx. ten times each, while repeating acceleration and braking intermittently. (2) If the tight corner braking phenomenon still persists, drive the vehicle again in a circle for several laps.

### A: REMOVAL

1) Remove the transmission assembly from the vehicle. <Ref. to CVT(TR690)-55, REMOVAL, Automatic
Transmission Assembly.>
2) Remove the extension case. <Ref. to CVT(TR690)-138, REMOVAL, Extension Case.>
3) Remove the rear drive shaft. <Ref. to CVT(TR690)-141, REMOVAL, Rear Drive Shaft.>
4) Remove the transfer clutch assembly. <Ref. to CVT(TR690)-146, REMOVAL, Transfer Clutch.>
5) Remove the transfer reduction driven gear assembly.

ST2 398497701 SEAT
ST3 498077600 REMOVER 2) Using the ST, remove the ball bearing (small) from transfer reduction driven gear. ST1 899864100 REMOVER

1) Measure depth “A” from the ST upper face to the ball bearing catch surface. ST 398643600 GAUGE

![](images/95e0a7ac8d613c79e85ba9aeef8e96c8e52e9aa3edf6ee97a1fff9d729320ec9.jpg)

[T in = (A – 0.591) – (B + 0.591) – (0.002 — 0.01)]
T: Shim thickness
A: Depth from the ST upper face to the ball bearing catch surface
B: Height from the ST to the end of the ball bearing outer ring
15 mm (0.591 in): Thickness of ST
0.05 — 0.25 mm (0.002 — 0.01 in): Clearance

### C: DISASSEMBLY

1) Remove the parking support.
2) Remove the CVTF filler plug.
3) Remove all plugs from intermediate case.

![](images/0baac36dd1432c8d1c312e81b2f1b01493b78904545fb6005748cfe050f03217.jpg)
CVT(TR690)-168

4) Remove the reverse brake assembly. <Ref. to CVT(TR690)-171, DISASSEMBLY, Reverse Brake Assem bly.>

### D: ASSEMBLY

1) Install the reverse brake. <Ref. to CVT(TR690)-174, ASSEMBLY, Reverse Brake Assembly.>
2) install all plugs to intermediate case.

Tightening torque: 25 N·m (2.5 kgf-m, 18.4 ft-lb)

NOTE: Use new O-rings.

![](images/0e53e805631ffda6e31089d527f95bff5939f8fab49c6ba3dba52277c9878ff6.jpg)

3) Install the parking support.

Tightening torque: 25 N·m (2.5 kgf-m, 18.4 ft-lb) 4) Install the CVTF filler plug.

NOTE:

Replace the gasket of CVTF filler plug with a new part after installing the transmission assembly to vehicle and adjusting CVTF fluid.

### E: INSPECTION

• Check the intermediate case for fissures, cracks or damage. Check for leakage of CVTF from the connections between intermediate case and transmission case, and
between intermediate case and extension case.

### 35.CVTF Filter

A: REMOVAL

NOTE:

• Although CVTF filter is a maintenance-free part, replace it if a large quantity of wear debris and metal particles are found in CVTF and CVTF filter.
• For removal of CVTF filter, refer to “Intermediate Case”. <Ref. to CVT(TR690)-165, REMOVAL, Intermediate Case.>

### B: INSTALLATION

NOTE:
For installation of CVTF filter, refer to “Intermediate Case”. <Ref. to CVT(TR690)- 166, INSTALLATION, In
termediate Case.>

### C: INSPECTION

Check if a large quantity of wear debris or metal particles are in CVTF and CVTF filter.
Check for broken part or damaged O-ring.

### D: ASSEMBLY

1) Apply CVTF to the seal of reverse brake piston and install it to intermediate case.

![](images/bb1d54f7e80d33ae7b4a202bef3219709c44b3546166360377ab2f8a9470d7ab.jpg)

2) Install the return spring.

![](images/d196917617391034787d580182503f3a13cbf87cd4fcdd46c0f73aa76f4b9d25.jpg)

![](images/ba48dc8c9fd38379211dc8c080917ba42fd751ff6584e495bb410e7fa3318cea.jpg)

(A) Snap ring (B) Spring retainer

4) Set the ST1, ST2 and ST3 to intermediate case. ST1 18762AA000 COMPRESSOR SPECIAL TOOL ST2 18763AA000 COMPRESSOR SHAFT ST3 18765AA000 COMPRESSOR SUPPORT

![](images/0362da33074ac63659eb2258a754bd65c22af4a90b028baa0559e68da3c1ca72.jpg)

5) Compress the return spring using the ST attached, and install the snap ring.

![](images/2141d82943c7d0900545ee196c1854a13b670a18002e49e3bc1a20611a641323.jpg)

6) Check the operation of reverse brake piston by blowing compressed air intermittently from intermediate case hole.

![](images/e4af05f530d33e8144d46b50a35704b2b89e3757fd95f57b404c542cd9428fe3.jpg)

7) Place the dish plate, driven plate, drive plate and retaining plate neatly in this order on surface table.
8) Set the dial gauge to retaining plate, and read its scale.

NOTE:

The value, which is read in the gauge at this time, is zero point.
9) Scale and record the weight “Z” of a flat board which will be put on retaining plate.

NOTE:

Use a stiff board which does not bend against load as a flat board to be put on retaining plate.
Use a flat board weighing less than 84 N (8.6 kgf, 18.9 lb).

10) Put the flat board on retaining plate.

![](images/24bdccada14044784eb70a165e3a39107e35a4e2bbc86c334faacdf4ceba7ef0.jpg)

11) Using the following formula, read the push/pull gauge, and calculate “N”. N = 84 N (8.6 kgf, 18.9 lb) – Z
84 N (8.6 kgf, 18.9 lb) Load applied to clutch plate
Z: Flat board weight

12) Press the center of retaining plate by applying a force of “N” or more using push/pull gauge, and then measure and record the compression amount “A”.

NOTE: Measure at four points with a 90° interval and calculate the average.

![](images/d4bbf310084343b026d1bcf93c1a59d812da611caf52178ac41d726e070714ed.jpg)

AT-07880

(A) Drive plate (B) Driven plate (C) Retaining plate (D) Dish plate

13) Install the dish plate, drive plate, driven plate, retaining plate and snap ring to intermediate case.

NOTE:

Install the dish plate in the correct direction.
14) Measure and record the clearance “B” between the retaining plate and snap ring. 15) Piston stroke calculation
Calculate with A and B dimensions recorded before. If it exceeds the limit, replace with a new drive plate and adjust within the initial standard value.
S mm (in) = A + B
S: Piston stroke
A: Compression amount of drive plate and dish plate
B: Clearance between retaining plate and snap ring

![](images/47054d47d9bb2f761097a29a47897db4a32bc7f703cca5f64a55d442aab09b0e.jpg)

Initial standard: 2.88 — 3.18 mm (0.113 — 0.125 in)

Limit thickness: 3.38 mm (0.133 in)

### E: INSPECTION

Inspect the drive plate facing for wear and damage. Check the driven plate for discoloration (burnt color). Check for worn snap ring, fatigue or damaged return spring or deformed spring retainer. • Make sure the clearance between retaining plate and snap ring of reverse brake is within the limit. If it exceeds the limit, replace with a new drive plate and select and adjust the retaining plate within the initial standard value. <Ref. to CVT(TR690)-174, ASSEMBLY, Reverse Brake Assembly.>

### E: INSPECTION

• Check the forward clutch drum, internal gear, sun gear and forward clutch piston lip for wear or damage. • Inspect the drive plate facing for wear and damage.
• Check the driven plate for discoloration (burnt color).
Check for worn snap ring, fatigue or damaged return spring or deformed spring retainer.
+ Make sure the clearance between retaining plate and internal gear of forward clutch is within the limit. If it exceeds the standard, replace the forward clutch assembly. <Ref. to CVT(TR690)-189, ASSEMBLY, Forward Clutch Assembly.>

### F: ADJUSTMENT

1) Measure depth “A” from the ST upper face to the washer catch surface. ST 398643600 GAUGE

![](images/425746c3fc0e25b506a2119ab776b33ec6bc5b73ab18b2c6a24316be3cdfed68.jpg)

2) Install the forward clutch assembly to intermediate case.

3) Setting the ST, measure height “B” from the ST upper side to the intermediate case mating surface. ST 499575600 GAUGE

![](images/0091da418c44923197725562e479941291eb841f1296ccce880d0c57f159972f.jpg)

4) Obtain the thickness of washer using the following formula.
Calculation formula:
T (mm) = (A – 15) – (B – 15) – (0.35 — 0.70)
[T (in) = (A – 0.591) (B – 0.591) – (0.014 — 0.028)]
T: Washer thickness
A: Depth from the ST upper face to the washer catch surface
B: Height from the upper surface of the ST to the mating surface of the intermediate case 15 mm (0.591 in): Thickness of ST
0.35 — 0.70 mm (0.014 — 0.028 in): Clearance
5) Select the washer to meet the value “T” obtained from step 4).

![](images/a2b9185e2657bfdb4031f7f5001141a34c171da86f263695906d44d305e85e30.jpg)

(A) Bolt (B) Range select lever (C) Manual plate (D) Parking rod

3) Install the spring pin.

NOTE: Use new spring pin.

![](images/5489264fe7a716c15ba90056aea77a6c6795fd3a2cd55a759d96cb6f52d408cc.jpg)

4) Install the inhibitor switch. <Ref. to CVT(TR690)-91, Inhibitor Switch.>
5) Adjust the inhibitor switch. <Ref. to CVT(TR690)-91, Inhibitor Switch.>

Body.>

Transmission Assembly.>

### A: REMOVAL

1) Remove the transmission assembly from the vehicle. <Ref. to CVT(TR690)-55, REMOVAL, Automatic Transmission Assembly.>

2) Remove the air breather hose. <Ref. to CVT(TR690)-132, REMOVAL, Air Breather Hose.>
3) Remove the transmission harness. <Ref. to CVT(TR690)-118, REMOVAL, Transmission Harness.>
4) Remove the secondary speed sensor. <Ref. to CVT(TR690)-98, REMOVAL, Secondary Speed Sensor.>
5) Remove the inhibitor switch. <Ref. to CVT(TR690)-94, REMOVAL, Inhibitor Switch.>
6) Remove the extension case. <Ref. to CVT(TR690)-138, REMOVAL, Extension Case.>
7) Remove the rear drive shaft. <Ref. to CVT(TR690)-141, REMOVAL, Rear Drive Shaft.>
8) Remove the transfer clutch assembly. <Ref. to CVT(TR690)-146, REMOVAL, Transfer Clutch.>
9) Remove the transfer reduction driven gear assembly. <Ref. to CVT(TR690)-158, REMOVAL, Transfer Re
duction Driven Gear.>
10) Remove the intermediate case. <Ref. to CVT(TR690)-165, REMOVAL, Intermediate Case.>
11) Remove the forward clutch assembly. <Ref. to CVT(TR690)-180, REMOVAL, Forward Clutch Assem
bly.>
12) Remove the reduction driven gear. <Ref. to CVT(TR690)-200, REMOVAL, Reduction Driven Gear.>
13) Remove the oil pan and control valve body. <Ref. to CVT(TR690)-108, REMOVAL, Control Valve Body.>

NOTE:

When removing the control valve body, also remove the pressure pipe if it is attached on the case.

![](images/141ab1c51e45a016d0287587e3adb97f11b46c744b9d22bb513dff35a3f17d9b.jpg)

14) Remove the CVTF pipe using a tire lever etc.

NOTE: Remove by hooking the stepped portion of CVTF pipe with a tire lever etc.

![](images/9d83d926e401dbfdbf926854939e8ef445e9ae9784e7698ae7c1bd03ad61aafe.jpg)

(A) CVTF pipe (B) Tire lever

15) Remove the CVTF cooler hose.

![](images/2dff44c4409bf85021625e554a8219b9fd448ebd977f6d832506b5f30154ec13.jpg)

16) Remove the transmission case.

NOTE:

The total number of transmission case mounting bolts is 15.

17) Remove the O-ring of lubrication pipe.

![](images/e8ed0fb0512684ebb8a1cb5526766728878ce4a07b019299ef60ba3295a4d638.jpg)

18) Remove the control device system. <Ref. to CVT(TR690)-207, REMOVAL, Transmission Control Device.>

### B: INSTALLATION

1) Clean the mating surface of transmission case and converter case.
2) Install the control device system. <Ref. to CVT(TR690)-209, INSTALLATION, Transmission Control Device.>
3) Install the O-ring to the lubrication pipe.

NOTE:

Use new O-rings.
Apply CVTF to the O-ring.

![](images/0f30aba239e40e7b1bbc2e7fc97d96787296f7a01f538910c5366a8e0891c9c6.jpg)

4) Make sure the lubrication pipe and support rod are in vertical position.

![](images/435c717f6553c99a76a76ab043dca82bfba4a30ad61135c2c61a5bf320645dbc.jpg)

5) Apply liquid gasket seamlessly to the mating surface of transmission case.

Liquid gasket: THREE BOND 1215 (Part No. 004403007) or equivalent

![](images/f7a62c7f702223a03221a99b5e27b6d99988a614a1da1fd382545babf45fc839.jpg)

6) Install the transmission case.

> ⚠️ **Внимание:** 
> If the transmission case gets in contact with the lubrication pipe and support rod, do not install the transmission case forcibly.
>
> NOTE:
>
> • Install while checking the lubrication pipe and support rod is being inserted properly into transmission
> case.
> • If installing the transmission is difficult, check if the lubrication pipe and support rod are bent. The total number of transmission case mounting bolts is 15.
>
> Tightening torque: 41 N·m (4.2 kgf-m, 30.2 ft-lb)
>
> 7) Install the O-ring to CVTF pipe.
>
> NOTE:
> Use new O-rings.
> 8) The smaller opening of CVTF pipe should be inserted to transmission.
>
> NOTE: After installing, make sure the CVTF pipe does not stick out of transmission case.
>
> ![](images/869f749dcb6706ff7d28f189f07d697bffa3b133a2b6b64c19373377abc382c5.jpg)
>
> AT-05588
>
> 9) Install the CVTF hose.

> ℹ️ **Примечание:** 
> Use new CVTF hoses.
> Install the CVTF hose with the painted position facing the rear side of transmission.
> 10) Install the reduction driven gear. <Ref. to CVT(TR690)-201, INSTALLATION, Reduction Driven Gear.>
> 11) Install the forward clutch assembly. <Ref. to CVT(TR690)-181, INSTALLATION, Forward Clutch Assem
> bly.>
> 12) Install the intermediate case. <Ref. to CVT(TR690)-166, INSTALLATION, Intermediate Case.>
> 13) Install the transfer reduction driven gear assembly. <Ref. to CVT(TR690)-158, INSTALLATION, Transfer
> Reduction Driven Gear.>
> 14) Install the transfer clutch assembly. <Ref. to CVT(TR690)-147, INSTALLATION, Transfer Clutch.>
> 15) Install the rear drive shaft. <Ref. to CVT(TR690)-141, INSTALLATION, Rear Drive Shaft.>
> 16) Install the extension case. <Ref. to CVT(TR690)-139, INSTALLATION, Extension Case.>
> 17) Install the inhibitor switch. <Ref. to CVT(TR690)-96, INSTALLATION, Inhibitor Switch.>
> 18) Install the secondary speed sensor. <Ref. o CVT(TR690)-99, INSTALLATION, Secondary Speed Sen
> sor.>
> 19) Install the transmission harness. <Ref. to CVT(TR690)-120, INSTALLATION, Transmission Harness.>
> 20) Install the control valve body and oil pan. <Ref. to CVT(TR690)-112, INSTALLATION, Control Valve
> Body.>
> 21) Install the air breather hose. <Ref. to CVT(TR690)-132, INSTALLATION, Air Breather Hose.>
> 22) Install the transmission assembly to the vehicle. <Ref. to CVT(TR690)-68, INSTALLATION, Automatic
> Transmission Assembly.>

### E: INSPECTION

• Check the transmission case for damage.
• Check for leakage of CVTF from the connection between converter case and transmission case. Check for leakage of CVTF from the connection between intermediate case and transmission case. Check the lubrication pipe for bend or damage. Check the bearing for smooth operation. Check the bearing for seizure or wear.

When replacing the transmission case with a new part, perform the following check and adjustment for the

ward Clutch Assembly.> Select the snap ring for the reduction gear. <Ref. to CVT(TR690)-206, ADJUSTMENT, Reduction Driven
Gear.>

### 41.Primary Pulley and Secondary Pulley

A: REMOVAL

NOTE:

Always replace primary pulley and secondary pulley as an assembly because they are non-disassembled parts.

1) Remove the transmission assembly from the vehicle. <Ref. to CVT(TR690)-55, REMOVAL, Automatic Transmission Assembly.>

2) Remove the air breather hose. <Ref. to CVT(TR690)-132, REMOVAL, Air Breather Hose.>
3) Remove the oil pan and control valve body. <Ref. to CVT(TR690)-108, REMOVAL, Control Valve Body.> 4) Remove the transmission harness. <Ref. to CVT(TR690)-118, REMOVAL, Transmission Harness.> 5) Remove the extension case. <Ref. to CVT(TR690)-138, REMOVAL, Extension Case.>
6) Remove the rear drive shaft. <Ref. to CVT(TR690)-141, REMOVAL, Rear Drive Shaft.>
7) Remove the transfer clutch assembly. <Ref. to CVT(TR690)-146, REMOVAL, Transfer Clutch.> 8) Remove the transfer reduction driven gear assembly. <Ref. to CVT(TR690)-158, REMOVAL, Transfer Reduction Driven Gear.>
9) Remove the intermediate case. <Ref. to CVT(TR690)-165, REMOVAL, Intermediate Case.>
10) Remove the forward clutch assembly. <Ref. to CVT(TR690)-180, REMOVAL, Forward Clutch Assembly.>
11) Remove the transmission case. <Ref. to CVT(TR690)-211, REMOVAL, Transmission Case.> 12) Set the ST to the secondary pulley, and expand the V groove of pulley until the variator chain gets completely loose.

### ST 18769AA000 EXPANDER PULLEY

![](images/84fe90cd4c11ceecd1ec716e62c7d3da7148e58ededbaa32cdb81a34b31c1c9f.jpg)

13) Remove the chain guide from lubrication pipe and support rod.

14) Remove the lubrication pipe and support rod.

![](images/bfccf09c1250e7a4fba63556faac85b67de540741d105464e7da80f0dfd50134.jpg)

15) Detach the four claws to remove the two chain guides.

![](images/a8c895ee8d1dbd6fe90055cc581b18b7151fe2a63a7758353e019201bed8792c.jpg)

16) Remove the secondary pulley mounting bolt.

![](images/91dd34d1bce0caee2ea7ee636a05e88d53b48996cf88bc46679c14b8a1819c4d.jpg)

17) Remove the secondary pulley from drive pinion retainer and intersect the V groove of secondary pulley and V groove of primary pulley. Remove the variator chain from secondary pulley and remove the secondary pulley.

> ⚠️ **Внимание:** 
> Cover the V grooves of secondary pulley and primary pulley with cloth to protect the both pulley and variator chain from scratching.
>
> ![](images/3cf3b3ebe622d0aa841a2c5652686e5eda36bdf88731c457cd81f755bfa1a96e.jpg)
>
> 18) Remove the variator chain from primary pulley.
>
> 19) Remove the primary pulley mounting bolt.
>
> ![](images/9cfed1f277ae0168ff2aa1bc94caeb8214b6e304dd66df809adb3744940f4143.jpg)
>
> 20) Remove the primary pulley.
> 21) Remove the two seal rings from drive pinion retainer.
>
> ![](images/09e3aba8835239334e9857c439a9772339a5a4307d50eed7f3ecbc4b8554e898.jpg)
>
> 22) Remove the two seal rings from primary pulley.
>
> ![](images/c3f2b8720db4797d51ae705a60ad037d3f718ede12f1158cfd078ae6faff12dd.jpg)

### B: INSTALLATION

1) Select shims for pulley alignment. <Ref. to CVT(TR690)-237, ADJUSTMENT, Primary Pulley and Secondary Pulley.>
2) Install the two seal rings to drive pinion retainer.

NOTE:

Use a new seal ring.
Apply CVTF to the seal rings.
When installing the seal ring, do not expand the seal ring too much.

![](images/3a0eede5fa02f670eb74d2115c04a61f635076c9a3e8adaae2efa231869918fb.jpg)

3) Install the selected shims to the primary pulley bearing catch surface.

4) Install the two seal rings to primary pulley.

> ℹ️ **Примечание:** 
> Use a new seal ring.
> Apply CVTF to the seal rings.
>
> ![](images/a3e251be837bdf9b2851f581137ef2a937430c6ef1f173b74ed120e08d87c374.jpg)
>
> 5) Install the primary pulley and adjust the position of bolt holes of primary bearing retainer and converter case to tighten the primary pulley bolt.
>
> NOTE: Use a new seal washer.
>
> Tightening torque: 21 N·m (2.1 kgf-m, 15.5 ft-lb)
>
> ![](images/7f92566d3fcfcf62c7e1f491b12fee0ff33a28f6bf0d65df20503a07a11b76d4.jpg)
>
> 6) Set the ST to secondary pulley and expand the V groove of pulley. ST 18769AA000 EXPANDER PULLEY
>
> ![](images/8c676a5c85ad231aa365fd4d653afd321d6ee76ab9e439901bf29326bb5d213c.jpg)
>
> 7) Place the variator chain on the primary pulley groove and attach the secondary pulley and variator chain together to the drive pinion retainer.

> ⚠️ **Внимание:** 
> Cover the V grooves of primary pulley and secondary pulley with cloth to protect the both pulleys and variator chain from scratching.
>
> (1) Place the variator chain on primary pulley.
> (2) Intersect the V groove of primary pulley and the V groove of secondary pulley and install the secondary pulley while placing the variator chain on secondary pulley.
>
> ![](images/b0e0fd4e74e14c7371e25f33a5807427c16f859cdbf1acb50ce4740f16cc3f73.jpg)
>
> (3) While aligning the bolt hole of secondary bearing retainer and the bolt hole of driving pinion retainer, install the secondary pulley to drive pinion retainer.
>
> 8) Install the secondary pulley bolt.
>
> NOTE: Apply CVTF to the bolt.
>
> Tightening torque: 33 N·m (3.4 kgf-m, 24.3 ft-lb)
>
> ![](images/e07b2a589d9e4146c8883b5f298fc1c382b9467bde2fc9b77ad979e7d6694466.jpg)
>
> 9) Install the chain guide.
>
> NOTE: Install it with two claws facing outward and with two claws facing inward.
